title: Montserrat Half-Day Tour with Tapas and Gourmet Wines
description: Combining Montserrat Monastery with a winery visit for wine tastings is an unusual combination that’s difficult to arrange independently. This day trip makes it easy: with round-trip air-conditioned transport and a guided tour of Montserrat so you see and learn about all its highlights. Plus, your winery tour includes tastings, tapas, and dessert, so you don’t need to budget for lunch.

reviews.usertext:
I had a very nice tour visiting Montserrat and Oller del Mas winery. Our guide, Anays was great, she provided a lot of interesting information with fun facts and I enjoyed listening to her stories. The views at Montserrat are breathtaking and the winery is special, having a history of over 1000 years. The wines are delicious and fairly priced, the tasting takes place in the old family castle. For me this was the best part of the tour.
A few tips:
If you are looking for a short visit to Montserrat, or want to return for a second visit at your own pace, this is the tour for you. Because there are many things to do and you won't be able to do them in one hour, you have to choose one. You can visit the monastery, the museum, go hiking, take the funicular to see the views (there is a 30 minute hike once you reach the top if you want to see the monstery from above from the highest point), taste and buy the various local products etc.
So if you are like me I would suggest taking a full day tour or going on your own.
If you only want to visit the monastery and see the black Madonna don't go on a sunday. You will arrive at mass and you won't be able to spend more than a few minutes in the church.
All in all it was a nice experience and I had a very enjoyable day.

My husband and I just loved this tour and that was because of our tour guide, Aurora. Aurora enthusiastically shared her vast knowledge of Montserrat including its significance, history, its geology and, of course, its famous monastery.
Because of of her warm and vivacious personality along with her great sense of humour, she adeptly kept the tour group totally engaged.

During the second part of the tour, we visited a centuries old winery where we enjoyed a lovely tapas lunch and wine tasting. Once again, Aurora did not disappoint. She provided the tour group with an explanation of wines from vine to pallet and in doing so, captured the interest of the tour group.

This was a most excellent excursion and I highly recommend it to those who are planning a trip to Barcelona! Thank you so much, Aurora.

First, the planning for this was handled very well. The company worked with my group of 10 to make sure that we could all be on the same tour even though we purchased individually. Check-in was a breeze and the tour sizes themselves were quite small. When I saw the size of the bus I was worried the tour was going to be too big and impersonal, but instead, they had put approximately 15 ppl per tour guide. The bus was comfortable and especially important... air-conditioned. The guides were witty and entertaining while informative during the ride which started the trip off on a good note.

Our tour guide, Marianna, made this tour so enjoyable for us! We kept talking about how much we enjoyed her energy and Joi de Vivre. Being about our 5th tour, we were toured out, but she made it a completely different experience. Many of our group walked away feeling like they were now wine connoisseurs and very happy with the day.

Additionally, Marianna shared with us a map of suggested places to go and music to listen to. I've done tours in Scotland, England, Zürich, Strausberg, Quebec, and Montreal and never had someone follow up that way. I was very pleased with the service and attention that Marianna and Castle Experience Wine Tours provided.

Absolutely incredible! Gus was an amazing tour guide and made the trip so memorable and informative. He was able to tell a story with his facts about Montserrat, as well as, the winery and family history. 10/10 would recommend if you’re looking for beautiful sites, delicious wine and tapas, and some comedy as well. Gus was the best! I did the tour solo and had the most fun.

Tour was nice and guide was informative and made fun jokes throughout. We spent about two hours at the basilica, which is much longer than I anticipated. It was hot outside so if going in the summer season, I recommend bringing your own water. The bus ride was about 40-60 minutes long, but very hilly and winding in the mountain, so if you’re sensitive to motion, be prepared. The winery accommodated dietary restrictions and there was a shop to purchase bottles. The only reason I’m giving less than 5-stars is because the winery was very crowded with all tours and the line to get wine (after the tasting) was very long in the hot sun and there was only one menu located at the bar, so it took everyone a long time to decide at the bar, which made the wait even longer. Additionally, the bar didn’t have several items which were listed on the menu, which took even more time to order.

My friends and I were so glad we did this tour! Two of us had been to Barcelona many times, but we were with our partners who had never been, so we decided to try a new way to see Montserrat and the surrounding area. Montserrat is always a treat, and our tour guide was efficient and knowledgeable, and knew how to avoid the crowds. However, the real highlight was the wine tasting in a castle/winery originally built in the 800s! Mareck was a super fun and engaging guide throughout the day, and the winery pleasantly surprised us with the quality of wine and experience. I really enjoyed sitting with my group, meeting everyone, eating tapas and learning a bit (but not too much) about the wines. I am one of those people who is always nervous to do "touristy things", and am a bit of a skeptic. So, I can confidently say that if you are looking for a day trip in Barcelona, this is a great one!

I had an amazing time. It seemed like all the visitors were half asleep and hangover or something which made it the more fun. Especially when Toni, our guide asked how everyone was doing and no one answered ( The first time) the second time we were all prompted to applaud and cheer and to put in energy so the guides would wake up as well. I think I even saw some stage diving and some underwear flying as everyone applauded the historical information we received. The views were incredible and I was able to make it to the lift to go up and hike back down to the temple. I saw lots of nuns and monks walking around and bought some local made cheese from the farmers market. The wine and tapas tour was definitely worth it and even though it was the end of the trip, I think everyone in the tour was awake by then. There were people from Costa Rica, Germany, Mexico, the USA and Puerto Rico. We had a food fight and broke a couple of bottles and headed back to Barcelona.

The trip began with our wonderful tour guide TONY. He was incredible from start to finish. The tour bus was pleasant and quite relaxing. Arrival to the monastery was rather quick. Tony gave us a well detailed tour while also giving us ‘free time,’ to roam the church, and the options to tour the museum or ‘hike’ up to the holy cross. We opted for the hike which provided absolutely wonderful views of Monserrat. Next was the wine tour which was in a completely separate location that was absolutely breathtaking. We sat as a group in a large communal table, with delicious treats comprised from individual charcuterie boards. We tasted 3 types of wines with wonderful descriptions for each provided by Tony. We were given more ‘free time’ to roam the grounds and capture our own wonderful pictographic memories before heading back to the city. A 100% must do!

An amazing experience with very knowledgeable tour guides. They had a great outlook and love for their country, where they had come from, and the culture it breeds. Views were amazing from the square and the tapas and wine at the end of the trip was icing on the cake for a great trip for my family and I! Shout out to Mariana, our tour guide, she is kind, experienced, and very talented. She explained to me something about the euro currency that I had never known, crazy enough staying in Europe for years I had never realized. All in all would definitely recommend this trip to anyone who is looking for a relaxing, informative, amazing trip of just a small piece of beauty that Spain has to offer.

The whole experience was wonderful! Monserrat was a magical place! Our tour guide Violeta was AMAZING!! She made the trip so much fun and was extremely knowledgeable about the history of Barcelona and Montserrat. Fantastic tour of the winery, tasty tapas and fun wine tasting to finish off our day. I highly recommend this on a 1-10 scale I give it a 15!!!!
Dorothy. 7/16/2022

The entire experience was extremely well organised and managed. Being broken down into smaller groups made the experience feel more personal and intimate. Our tour guide (Aurora) was class: she was extremely knowledgeable and had a wonderful personable approach that made us feel relaxed and at ease. It was a once in a lifetime experience to see the beautiful scenery of Monserrat and similarly, enjoy a selection of beautiful wines from a local Boutique winery. I would recommend this tour to anyone looking to experience the Catalonian culture beyond the city of Barcelona and would also recommend to have Aurora as your tour guide.

Violeta was our(group of 4, Texas) tour guide! Her English is wonderful and she is very knowledgeable, making the tour a very informative trip into one of Spain’s historical and picturesque area. The gorgeous mountains offer a cool climate along with wonderful views of the valley below. Visiting a monastery is not high on my list of fun things to do but Violeta kept the group in tune with her laidback style of guidance. Next, we visited a 1000 year old home of wine makers! After learning about the area and the family, Violeta sat the group at a large table, with tapas, and proceeded with a wonderful lesson in wine tasting. Afterwards, we sampled some wine and Violeta had us taste some dark chocolate(with olive oil and salt), which paired well with our full bodied wine. The bus ride back gave enough time for a siesta. Violeta is a rockstar and you will enjoy yourself on this tour!

From the moment we met her on the coach terminal in Barcelona, Mariana Lopez was simply charming, making my wife Jilly and I feel most welcome on our memorable coach trip to Montserrat.

Together with Anays, Mariana was fantastically attentive, providing the group with an enthusiastic and entertaining history of Catalonia, and of Montserrat (and its religious and historical significance), encouraging the tourists to interact with them during the very pleasant (air conditioned...phew!) coach drive to site.

Both were confident, funny, and demonstrably knowledgeable about the area and its history. It was immediately very clear (and genuinely heart-warming) to hear of Mariana's obvious pride in being a native Catalan.

Mariana went to great efforts to speak with each of the groups on the tour, making sure that she took the time to attend to everyone throughout the visit, answering many questions comprehensively.

Monserrat itself is lovely and the views from its walls breath-taking. Despite neither of us being remotely religious, Jilly and I found Mariana's recounting of the story of the discovery of the little black virgin entirely captivating and really quite moving; Mariana's undeniable enthusiasm was wholly infectious.

The 'shrine' of the little virgin really lived up to Mariana's narrative; Jilly and I agreed that visiting the site really was a spiritual and very worthwhile experience.

Our only regrets were that, in taking so much time looking around Montserrat, we failed to take advantage of the free tasting of the resident monks' liquor and that the neighbouring vineyard's delicious plonk isn't exported to England :-(}.

Jilly and I would have absolutely no hesitation in recommending this tour to anyone planning to visit Monserrat.

Thank you, Mariana, for a lovely day.

Our tour guide Violeta was amazing, she really took care of us and went above and beyond with regards to her hospitality, compassion, and fun. She made us feel welcome in Barcelona and shared so much about the culture and history. She was a great host and I would highly recommend coming and setting up a tour with her if possible.

The monastery wasn't something special, but i didn't go inside. The view from there is amazing and you are going there buy a kind of train that is climbing up the hill! Except of the monastery, the place there is beautiful, you can chill around, eat or drink a coffee or try local products. In general the first part of the trip is really good.

BUT the real trip is at the second part when you will explore the winery and taste some of the best Catalan wines! There you will have some food to combine and highlight the real taste of the wines!

The guides are awesome (Francese you are the best tour guide I have ever meet ❤️) with a lot of knowledge. Furthermore, as in every tour, you can make some friends that they will make your time even more better.

The price is really worth it, everything is included (transportation, wines, food, entrance to the monastery), sooo, I really recommend this tour.

Enjoy!

This is great day trip tour from Barcelona. It’s an easy 1 hour drive on a nice air conditioned bus. Jon was our guide today and gave us a nice overview of Montserrat before allowing us some free time to shop and take pictures. We then headed to Oller del Mas winery for tapas and wine tasting. Jon was quite entertaining with his wine presentation and has a vast knowledge of the winery. The tapas were top notch as well. I highly recommend this tour!

If I could have given this tour 10/10 I would. From start to finish the day was perfect. We had a large group and there was 14 of us. Nuria was our tour guide for the day. From the very beginning she interacted with all memebers of the group, very approachable if you had any questions and found her to be fabulous at her job. She was very interesting to listen to and very informative with regards the history of the region and the during the wine tasting. Thank you Nuria, hope to ser you again in the future.

You have to do this tour if you are in Barcelona! My husband and I very much enjoyed this tour! It was a last minute decision, and so far it has been one of my favorite highlights of visiting Barcelona. Our tour guide Mariana was very knowledgeable and informative of Catalunya, the monastery and history of the vineyard we visited. She and the other two tour guides we road with (on the very comfortable tour bus I should add) made the history lessons light and fun. Everything was very well organized. The tapas included with the wine tasting were superb and the sample liquors at the monastery we got to try was a great touch!
There is about an hour and a half for you to explore the area when you first get there. While some chose to hike to an amazing viewpoint, we opted to check out the beautiful church and the great art museum featuring Dali, Picasso, and Monet. There are also artisans selling homemade cheeses and honey which was an added bonus. Loved this tour!

One of my favorite days in Spain! The winery portion of the tour was good but Montserrat was the real highlight. I had very little interest in the religious aspect of Montserrat but the history and views from the mountain are spectacular.

Nuria was our guide. She was very knowledgeable, had a good sense of humor, and spoke excellent English. She did a great job of giving us a digestible history of Catalonia on the bus ride to Montserrat. Once we arrived at Montserrat, we did a brief walking tour, including entering the church that houses the Black Madonna. We then had roughly 45 minutes of free time to explore. I wish we had more because there are a number of things to do (hike to the cross, shop at the farmer's market, walk to the various lookout points, etc.) but not enough time to do them all. Because I was wearing sandals, we skipped the hike and checked out the farmer's market where we sampled some excellent cheeses before walking to one of the lookouts.

After we regrouped at the bus, it was a 20ish minute ride to the winery. The views are incredible as you descend the mountain! At the winery, we enjoyed a charcuterie board and sampled three wines (1 white and 2 red). Because we chose the half day tour, the winery portion felt a bit rushed. It would have been nice to stay longer to enjoy the patio and sample some of their other wines. Overall, a very nice way to spend a day in Barcelona!

Nuria was an excellent guide- friendly, fun and very knowledgeable. The pace of the day was wonderful - enough time on tour and on our own. The commentary by the guides on the bus ride was brilliant. The tapas and wine tasting event was beautifully done in a stunning setting. Would recommend this tour to anyone who wants to see Monserrat and learn more about the heart of Catalonia.

This was our favorite tour so far, especially for the price! Our tour guide was Violeta and she was INCREDIBLE. Her story telling just captured you in the history of Barcelona, it was like you hung on every word. She was light hearted and added comedy to the tour. Absolutely stunning views and great little winery to check out. Everything was organized and safe, with a great itinerary for the day. Definitely recommend, 10/10

Traveling solo so I said to myself let me fond a tour outside of Barcelona. I found this tour to be the most compatible with my time schedule and cost-efficient.
The meeting is point is easy with the provided directions inside the bus station. We were a group of almost 50 tourists, mostly couples. We were divided into smaller groups of 15 or so, with a tour guide for each group. We had Violeta who was a very amazing, helpful and knowledgeable person.
The tour was cozy, and although we had short showers of rain, that didn’t disrupt our tour or ruin the program.
I have truly enjoyed the 7 hours trip and I truly recommend it.

This tour was a wonderful way to spend the day going to Montserrat. The tour guides were very knowledgeable, and our guide Montse (yes, short for Montserrat) was exceptionally hospitable, helpful and charming. She brought the history and sights to life by taking her time explaining the significance of our surroundings. Once at Monserrat, we had a chance to explore the grounds, shop local vendors and taste the wonderful liquors made by the monks. The winery was great, too, and we enjoyed the wines and tapas. I would do the tour again.

We had an amazing day in Monserrat and in the Oller del Mas winery. Toni did a terrific job coordinating everything and telling us a lot of fun stories during the first part of the tour and then guided us through the wine tasting. The monastery and the whole Monserrat is a magical place, definitely worth visiting. I totally recommend doing it with Castlexperience. If you are lucky enough you will have Toni as your guide too.

We had the most amazing time on this trip. Very professional; bus departed on time and the guides made the one hour ride so fun detailing the history of Barcelona. Edu was our guide once we reached montserrat and his factual knowledge along with his personality and enthusiasm made our visit fantastic. The winery tour and tapas lunch did not disappoint. Beautiful winery and the lunch provided was also fantastic - even accommodated my vegan dietary needs. The wine tasting was perfect and plenty of time to wander and take photos before heading home. A huge thank you to our guide Edu for making us feel so welcome and special and comfortable. Would highly recommend this tour. Ask for Edu!!!

I should start by saying that Monserrat should not be missed. The tour given was average but the transportation was a great plus. The tour provided an average amount of information but everything was an additional fee. The main interest of the guide was the wine part of the tour and it was obvious they were an employee of the winery. The wine tasting was well done but again there were additional fees incurred here. All in all, there was nothing negative about the tour just an average tour. There were 7 in our group and this was our general consensus.

It was the best tour. My wife and Ioved it. Toni was our guide and he did a great job. The bus was very comfortable and easy to access during the trip (go downstairs at the North bus station when you first arrive to find the "Castle Experience" check in location). Professional driver was excellent at navigating the roads up the mountain. Guides gave us information not only about Monserrat but about the Catalan region as well, very interesting. Just the right amount of narration, not too much, not too little. The monastery is amazing. Highly recommend the hike to St Michael's cross for an panoramic view that is unbelievable (about 15 min hike). Wine tasting and Tapas were excellent. Nice amount of food and like 3 glasses of Wine! Also, lots of interesting information about Catalan wines and the wine region. Got back at 3:30pm.

Merak was simply outstanding. He shared personal stories, was extremely knowledgeable and entertaining the entire tour.

Listen to what he has to say as EVERYTHING he suggested was spot on. And, dinner recommendations were the best. You’ll even learn some Catalan throughout your day.

Highly recommended, you will NOT be disappointed - especially if Merak is your guide.

Salut I força al canut!!!

An average guide delivers the factual information well. An amazing guide like Toni tops the expectation by adding his own witty comments, jokes, and high energy to keep the audience super engaged throughout the day. Learned a lot about the Mont serrat and enjoyed the winery that followed after. Highly recommend!

Our Guide Anays is first class. Knowledgeable, informative, and humorous, she made an interesting trip more so, and entertaining. Learning the Black Madonna history
in the place of that history was important because the iconic figure itself is not striking, and not easy to see within the beautiful basilica.
The collection of candelabra inside was fascinating (good photo opportunities if there is no Mass).
The road up to the Monastery is stunning but not ideal for those with a fear of heights. Our coach drivers were excellent and on the journey, especially the down part, was done with great care, gentleness....and was appreciated.
The Tapas and Wine tasting was also enjoyable and informative thanks to Anays' down to earth oenology.

I’m so glad I booked this day trip! My boyfriend and I were staying in Barcelona for about 10 days and wanted to explore a little outside the city so this day trip to Monteserrat was perfect. We got to see a beautiful monastery and views of the mountains and countryside (the hike to the cross has the best views!) followed by a wine tasting at a vineyard. Our tour guide, Pep, was the absolute best! He gave us an abridged version of Catalan history (which was really fascinating) and was an all-round fun and engaging guide. Highly recommend this excursion!

Montserrat is beautiful and there is a wonderful art museum with paintings from well known masters that was very special to see. The winery is beautiful, the tapas delicious, and the wine very good. Our guide was Javier and he did a great job! Also Edu who entertained us on the bus was very funny and informative. Great tour we highly recommend.

Great Half-Day Tour! The Basilica of Montserrat is beautiful as well as the small town it resides in. The viewed from the top are incredible. The wine tour at Ollers was also nice. We just wanted the tasting to be a a bit shorter so we could have enjoyed sitting on the roof top longer.

What a great family experience! Our family of 9 booked a private half day tour to Montserrat and a local winery/lunch. Jon, our guide was amazing! Great sense of humor, knowledgeable, and gave great tips along the way. Our favorite part was gathering at a big table at a local winery and getting to hear, Ana, the owners story and the special meaning behind her wines. We felt like part of family and enjoyed our afternoon there! You could see how much both Jon and Ana love what they do and we were lucky enough to get to know them and a little more about Spain! What great memories created! Thank you!

Montserrat was absolutely stunning, wish we would have had more time there as we got tickets to see the black Madonna up close but the time would have been after our tour was due to leave. There is so much to see and even just sitting quietly taking in the views requires more time. However the tour was very convenient, buses were clean, spacious with very comfortable chairs that reclined and A/C. Tour guides were fun and entertaining, even the ride from Barcelona to Montserrat and then the wine tasting was very enjoyable as there are so many interesting and beautiful things to see along the way. The wine tasting was very nice, Tapas were delicious and they even accommodated vegan and vegetarian individuals. Wine was pretty tasty and plenty of water was provided for the hot temperatures and to cleanse your pallet between tastings. My entire family really enjoyed this excursion, I absolutely recommend to anyone visiting.

It was our second day in Barcelona & we were so glad we spent it doing this tour! Montserrat was absolutely stunning, a little foggy but by the time we went to leave it cleared out. The wine tour in the castle was amazing. Our tour guide Gus was so informative & really gave us information that made our experience to Spain so special. I recommend this experience 10/10! Make sure you wear sneakers so you can do the hike at the Montserrat & bring a light jacket in case it’s a little chilly.

Wonderful tour with our guide, Nerea. She was so knowledgeable and friendly. She did a great job explaining everything we saw and gave us great insider tips on which side of the bus to sit on for the best views. I was also very impressed with her knowledge of the wines we tried on the tour. Would definitely recommend!!

Highest recommendation. Lorena was a wonderful guide and her English was perfect! We didn't realize ahead of time we would not be able to see the Madonna up close which was disappointing but that was not explained in the trip description. Also, the tapas and wine tasting was good but very minimal, again, not really described in the description what to expect....we would have brought lunch if we knew it was so small. Lorena however was fantastic all the way. Learned so much and really informative! Montserrat was amaing, and the history of the winery was fascinating!

This tour was recommended to us by a friend who took the full day tour a few weeks prior to our visit. Due to limited time on our itinerary we took the 1/2 day tour (which is pretty much a full day). I highly recommend the full day tour if you enjoy hiking as the views are amazing or take the 1/2 day Montserrat tour without the winery. Unfortunately, it was quite foggy during our visit and the trail to the cross was closed due to a recent landslide. Also, since we were on the 1/2 day tour, it did not allow time for us to take the funicular up the mountain or visit the museum, so another reason to take full day tour. Alex was a great guide, very knowledgeable, his English was impeccable and very friendly and professional. The bus transportation was comfortable, modern and clean. The winery tour was nice, we have taken many wine tours before so it is nice to see a different process. The tapas were quite disappointing and the wine tasing portion felt a bit rushed (probably because the travel time took longer due to the fog coming up and down the mountain). My recommendation would be to improve the tapas as they were lacking in flavor. By the time you get to the winery you have worked up quite an appetite so unfortunately this was not satisfying. All in all, this tour was a 4 and I highly recommend.

We were collected in an immaculate, comfortable, large coach as there were 3 tour groups going at the same time. Each group had their own guide, ours was Nuria and she was excellent at her job, welcoming, excellent english and knowledgeable about Montserrat and then later, Oller del Mas winery. The other guides were lovely people too. En-route to Montserrat we learned about the history of Catalonia and how Montserrat Mountain range was formed and the legend of the Black Madonna. The journey from the coach park to the Monastery in the cog wheel rail cars was interesting and there are great views of the stunning, steep hillsides.
The views from Montserrat Monastery were amazing. It can be cool as there is usually a breeze and there are shady parts. Layer up and then strip down if too warm. Nuria provided good advice about what it would be possible to do during our free-time -I went up to St Michael's Cross for the views of the Pyrenees and the Monastery, worth the time and climb!
The coach collected us up at the monastery instead of going back down in the cog wheel rail cars and transported us via winding mountain roads down to Oller del Mas winery where we spent a pleasant two hours learning about the history of the winery, vines, wine production and so on. We had a light tapas style lunch and 3 small glasses of different wines with instruction from Nuria on how to look at, smell and taste the wines. The journey back took about an hour. A good day out!

This tour was the highlight of our time in Barcelona. Our guide Nuria Carbolla was very helpful and kind and she shared her knowledge and love of the Catalunya region and the history and relevance of Montserrat. We learned a lot from her.

Montserrat was beautiful and spiritually uplifting. It is a place to return to for sure. The castle, tapas, and wine tour was a valuable addition to the day and again our guide Nuria shared her extensive knowledge of the Catalunya wine region. It was a special experience.

The whole tour was well organized and the buses comfortable

We highly recommend this tour.

We had an absolutely wonderful time on our Montserrat and Wine Tasting tour. Aurora was a wonderful guide. She balanced very well providing information and history while also allowing for freedom to wander and do some of our own activities. Montserrat is simply stunning and beyond words. The bus ride up the mountains was an adventure in itself, if you get motion sick you may want to consider taking something. The bus driver (his name escapes me) did an amazing job.

The winery experience was excellent as well. The winery and land has been in the same family since the 900's. The wines were stellar and the tapas delicious. We were lucky to have a few moments to talk to the owner and his passion for wine as well as for being preserving the lands and being ecologically responsible were great.

We highly recommend this experience for anyone.

’ve been to Barcelona before, but on this recent trip I brought along my partner and his mother. I wanted them to experience Monserrat and wine tasting tour and was not disappointed. From beginning to end the staff was accommodating and friendly. We had Daniel as our tour guide and was extremely happy. He was informative giving us a history background of Monserrat, but it was his friendly/happy personality that made this trip worth it!!!! He was constantly checking in on those in his group and was always available to any questions or request throwing in a joke here and there! I would definitely recommend him if your thinking of taking a tour with CastleExperience, though everyone else we encountered were friendly and welcoming.

We had a great time! Aurora was an excellent tour guide. She has rich knowledge of all places we visited. She added fun and interesting narratives which made us laugh and feel at easy. Thank you for a memorable experience.

Definitely a great way to spend a day while visiting Barcelona. The meeting place for pickup was a central location and the pink umbrellas made our tour guides extremely easy to locate. They transport us in one of those giant coach buses and they were air conditioned and very comfortable. Aurora was our tour guide and she was magnificent! First half was the trip to Montserrat and a tour of the abbey which holds the statue of the Black Madonna. You had an hour of free time there to hike or shop or eat. We hiked up the mountain to get some photos of the views from there. Took us about 35 minutes there and back including our stops for photos at the cross. St Miquel’s I think? Worth the trek in my opinion. After that was about a half hour ride to the winery. It was SO nice. Beautiful brand new modern building. You get a lesson on how the wines are made and a difference between the process of making white, blush and red wines. Then you taste all the wines and a delicious late lunch is provided. Lots of fun conversations and laughing along the way. After the wine and food you get about a half hour to take photos or buy something in the shop. Loved this experience. So happy we did it!

I went on this trip while pregnant with my mother, husband and 2 year old. Even though I couldn’t drink wine we all had a great time! Our tour guide Pol was entertaining and informative- loved learning about the history and geology of these beautiful places. We saw Dali, Picasso, Monet and other beautiful artwork in the nearly-empty Montserrat museum while there too.

The tour to Montserrat with wine and tapas is highly recommended. Great views from the monastery, great wine and delicious tapas.
But the tour would have been only half as nice and interesting if we had not had our guide Marta.
Marta is very authentic and sympathetic. With her knowledge and the stories she tells, she knows how to carry her audience along. She is an outstanding guide. Thank you again for that.

Awesome time and the history of this place is so Rich. This is truly the heart of Catalonia and the view on the top of this mountain is truly breathtaking something that makes you appreciate creation and God’s handiwork in it. Jon was also a great tour guide and was super upbeat and knowledgeable of the site.

Fabulous half day tour with amazing guide, Jon. Definitely recommend taking a day from touring the city of Barcelona to do this trip. Jon was charming and funny and well versed in everything Montserrat . He also knew many details about the wines we tasted. The winery we visited has an incredible history and was founded in 964! Also recommend buying some honey and CHEESE from the local Montserrat vendors - incredible!

If you like religion, history, amazing views or even just wine, then this is the trip for you. It’s a full day experience that is planned out extremely well. They give you extra time at both stops and the tour guides are very knowledgeable. Our tour guide in particular was Jon. And let me tell you, if you somehow get the chance to choose which guide you get, please pick Jon. His demeanor and knowledge made the entire trip that much better. He’s constantly smiling and telling jokes and his good attitude and personality are infectious. You’ll have a good time on this trip, but you’ll have an even better one if Jon is your tour guide. Only thing I would change is maybe just tad bit longer of free time at both spots, but other than that there is nothing to complain about! Thank you to everyone who made the trip great, especially Jon.

Absolutely loved this tour and have already recommended it to other people. My husband and I live in Barcelona and as our close friend was visiting from the UK, we wanted to organise something special for her stay. This tour proved the perfect option. Our guide Pol was really impressive, humorous, and insightful on so many things, from the history of Barcelona, to the details of the monastery, and the wine-tasting course.

We enjoyed every moment of all the different parts of the day and would definitely recommend Castle Experience to anyone visiting Barcelona who is interested in history, hiking or wine-tasting!

This tour was recommended to us and we loved it! We were on a luxury coach up to the train. Train was great. Coach transfer to the winery was not so good, older coach with no air conditioning. Coach transfer back to Barcelona was good. Winery tasting tapas were good. Not the best wines. Glass pours for additional money were available. Loved the tour of Montserrat and the extra time to hike/explore.

Starting with the tour guides, they were all a joy to be around and very knowledgeable of the area. When we got to Montserrat, the views were breathtaking. A full day tour is required for those who need more time to visit both available hiking trail or those wanting to stop on either path. It’s still nice to just walk about half way up the path to the cross and just stop to enjoy the view. Also, try the cheeses available there! When you get to the winery, it’s a beautiful old family castle that you can walk around. The wines there are delicious and are available to buy at fairly reasonable prices after the tour is over. Overall, the tour was very enjoyable. The only complaint I have is that I didn’t choose to take a longer tour and that’s just because I enjoyed it so much I didn’t want it to end!

Please please please please book this trip! I was hesitant and booked the morning of and I am so glad that I did! David was so fun, knowledgeable and made our small group feel like family. He did such a good job at making us comfortable that some of us from our group went and had drinks afterwards (and followed his recommendations for places to go). We all sat around together and commented on how happy we were with our trip and how excellent David was.
As a solo traveler who tours the world and goes on these trips, please please please book the tour!

A great day trip led by our excellent guide Marcel. He was really knowledgeable and approachable throughout the tour and gave lots of little extra recommendations. You could tell he wasn't reading a script and enjoyed what he was doing; tour guides like this make the whole experience even better.

Montserrat is well worth a visit. The cogwheel train upto the monastery is pretty unique and the monastery itself is stunning. The hour free time between the main tour and the vineyard was about right. I would have maybe liked to have investigated going even higher up the mountain, but would have needed more time.

Make sure you try the liqors and sweetbreads from the botega, you won't regret it, and the goat's cheese available at the market is like no goat's cheese I've tried before.

Not usually a couple for booking group tours, we reluctantly booked this one to escape the hustle and bustle of the city for a day. It turned out to be a fantastic day!

The tour was well organised and went smoothly.

The sites are excellent.

The view at Monserrat is outstanding and the food/wine at the Vineyard was delicious.

Special mention for our tour guide Marta who was excellent. Friendly, knowledgable and funny.

I’m not the type of person that loves a guided tour but that has changed since coming to Barcelona. Anays was full of energy and had knowledge surrounding wines, history of Montserrat that I didn’t know at all. Would 100% recommend this for anyone coming to Barcelona.

This was a very fun trip. We really enjoyed the history, architecture, and views at Montserrat; and the winery was a fun stop. Our tour guide, Mariana, was excellent! She was very knowledgeable about Barcelona, history of Catalonia, Montserrat, local cultural & customs, and the wines we sampled. She did an excellent job with our group.
We are glad we did this excursion our few days in Barcelona.

Our guides were knowledgeable and fun, creating a welcoming atmosphere. The monastery grounds, high in the jagged mountains provided a grand view & we managed to see some master artist gems tucked away in the museum there.

The wine tasting & tapas were a nice treat after walking the monastery grounds. Worth the day trip & price!

Full day. The Mountain and monastery are beautiful. A little cold this morning in March (10 degrees cooler than Barcelona). The basilica and statue of the Black Madonna were worth the trip. We had some free time and spent it at the art museum which had a very impressive collection. You can also spend time exploring outside and hiking around. Then we went to a winery and had delicious tapas and learned about the local produced on sight. Reminiscent of lovely California wine country. Our guide was very nice and knowledgeable. Would highly recommend.

This trip is everything you need for a few hours away from Barcelona. Montserrat is beautiful and full of history and Max our guide gave you all you needed without it been a long drawn out bore. Max is from theCatalan area and really made the trip and when we tasted the local Catalunyan wines he again showed his passion and knowledge of the region.Would really recommend this trip for seeing the area and value for money.

We had a wonderful time! The scenery was spectacular, the Basilica was incredible, all of the wines in the winery were terrific. I can’t speak highly enough about how fantastic Violeta was as our guide. She taught us so much, managed our group (there was one physically challenged person in the group), and gets an A+ rating.

It was an amazing experience. Montserrat is full of natural beauty and interesting religious history. Don’t miss the Museum of Montserrat which has paintings of El Greco, Picasso, Dali, Monet etc.
The highlight of the tour was Oller del Mas, a vineyard and winery established almost 1000 years ago and run continuously for 36 generations. At the winery you will feel like you’ve been time travelled back to the medieval ages of Spain.
Special thanks to our excellent guide, Merak!

Our tour guide Anays was FANTASTIC! Deeply informed and bubbly, full of exciting facts and pertinent knowledge of the Monastery, its offerings, but also about the winery we visited and the wine therein. She taught me personally how to really "taste" and appreciate wine in a way that was not at all pretentious (and that I previously thought goofy and performative but no longer!), and was a joy to be on the tour.

I was able to hike to the top of the funicular railway at Montserrat and that was such a joy to me personally I cannot adequately express my gratitude to Anays for facilitating. My partner was able to shop and enjoy the sights around the monastery while I shot up the mountains for a once in a lifetime view. Heartily recommend this tour if you're in the area!

Terrific experience….with only one suggestion. The tour was excellent with a very helpful guide and incredible views at Montserrat, especially if you walk to the cross of St. Michael!! Wine tasting was also terrific - the food and the wine. However, if you go to Oller Del Mas vineyard, do NOT bother with the so called “orange wine”. It is expensive and has no taste at all (8 wine drinkers in my group agreed). However the whites and reds served with lunch were quite good - stick with those if you do additional tasting after lunch. Cheers!

This was a really nice way to experience Montserrat. We were very lucky to have Aina as our tour guide as she was very knowledgeable and helpful. You could tell she had passion for the history of the area as well as the wines of Spain. Since we visited the area during off season it was quiet which meant there were no lineups to view the Black Madonna and we ended up with an extra 40 minutes of free time on top of the regular 30 minutes. This gave us time to view the art museum and do the liquor tasting - both highly recommended! The winery was beautiful and the cold tapas lunch was really lovely. Definitely would recommend this tour!

Oh boy was this an amazing tour! From start to finish, we had a great time. Everything ran smoothly. The bus was super comfortable, we siesta on the way there and back. The tour of the Montserrat was fantastic and we really liked all the stories/facts. It was a good balance of guided tour and free time. We were given recommendations on what we can do on our free time, we chose to hike to the cross and it was well worth it, the view was incredible. The wine tasting was fun and relaxing. We learned so much about catalan culture and Barcelona throughout our tour thanks to our guide Merak. He was the BEST. He made this trip one to be remembered, he went above and beyond for everyone in the group and made sure we were smiling from ear to ear!

Thoroughly enjoyed this trip, A well organized very informative tour with our excellent guide Pol. Would recommend this to anyone amazing views and scenery, done in a very relaxing way and toped off by a genuine tapas and wine experience at the oller del mars winery. Highly recommend this trip

Toni was incredible! We really enjoyed his concise and interesting stories about Barcelona, Catalonia, the Black Madonna, and the winery - he had some nice wine recommendations. We found him to be a helpful guide for both the tour and our experience in the city more generally.

I was happily surprised we visited such an old winery - it was established in AD 994 or so.

We lucked out with excellent weather, only 84 F.

The views at Montserrat were beautiful and there were many great products on display, so it was easy to knock out some shopping for gifts for family and friends.

Overall my spouse and I are very happy we included this tour in our 6 days in Barcelona.

My husband and I were in Barcelona in December 2019 and we spent one day on this tour of Montserrat and having a wine tasting. We had a great guide named Rubi. Rubi was knowledgeable, funny, and entertaining. We are not religious and the part of the tour to Montserrat was to a beautiful location; however, the monastery seemed very superficial and just commercialized so we were a little disappointed. During the tour, we had about 1.5-2 hours to experience Montserrat on our own and we took the funicular to near the top of the mountain and hiked around up there which was fun. There were great views of surrounding valleys and you can see the Mediterranean. The next part of the tour was to the Oller del Mas winery which was a beautiful place and had delicious tapas and wine. The winery was our favorite part of the tour. Both Montserrat and the winery are about 1 hour from Barcelona. The driving portion of the tour was on a large but very comfortable tour bus. The road to Montserrat is pretty windy, especially on a large bus, so be sure to take medication if you tend to get car sick. Because the wine/taps is not until around 2pm, it's a good idea to bring some snacks to hold you over. We give this tour 4 stars and not 5 because of our disappointment with Montserrat; every other aspect of the tour was great! This tour is also a great option if you're looking to escape the city for a day.

This tour was definitely a worthwhile experience. Our tour guide was Sergio, who was not only knowledgeable about the city of Barcelona and its wines, but made the tour interactive and lively. We would definitely come again to relive all the great moments!

The meet up location(near Hard Rock Cafe) was easy to get to. An on-time departure allowed our group to get to the monastery in time to see the Black Madonna up close. Our guide Toni was friendly, pleasant and offered many suggestions for things to do during our free time. Including, visiting the farmers market to try many samples of wonderful, local cheeses. At the winery, Toni took a group picture which was a nice remembrance. I really appreciated that our bus load of people were divided up into small groups. Thank you Toni for a great experience.

This was a perfect tour to combine a lot things into one great experience. Our guide was Edu, and he was so knowledgeable and fun to hang out with for the day. It's obvious he knows and loves the region as well as sharing his life/culture with you! The views and history knowledge combined made for a trip that anyone would enjoy. The wine tasting and tapas were obviously also a plus! Highly recommend.

We had a fantastic tour with Marcel, who made us and the rest of the group feel at ease. Although there is never enough time to do everything, Marcel provided a great number of options after the initial tour and we chose the arduos, but rewarding hike up to the cross; a trip well worth it for the views of Montserrat and surrounding area. The follow on visit to Oller del MAS for wine and tapas was equally enjoyable: only regret was winery didn't have wine glasses with their logo for sale...as a collector of these, was disappointed a bit, but overall, the whole trip was exceptional and Marcel, with the other staff of Nadia, Javier and Jorge ( who got us there and back safely), made the trip well worth it...job well done!

We just finished our tour and I wanted to write this review quickly while everything is fresh in my mind. We enjoyed every moment of the tour from beginning to end. Our tour guide Daniel was incredibly knowledgeable about the history of Spain and of course the specific history of the region we were in. You can tell he’s passionate about history and his storytelling is compelling. To be fair all of the guides at some point contributed historical/anecdotal information during the tour. It’s April now and it was pretty chilly in the mountains so dress in layers because the temperature near the vineyard is warmer. This was a wonderful excursion that incorporated history, relaxation and wine.

We had a great time on the tour. A bit of history explained on the bus and a tour of the monastery followed by an hour of free time to explore whatever part of Montserrat we wanted. Toni provided great suggestions. Then we went to the Oller del Mas winery. I loved having the tapas and tasting in the private room in the castle. Very unique experience. Toni explained the three wines we tasted, which was helpful. We had a bit of free time here as well. Overall great tour with a great guide!

I heard that I HAD to see Montserrat and while I am a city dweller and city liver, I am also a theologians daughter and wanted to see more of the mystery of the mountain that is so important to the region I was visiting. This tour did not disappoint! It's one of many options, but the guides were so well informed and well choreographed, I felt like I couldn't have made a better choice.

We had both a tour of the grounds of Montserrat and ample time to explore on our own as well. I managed to get a quick hike in and have some lovely quiet contemplation as the fog began to lift. Our tour guide made excellent suggestions for sights to see and even recommended visiting the farmers market that sets up right outside the basilica, so I was able to get some local honey and cheese as well!

Then we had an excellent wine tasting and history lesson at a vineyard older than this American can consider realistically! Founded in the 900s?! Amazing. We got to literally taste history - 3 glasses worth- and have some tapas. I learned a lot about the wines on this vineyard, and also fun facts like why they have donkeys (extra triple treat, getting to watch a donkey roll around on the grass like a puppy, five stars!) overlooking the grapes. I have been to a bunch of tastings (by no means an expert, I just like them) and still learned so much!

I mentioned the tour guides-they also give really good (and funny!) commentary on the bus back and forth to Barcelona, and I could listen to them talk about Catalunyan history all day. A great highlight of my trip. The only downside was that my mind was so blown, I wasn't the best guest for dinner later! I was still contemplating the experience. For me, that's a huge bonus. Could not recommend more.

Toni was our tour guide for a magical day at Montserrat and the Oller del Mas vineyard! Toni was incredibly charming and very knowledgeable about Montserrat in particular, general Spanish history, and told us all sorts of fun historical facts and legends. At Monserrat, he also gave us plenty of recommendations on what we could do during our allotted free time. Then at the vineyard, Toni led our tapas lunch and wine tasting - he was so knowledgeable about the wines and the vineyard's history, you would think he was a master winemaker himself! All in all, we had a fantastic time on the tour - and afterwards, Toni even gave us recommendations for bars and restaurants for us to enjoy during our stay in Barcelona. I would highly recommend taking this tour with Castleexperience, and hope you get Toni as your guide!

The experience was great! There were a lot of people on the bus, but they broke us up into smaller more manageable groups with our own guide. Toni was the best at answering our questions and providing enthusiasm during the tour. He gave us options for our free time in Montserrat and helped with timing. The wine portion was good and more of an intimate experience.

This tour is a must if you visit Barcelona. Our tour guide Aurora was super funny, awesome, knowledgeable, and overall great to be around.
Definitely would recommend to anyone looking to spend a fun day outside of Barcelona, learning about history of Montserrat monastery and sipping on delicious local organic wine.

Our tour guide, Merak was an awesome guide. Very knowledgable, great suggestions for free time, and upbeat! All three guides took turns speaking on the bus ride and were great too. The winery and food was well done. Only negatives: castlexperience a bit hard to find in the bus station and the group of 22 was too large (advertised as a max of 18-20).

An amazing journey from start to finish.

Finding the tour office at Barcelona Nord was easy and the check-in process was fast and fuss free. Meeting Gus, probably the coolest, laid back guide who simply took us on an adventure to Montserrat. Gus, was knowledgeable, full of humour, and always knew when to dish out fast facts and jokes to keep the atmosphere going.

The tour at Montserrat was awesome and humbling. Getting fast track access into the Basilica and seeing the Black Madonna from a distance was such a humbling affair. Hearing the origins and history was an enriching experience.

The wine tour at Oiler de Mars was just as rewarding. Hearing the history of the Oiler family and their passion for great wines, and also tasting great wines with a very presentable plate of tapas rounded up the tour with a flourish.

The tour took no more than 7 hours and we were back at Barcelona Nord by half past 3 in the afternoon. Very recommended tour for those with a thirst of history and wines!

We had a LOVELY guide Anays who was animated, passionate, knowledgeable about her job and humorous all which made this experience fly by so quickly, I wish it were longer. We had a great time exploring Montserrat (tho it did feel a little short cuz we were enjoying ourselves so much), and just wish we had a little more time to explore! Still, it was interesting learning more abt Barcelona’s history and getting a glimpse into a winery and wine appreciation. Would do it over again in a heartbeat, as u can tell by my essay. Once again a shoutout to Anays. I’ve been on many walking tours. She’s been one of my favourite and best guides so far.

We loved this to trip. Nerea was wonderful. She knew so much about the history of Montserrat. I also loved she included her personal family history about what they did in Montserrat.
The tour was fabulous and I was grateful that Nerea shared what her family did.
The wine part of the tour was great as well. Nerea spent time explaining about the different wine and we discussed the various flavours we could taste. Lots of fun. Would definitely recommend this tour

Great tour with really friendly, young and funny tour guides. I felt we really learned a lot of interesting things about the areas we visited but without it being too much. It was just right. The mountain area itself is lovely and you get free time on the tour enough to walk to the cross which is a lovely walk with great views. Then down to the winery which was really beautiful and quiet with vineyards and views of the mountain. We think this is a great idea for anyone, myself and partner are mid/late 20s and really enjoyed it a lot, despite not really being the type to do organised tours, we both liked it a lot. The transport is easy enough and comfortable from near arc de triomph at the bus station, which you can get to from the metro with ease. The tapas was really tasty as was the wine. They accommodate for all food allergies, just let them know as they ask you when you arrive at the bus station. I got gluten free tapas with no issues and it was really nice. Shout out to our tour guide Ursula for great information and friendliness throughout. Really nice day out and would recommend to all ages (+18!) minimal photos added as you should really see it for yourself :-).

Merak was the best tour guide we have ever had whilst touring in Europe. He was extremely knowledgeable about the region and taugut us so much during our wine tasting. He was very attentive to our group and brought us all together for conversation. We had such a great time and know we booked the best tour with the best guide in Barcelona! Thanks Merak! Gracias!

We had such a wonderful time! Anays was awesome! The experience itself was great, easy transportation, and just the right amount of time at the monastery and at the winery. Anays made everything fun and interesting and was always thoughtful about little details, like getting good seats on the bus or getting into the basilica at the optimum time. She was so friendly and really made it such a fun trip! The winery was a very nice experience too. The tapas were very good and it was fun to learn about the different wines. Overall a great trip and very much worth it!

The trip to Montserrat was very winding and frankly I was glad there was fog because I think the drop off would have scared me if I could have seen it. Our guide, David, was very informative and shared interesting tidbits with us and kept us together like his "family". It would be best not to visit on the weekend because it was quite crowded. I would have had to wait in a line worse than Disney to see the Black Madonna. The trip to the winery was not so scary ( Can't tell you why that was.) We visited "the potter's winery" (can't remember the real name). The tapas they served was quite good and there was plenty. There were three different wines to taste. These tastings are not like the tastings I've had in Napa where it's an inch per glass. These were full glass samples and many of the group had more than the single glass. The bus was large and comfortable.

Perfect day from start to finish! Easy to book, found the tour guides easily, bus was brand new and air conditioned. We had tour guide David who was exceptional - his knowledge of history and wine was top notch and he was so respectful of the covid protocols which made us feel very safe. Winery was spectacular - all new with a superb selection. Tapas was delightful. I saw another review saying they were left hungry…I wouldn’t say that. Plenty for me. Great value for the money.

Our tour and guide was absolutely wonderful! Montserrat was one of the highlights of our trip and we did get to see the boys choir which was fantastic. Montser our tour guide, was great as well giving tips of things to do and try (Catalan bread and cheese) at Montserrat.
Highly recommend!

What a soulful experience! Beautiful mountains, there’s a small hike to see the cross or you have time to walk about Montserrat small village and get cheeses, tastings, coque bread and much more! Nuria was our guide and came highly recommended and we know why- her knowledge of history in the region and her passion for Spain was evident in her tour. The monastery was amazing and we got to see the black Madonna which is truly a spiritual experience and one in a lifetime. In the afternoon we drove down to Oller vineyard and had tapas and wine tastings in the castle. The family there was so nice and the history was very rich with stories. We came home with a bottle of a very special wine from the Vineyard and cheese from the local market with bread so we could relive the moment that that night! Highly recommend and ask for Nuria!

We had an amazing time during our tour to Montserrat. Everything was well organized and managed, the ambiance was nice and funny, the guides were very informative and knowledgeable. Very good idea to break-down all visitors into smaller groups, it felt more relaxed and personal. Particular thanks to our guide David who was very funny and excited about sharing his knowledge and experience with us, also sharing the catalan culture and funny stories. He also gave us a lot of tips on the souvenirs (liquour, local food, wines). It was really interesting!
The place itself is impressive and beautiful! What a view from the Mount Montserrat! Also we enjoyed a lot the winery - nice place, nice tapas lunch and tasty wine dégustation!
Totally worth it and definitely recommend it!

We had a wonderful day at Montserrat followed by delicious tapas and wine. Transportation was timely, clean and efficient. Our guide, Toni, was fun, well-informed and gave us excellent suggestions on how to make the best use of our time at the monastery. The Oller del Mas Winery was spectacular, Toni was very knowledgeable and clearly loves his job. It was a great day that we would highly recommend to other friends and family!

Anays was an excellent tour guide! She was personable and funny - definitely appreciate her extensive wine knowledge. Highly recommend the half-day express tour for those who want to get back to Barcelona for a siesta and evening activities. We felt this was just the right amount of time in Monserrat to take in the views and see the church. I wish we had maybe 30-45 more minutes at the winery. Enjoying the tasting outside (if shade was available) instead of in the tasting room would have been nice. Loved the guides giving us commentary on what we were seeing as we drove to and from Barcelona! Highly recommend this tour.

We are thrilled with our recent experience with our tour to Monserrat and Oller Del Mas Winery. The tour was well organized and coordinated! We were split into various groups of 16, which was a perfect size for managing our tour. Monserrat was simply amazing! Our guide Aurora was the gem who not only made the tour interesting BUT she’s very funny and offered so much insight on the history and culture of Barcelona, Monserrat and Oller Del Mas Winery. The tour wrapped up at the awesome Oller Del Mas Winery. The tapas was delicious as were the three wines. The bus ride was comfortable and the guides were well versed and so accommodating. This tour is not to be missed! Delightful way to tour Monserrat!

We had a great time on this tour of Montserrat as well as a small family-owned vineyard nearby. The highlight of the trip was without a doubt our tour guide, Anays, who filled our tour interesting and engaging history of Barcelona, Montserrat, and the vineyard. This was our first time on a vineyard tour and we were so glad she kept it informal and super engaging. We learned so much from her, and helped us enjoy Montserrat to the fullest!

It surpassed my expectations - I’d definitely do another tour with this company - Marta, our guide, was amazing. I’ve done many tours on holiday with friends and family in the past, some good, and some lacking, and I was sceptical about giving up a day in Barcelona for this, but I’m so pleased I did. Monserrat was stunning and it was lovely to be in the mountains after the hustle and bustle of Barcelona (although as a Londoner I love a city, it’s good to have the chance to venture beyond). Monserrat itself was beautiful and interesting, and the vineyard and wines were great. I was very happy with the vegetarian tapas too and to hear the tour company had pushed to improve this - its very appreciated. Marta, I had a lovely day and hope I get to do another tour with you in the future!

Really enjoyed this tour. Montserrat was beautiful and it was great to get there early to beat the crowds. I especially loved the winery after. The history of the family ownership was incredible and our guide Violeta (@violetawinetour) was great in her explanation of what we were trying and the information on this region of wine.

From the introduction, Miss Mariana Lopez was a gem! She made sure that all her group was all well.
Her running commentary were fun and informative.
Montserrat is beautiful, and thanks to Mariana’s insight, we were able to gat the most beautiful pictures. As you go towards the church, look to your left at the entrance of the museum… the girl in the painting and Mariana have quite the resemblance! Her explanation at the winery about the history of the winery and the vinicultures was , again, fun and informative. The winery was beautiful, the tapas were great and the wine was very good,

A very good tour, even if you are not crazy about wine!

This was a super fun tour. It was very well organized and right on time. The combination of the tapas and wine with Montserrat was perfect. After touring the cathedral, seeing the black madonna, and a couple other areas, we had an hour of free time at the top of Montserrat. We chose to hike to the beautiful cross on the hill (one other option was to go to the museum which also looked amazing). Following that, we drove down the windy road to the winery. The tapas and wine were a nice finish to our day and we arrived back in Barcelona at 3:30 pm. The guides gave a nice overview of the history of Barcelona and Montserrat. We learned so much, including how wine was fermented in clay pots back in the day. Our guide, Pol, was an intelligent and kind young man who interlaced some of his own heritage into the tour. It was great to learn his perspective of the region from a local. We loved Pol and highly recommend this tour.

Tour was amazing. I actually thought Montserrat was going to be a bit underwhelming but I was obviously very wrong. Everything came promptly and it was a very breathtaking trip for myself

Our tour guide, Sergio, was amazing, extremely knowledgeable, welcoming and friendly as well.

Overall, no complaints about the planned trip - although I wish it wasn’t so cold, but that’s nobody’s fault. I was very impressed at how prompt our plan was and how on time we were. Many tours I’ve been on are always late, so this was refreshing.

Well done.

The coach journey was good and we were given some interesting history of Spain on the journey. The Montserrat Monastery was beautiful and well worth seeing as was the amazing scenery. We went to the Art Museum on site and enjoyed the experience. At the wine tasting nearby we were offered a nice selection of tapas and different wines. One white and two red. Our guide Merak was really good explaining how to do the wine tasting and was always very amusing as well as informative. My husband and I both thought it was a really good half day trip and good value for money.

Anays was an amazing tour guide!! we had so much fun, and truly enjoyed the day we spent learning all about the amazing history and culture with her. We all really appreciated hearing about catalan, and the monastery, but also about wine at the winery!! We enjoyed some of the best wine EVER and sooo wish we could order some more to the UK. Thanks so much for this amazing tour, would recommend to anyone who likes history, wine and nature! We would absolutely recommend this tour. Thanks!

This is a great tour! Our tour guide Merak was extremely personable and knowledgeable, we enjoyed his company throughout the day. Some tours seem to go on forever but this one was the perfect length where we saw everything and didn’t feel rushed or bored at any moment. Highly recommend!

The only complaint I had was the weather at Montserrat - foggy, cold, rainy. The weather was through no fault their own - Rubi, our tour guide, was wonderful! Rubi was very informative of the history of Montserrat and the winery we went to after, he made the day great despite the weather. This tour is perfect because it combines half a day at the Montserrat and a couple of hours at a small castle winery. Would highly recommend!

My partner and I had an absolutely amazing time on this tour, thanks in large part to our guide Aurora and the other tour leaders who were with us. The tour was timed perfectly with minimal time in transit and maximum time to explore and enjoy. Even the transit (which is often the most boring part) was fun with lots of information by the guides and great views headed up to Montserrat. The time in Montserrat was beautiful -- some of the best views I've seen in a long time looking from the top of the mountains, and so much to do up there whether you're into hiking, shopping or drinking (or all of the above). The winery Oller del Mas was fantastic too, the wines were great and unique and we definitely walked away with a bottle. The highlight of the tour was definitely the guides though, with special credit to Aurora, who was perhaps the funniest, warmest tour guide we'd ever experienced. You're lucky if you get to take a trip with this group!

We are a family of 4 (2 adults, 2 kids ages 10 and 12) that did the 7 hour day trip from Barcelona. We had a great day and would definitely recommend this tour! It was easy to find the meeting place and we had a nice balance of free time to explore independently and guided tour with explanations. We were with Merak and he was excellent! Very engaging guide, lots of interesting information and he made it a fun experience. We were the only people on the tour with kids but they also enjoyed it and didn’t feel out of place. The tapas and wine tasting was great, beautiful spot.

Thanks for a great day!

Highly recommend if you are visiting Barcelona! My wife and I went here on a day trip (half-day tour). The trip left around 9:30a from Barcelona Nord and got back around 5:00p. The transportation was very easy and comfortable. It was about an hour bus tour with excellent commentary from a guide named Pol. Our guide for the day was Montse - she was fantastic! Highly recommend her! She was the nicest person, extremely knowledgeable and passionate about what she does, and very catering to our group. She took care of us very well. She was an excellent host. The winery tour/tasting and tapas lunch were just as great as visiting Montserrat. Highly, highly recommend this tour and Montse if you can request a guide!

An excellent experience. Traveled on a luxury, air-conditioned coach. Our host, Violeta, made us feel so welcome and gave us loads of information along the journey and at the monastery/winery. She was very knowledgeable, kept it light hearted, with personal touches, and interesting. Violeta gave us tips of what to look out for and when different events were happening in our own time there.
I'm so glad I decided to take this tour, it was very well worth it. If I could go again I would make it a full day instead of a half, in order to experience the complete wine tour half. Our brief wine taste was delicious!
Masks were required on the coach and train but not the other areas.

Mariana our tour guide was awesome! She is very knowledgeable and explained the history of Montserrat thoroughly. We really enjoyed the tour and we highly recommend this tour if you’re going to Barcelona. FYI- free tasting wines and tapas were delicious!

We had an absolutely amazing time at Monserrat and Oller de Mas! Our tour guide Edu was extremely informative and gave us so many interesting facts about the places we were visiting. Victor was also extremely helpful with booking and planning for our group. We were traveling to Barcelona for my sister’s wedding and were a large group and both Edu and Victor truly went above and beyond to accommodate us and made our experience the best!

My girlfriend and I joined this tour last Saturday (9/18) and had a great time! Definitely a 10/10 experience, which was largely thanks to our awesome tour guide Toni. Toni was very knowledgeable, funny, and helpful throughout the day. He gave us an amazing yet concise history of Barcelona, recommended the best activities while at Montserrat, and kept the overall atmosphere light and fun for everyone on the tour.
Thanks to Toni and the CastleExperience wine tours team, we had a wonderful time on our first visit to Montserrat as well as a lot of fun on our wine tasting tour afterwards (winery had great wines, views, and history btw!).

Muchas gracias Toni and the Castle Experience wine tours team!

This tour was really good. It was a very nice experience - everything has been very well organized and punctual.
Ana was an amazing guide- Kind and sweet,always there for us, we were very lucky to be in her team, her "family" as she called us.
She knew a lot about the places and shared the information with us in a very gentle way, without having to say too much or trying to impress. She was also very good at the wine tasting - really knew a lot about wine!

Overall, it has been a really nice experience. I would be happy to do this tour again sometime in the future.

Violeta, our guide, was great. She was so good at presenting the information about the monastery and winery. She has great comedic timing. She kept everything moving in a very efficient manner. We really enjoyed all her recommendations. 10/10 for us. Both the monastery and winery are worth adding to your list of stops in Spain. At the monastery we enjoyed hiking to St. Michaels cross and sampling amazing, local cheeses at the pop up market. At the winery, we enjoyed hearing the history of the Oller family and grapes. So cool!

Our tour guide, Nuria, was terrific! We had a beautiful day but make sure to dress in layers as it was a bit chillier on Montserrat. As we drove (1 hour bus ride) we heard a bit of the history of Barcelona. Then had a nice tour and overview at Montserrat and we were treated to a performance of the boys choir. Then we went to a lovely historic biodynamic winery started in 924 A.D. Nuria told us all about the grape growing, harvesting, and wine production, then we had a tasting with some tapas. We arrived back about 5pm —wonderful day trip!

This was an amazing tour and we are thrilled we took it! We were checking out how to get to Montserrat, and it seemed complicated. I found this tour, and all I had to do was pay and show up at the bus station. Our tour guides were very knowledgeable, humorous, friendly and showed us a great day. Montserrat was beautiful, and we got some of the local alcohol and honey. Then we went to the winery for lunch and wine tasting. They accommodated our gluten free family members as well. I would highly recommend this tour. *if you get carsick, sit in the front of the bus. It is a very winding road up to Montserrat and a couple of us weren't feeling too great sitting in the back of the bus.

I highly recommend checking out this tour if you are visiting Barcelona. Our group originally signed up for the winery tour; we had no idea how awesome Montserrat would be! Anays was a great tour. We especially enjoyed her insight on tasting wine.

We had an absolutely fantastic tour with Edu. The entire day was very well planned and Edu was by far the best tour guide we experienced during our entire trip. We took over 10 tours while in Europe. Edu exceeded all the other 10 by a very large margin. His knowledge, passion and sense of humor made the day one we will never forget!

We rate Edu a 11 out of 10, as he exceeded all our expectations.
We rate Castle Experience a 10 out of 10.

My husband and I really enjoyed our tour to Montesarrat. The area is majestic and breath taking with great history. David, our Tour Guide was terrific...knowledgeable and passionate about his job. He gave us a wonderful orientation to the area with key highlights of the Monastery's history. We also had free time to walk around, explore and take in the natural beauty of this spectacular site on our own. The tour bus was very comfortable.

Everything was perfect and even exceed our expectations. The guide Anays is a real professional with deep knowledge about the history of Catalunya and a good sense of humor. She is really nice guide. Definitely recommend doing this route with her.
Best Regards!

The tour was AMAZING! Our guide Edu was fantastic - we loved the humor, fun facts and historical knowledge he provided during the day. Everything went smoothly and the tour was organized very well. Would absolutely recommend for anyone visiting Barcelona!

We had a great tour with Mariana! It is a full day but still feels like not enough time at these amazing place. Everything ran flawlessly. Mariana was very interesting and funny, she made sure we knew everything we needed to, but we were also given our own time in both locations, which was nice. Wine was genuinely excellent, Montserrat was stunning - all in all an excellent tour and an excellent tour company. Would recommend for anyone visiting Barcelona and wanting a lovely day outside of the city.

The tour was well organized and our guide - Loriane - was very knowledgeable, high energy, and friendly. Monteserrat is a unique experience and should be on everybody's list. Olle del Mar was a good selection for a winery. Wish we had more time at the wine bar to sample additional wines.

This was a great tour.Exceptional I give it 5 stars and a thumbs up.
Rubi was a great tour guide, welcome me and created a nice group were in everyone are lovely.He told me that i’ll be joining for a wine tour with Alex and introduce me.
Alex is very good in answering question about the wine tasting.Asked him about what popular beer in Barcelona and told me Estrella and tried it the Estrella Galicia.
They are both very good tour guide,friendly and amazing.
This is worth the price and recommend everyone to do this tour if your in Barcelona.

My group of four loved this tour! We were blessed with beautiful weather and the views from the mountain were incredible. Carol was an amazing guide. We really enjoyed spending the afternoon with her. My only advice is to sit at the front of the bus. The air conditioning did not work at the back of the bus and everyone was uncomfortable. Otherwise, great experience!

We arranged two private tours through CastleExperience during our visit to Barcelona last month for our family of 8. The first was a tour of Montserrat and a winery on Christmas Eve and the second was a customized tour day with visits to a winery, chocolate factory and a traditional Catalon lunch. We contacted four tour companies and decided on CastleExperience because they were responsive and were open to working with me to set up a personalized tour for our family. They were flexible with timing as we figured out our schedule, too. Our tour guide, Alex, was fantastic - sharing interesting information about the region and connecting with everyone in our group - from kids to grandparents. Every detail was taken care of and our tour days were two of our favorite days during our two week visit to Barcelona. I would highly recommend this company!

This tour is "a must" when visiting Barcelona. Montserrat is gorgeous, full of history, and of course amazing wine . Our tour guide, Pep, was amazing - extremely fun and engaging while helping us appreciate the history of the region and the beautiful country. And did I mention the amazing wine? You cannot go wrong.
