We loved this tour! Our guide Anays was amazing and had a great personality. Montserrat was absolutely beautiful and highly recommend anyone to see the monastery in the mountains. The winery we went to afterwards was equally as fun! Wine was good and the property was beautiful with the winery being over 1000 years old!

My friends and I had a great time on this day trip to Montserrat. Our guide, Nuria was very knowledgeable and provided historical context and lots of tips in a very engaging way. The scenery was gorgeous and the wine and tapas, delicious! Would highly recommend to everyone!

This was my favorite experience being in Spain so far. All of the guides on this tour were very knowledgable on the history of Barcelona which made for fun and interesting rides on the bus, which was air conditioned and lovely. As for Montserrat, the pictures do not do it justice. The hike to the cross is a must and the cheese at the farmer's market was incredible! I thought I had seen the best of it until arriving at the winery where you can see all of Montserrat while enjoying some amazing, organic wines. Toni had answers to all of my questions and I would 100% recommend him, and this tour to everyone!

This was the perfect day activity for me and my friends! Monserrat monastery was absolutely breathtaking. We were able to go inside the church, hiked up to the cross for the panoramic view of the mountains, lit candles in the hall of candles, and left with souvenirs of the liquors and chocolate. From there, we were taken to Oller de Mas vineyard, which was beautiful. We saw the production room where the wine is made, and tasted 3 of their delicious wines with tapas.

What made this trip even more worthwhile was our tour guide, Mariana. Mariana gave us so much information on the history of Catalonia, Montserrat, and the vineyard. She knew we were new to Barcelona, and told us all the best places we should check out. Our day would not have been nearly as good if it weren't for her!

We were pleasantly surprised with the entire tour. Monserrat was incredible and had breathtaking views. Our tour guide Edu was fantastic and always cracking jokes which made everything very fun and he was extremely informative about the history of Barcelona, Monserrat, and gave several tips and suggestions for what we could do for the rest of our vacation! 10/10 would recommend. Very organized and the sites alone are worth it.

Absolutely the best part of our trip to Spain. The monastery was absolutely breathtaking and our tour guide, Toni, was very knowledgable. We got around an hour of free time in Montserrat and Toni was able to give us so many recommendations on how to spend our time. Cheese was sooo good! Recommend this tour to everyone!

I did the half-day Monserrat/wine tour with these guys. I met the bus at Catalunya square. There was more than one tour meeting here and everybody takes the same bus to Monserrat then splits up into small groups. Everything was very organized. My group only had 7 people and Adrian was the guide. He was very friendly and informative. The tour consisted of a short introduction to Monserrat then an hour of free time to explore on your own. After that, we went to a winery for another short tour and a sit-down tasting of 3 different wines from the region with Tapas. There was enough food to consider it a light lunch. After that, we drove back to Barcelona and were back around 4 pm. Overall, I enjoyed this tour very much. It was a beautiful day at Monserrat and the amount of information/tour and free time were perfect to get a taste of the area. I would recommend this tour.

Toni was an awesome tour guide! The bus ride up to Montserrat provided very informative information on the history of Barcelona which was good to know. Once in Montserrat Toni provided things to do during our free time which was really nice after a quick walk through of the town. Farmers market of the local cheese was fantastic and do not leave there with out trying the monk made sweet bread! Once at the winery Toni provided great information on how the wine was barreled and history of the winery! Fantastic tour! Highly recommend!

Jon was a great tour guide. He was quite knowledgeable in many areas. He was interesting and funny. He kept the tour light with his jokes. He gave us options and good recommendations. When given the choice to explore on our own or stay with him we chose to stay with him to hear his knowledge about Montserrat. We appreciated his knowledge on the wine were served. He made us feel comfortable and welcomed. The bus was comfortable and the other tour guides gave us much information on Barcelona. The tour ran on time as scheduled.

honestly, edu is the best guide i've ever had on one of these tours. it's a standard tour as you'd expect but edu was engaged, super approachable, funny and shared stories both personal and historical. absolutely top bloke. cross your fingers that he's your guide. the tour itself is lovely too.

This is a wonderful trip.

The meeting point was easy to locate. It's Hard Rock Cafe at the main Catalonia square. Cannot miss it.

Our guide was David. Once we were on the bus, the 5 guides took turns to offer us the history of Barcelona and Montserrat. It's both entertaining and informative.

It was a cold day. The monastery was not crowded and the queue to the altar was short. The views were wonderful.

We then had a tapas lunch with wine. We did not take the lunch option.

Highly recommended

Being at Montserrat was wonderful in itself. We had spent a lot of sightseeing in Barcelona and it was nice to get out in te country. The veisw were fantastic. Our guide, Mariana was very knowledgeable and Made the wine tasting much more interesting. We even got to meet the owner, whose family had owned the land for overa thousand years.

We booked this trip the day before just to get out of Barcelona for the day. It was so worth it!!! Easy meeting place. The guides are all super friendly and speak perfect English. Merak was our guide and he was amazing! So knowledgeable, friendly and entertaining. The monastery was beautiful and if you take the path up to the cross the views are spectacular. It’s a hike though! The wine tasting was also delicious and the tapas were perfect. I’m a vegetarian and they easily accommodated me along with several vegan guests as well. Overall, great trip!

Anays was amazing. Her ability to navigate us to suit our individuals dual interests was excellent. Her expertise and knowledge saved me hours had I tried to navigate Monserrat independently. I was able to enjoy walking, indulged huge amazing cottage cheese & honey from the local farmers’ market, view the cathedral, learn about the Jesuit history& Catalan history, then escape down the mountain for wine education and tapas👏. My last day in Spain - what a crescendo !

We enjoyed our sunday tour to montserrat and wine tasting. The weather was exelent and the Montserrat and vineyard was beautiful. We could have stayed even longer. The tour guides were really friendy and fun. Our guide Daniel told interesting storys about Barcelona, their traditions and added his own storys in to it. We recoment this trip higly!

we arrive early in begin our voyage out to montserrat, we are split into groups our tour guide man was max. so informative on modern history of barcelona as well as ancient history of montserrat. the day flew by but you learn so much and there was never a wasted moment. very good highly recommend.

This tour was not what we expected. We booked well in advance, and things changed, but we were not told about the changes until the last minute. Reservations were needed for some things at the monastery. As a result we were given only five minutes to see the monastery before being given our free time. Since seeing the monastery was our main reason for taking this tour, we were very disappointed.

Nuria was our guide, and she was wonderful. She did everything possible to improve the experience for us. She even accompanied us back to the monastery during our free time to see if we could enter again.

The ride to Monserrat was beautiful. The views were spectacular. The village that has grown up around the monastery and basilica within a National Park was interesting to explore during free time. The wine tasting and typical lunch was well organized and informative. It is a good tour if your primary interest is the wine tasting and not the monastery of Monserrat.

The tour was excellent from start to finish. Pep our tour guide was absolutely fantastic, he was very informative, knowledgeable and very nice. He gave his personal preferences with wine and also the best place for photos at Montserrat.
Montserrat itself was beautiful, and the travel there was easy in well air conditioned transport (on a very hot day).
The wine tour was excellent, and the wines to taste were very good, and were a reasonable price to buy at the end.
Would highly recommend as a day out.

What a fun day! This is a great way to visit Montserrat, which is very worthwhile to see. The scenery, the monastery, the views were all great. The visit to the castle afterwards for wine and tapas was also a lot of fun. Our guide Marcus was great - really nice guy who clearly loves talking about history (he was a history teacher) and had lots of stories and insights to share.

The trip was so great, lots of fun, we enjoyed it very much. Our tour guide Mariana Lopez demonstrated her solid knowledge on the history of Barcelona, Catalonia and Montserrat. Great tour and tour guide 👍🏻👍🏻

The whole experience was amazing. The ride was great. The beautiful place, the wine tasting very good. And the guide Daniel is great, super funny, and he taught us a lot about the history of the place. He spoke Spanish to me, English to most members of the group, and Portuguese to a few people in the group

Enjoyed every second of the tour. The staff was very helpful and dedicated to the comfort. The tour guides were very much knowledgeable and we lived Toni's explanations on the way. It was well planned and would recommend this tour to anyone

Victor was a brilliant guide as he both explained to us the history of Montserrat and gave plenty of advice on places to see, things to eat and things to avoid. He always had a smile on his face and was super friendly throughout the trip. Recommended.

This is a tour not to be missed. We had an awesome guide in Edu. Edu was funny, entertaining, caring and knowledgeable. The Montserrat Monastery, followed by tapas and wine tasting was a perfect half day excursion. Definitely recommend this when in Barcelona!

David was an amazing host and of course witty and funny, even with his "awful voice." It was beautiful, the wine and food was great and learning the history of course was also amazing. Highly recomend.

Our tour was absolutely amazing! Pol was a fantastic guide - very knowledgeable and personable. In fact I learned so much that on the next tour I took, I already knew all the answers to the questions the guide asked! Montserrat is beautiful and worth the trip for the views alone. We felt like we had a good amount of time and did not feel rushed with the half day version. Overall,
I highly recommend and cross your fingers you get Pol! On your way out of Montserrat, don't forget to grab some sugar bread

Out trip was amazing!! Marta was great! We loved her sense of humor, personality, and knowledge of each location. It was great that we got some free time after the tour of each area to explore. Even though we booked the half day it was still very event filled! I would definitely book another trip with castle experience.

We enjoyed our tour to Montserrat and especially the wine tasting and tapas. It was definitely one of the most beautiful wineries I’ve been to and I’ve been to many. The tapas were very generous and accommodating to dietary restrictions which was appreciated! Aurora was a great tour guide and brought her extensive knowledge and sense of humor to the trip. Very comfortable bus to ride in as well - all in all the trip was very organized and enjoyable
We had the most amazing experience visiting Montserrat, our tour guide Nerea, shared so much knowledge and made the day extremely fun. Best day out of whole holiday. Can’t wait to go back!

This was an incredibly great experience and I highly recommend it! The drive up the mountain provided terrific scenery and the monastery is amazing. Our guide, Jon, was knowledgeable and sweet and was a great tour guide. We could’ve used a little more free time on Montserrat to explore some of the trails and do some cheese tasting from the locals but overall we had a wonderful time! The vineyard was a nice way to the end the tour so we could eat, drink and relax.

We had a wonderful time with our guide Pep on our tour! Pep was very knowledgeable and welcoming and gave helpful suggestions on how to spend our allocated free time. Everything went smoothly from the bus pickup in Barcelona to drop off that afternoon. I’d say this is a must-do for anyone with a free day in Barcelona!

We had a short stay in Barcelona prior to a cruise and was looking for an easy way to visit Monserrat. This tour was exactly what we wanted. We had a wonderful day! Edu, our guide, was very organized and informative. We enjoyed his positive spirit and funny jokes. It was a great itinerary as well. The pickup at the bus terminal was very easy to find although a bit of a walk from our hotel at Las Ramblas. We had enough time after the explanations to walk around the monastery on our own. The wine and tapas stop came at the perfect time when we were hungry and needed a rest. The wine, food, and conversation were so enjoyable! Also a great value. I would highly recommend this tour.

It was a fun, memorable and full knowledge to be in this tour. Toni being our tour guide did an amazing job by sharing phletora of knowledge regarding the history and culture of Barcelona. We enjoyed his company. He is full of energy and very enthusiastic! Good job for the over all tour.

Our tour guide, Edu, provided some very interesting history of the area, and was entertaining as well. However, the tour of Montserrat was not spectacular. I think it was not worth the amount of time we spent there. Also, I was not impressed by the wines.

This tour was amazing. The views of a monastery on top a mountain where you can taste local artisan cheeses or liquor made in the technique of ancient monks is unmatched. This, followed by some of the best wines and tapas I have had at a historical winery with a great story. David was our guide and he was incredible: funny, knowledgable, and a great time! 10/10 would recommend!

We had a great time during this tour! Our guide Toni was hilarious and had a great way of making everyone on the tour feel comfortable. The bus was nice and air conditioned and the driver drove safely. The monastery was beautiful and the winery was even older than the monastery by hundreds of years. Would recommend!

This was an outstanding tour, a complete pleasure from start to finish. It was well-organized and efficiently run, making it easy for us to simply enjoy the sights, history, food and wine. Our guide, Pol, has a broad and deep knowledge about the region, including its history, geography, local cuisine, politics, religion, and more. Not only that, but he has a great sense of humor and kept things entertaining as well. The visit to the monastery was truly one of the best experiences of our time in Barcelona. Later we enjoyed delicious food and wine at a simply beautiful winery, which included a tour of the vineyard and the cellar. Absolutely recommend this trip. Ask for Pol!

It was a great day. Our guide was Nerea. She was friendly, knowledgeable and personable.
We took a coach to the monastery at Montserrat and had a guided tour followed by a self guided tour. The scenery was beautiful.
Next, we loaded back on the coaches to head to the winery. The grounds were amazing. The tapas lunch was delicious. And of course, the wines were great.
Overall a great experience that I highly recommend.

This tour is highly recommended. The activities were not rushed and we had sufficient time to go around and explore the place. Food was delicious and the wines were not bad at all. Special shout out to our guide Merak who was quite knowledgable, very accommodating and was quite funny too. 👍👍👍

We enjoyed this tour immensely. It was very well organized and our guide Pep was perfectly informative and entertaining. Montserrat is a must see for anyone visiting Barcelona and this tour is a great way to experience it!

Definitely do this tour, a great break from the hustle and bustle of Barcelona, and gives a great.historicsl insight into Barcelona & catalonia. Anays was a great and knowledgeable tour guide, funny too!

Montserrat has lots to offer including nice cafes so no need to bring food, but bring water & sun cream (and a mask).

If I had one suggestion for improvement it would be to extend the day slightly, to allow a bit more time to enjoy the wine after the tasting & tapas!

Overall a great experience!

The transportation was seamless and Pep, our guide, was great. We enjoyed hearing all about Barcelona and its rich history from Aida on the bus (there were several small groups on the bus to start the day) and Pep gave is a great tour of Montserrat. Pep also made the vineyard stop a great learning experience as he was able share the history of the vineyard and a lot of background information on local wines and the winemaking process. I would highly recommend the tour!

Great tour with a chance to hear about and see the history of Barcelona and the Montserrat. The winery was beautiful and the tapas were delicious. We had an amazing guide Anays, she treats you like a best friend and gives you the insider's tips and treats. She made it that much better! Would recommend!

My wife and I were extremely pleased with the professionalism and knowledge of our Guide David. He treated all of his group as his "family". His knowledge of the local area history relating to the Basilica and the surrounding region was fun and informative. The bus ride was very pleasant and went by quickly with all the tour guides (multiple groups on the bus) shared interesting facts about the area we were driving through.

I would HIGHLY recommend this tour to anyone visiting Barcelona. You get to see the beauty of Montserrat and taste amazing wine all while learning so much. Our tour guide Max was so incredibly knowledgable about Catalan culture as well as wine. When touring Montserrat and driving through Barcelona he gave a thorough history which was super interesting and really makes visiting Montserrat so worth it. Then we went to this historic and beautiful winery where we learned SO much about how the wine was made and general information about tasting wines. I feel like I took so much away from the day and had a blast. Such a gem to do when visiting Barcelona! :)

My rating for the tour is 10!

My wife and I enjoyed the whole experience. Jordi was very personable and knowledgeable. As a native Catalonian, he shared his personal experience as well as the rich history of the Benedictine Monastery in Montserrat. We especially enjoyed the winery tour and it was a great way to wind down from the day tour. I highly recommend it!

We had a fabulous experience on this half-day tour! We had Edu as our tour guide and he was great - very funny, personable, and knowledgeable. We were on our honeymoon and the experience was so special to be able to see and tour Montserrat followed by the tapas and wine at a lovely winery. Would highly recommend this tour!

The entire experience was great. The guys were knowledgeable, friendly, and very accommodating. They gave a brief history of Barcelona on the way to the monastery. They kept everyone entertained with their stories and sense of humor. The winery was excellent and the lunch was so much fun.

My friends and I had so much fun on this day trip. Our guide, Ona, was so sweet and informative and made the experience very enjoyable. We were pleasantly surprised to learn so much history about Monserrat and the wine making process. Ona even sent us pics from the tour and gave us recommendations for the rest of our time in Barcelona. Very worth it!

This tour was well worth the money and time. Our guide, Toni, was extremely informative, easy to talk to, and had a great sense of humor. He also gave us some great restaurant and bar recommendations that didn't disappoint. The food that was provided during the wine tasting was very good and the facility was beautiful. All in all it was a wonderful day that we will never forget!

I had such a great time on the tour from the very beginning. I was the only one signed up for my time slot for the half day, and the leaders were so understanding and flexible and worked it out so I could have the best experience. My tour leader, Jordi was personable, knowledgeable and really a pleasure to be around all day. I would HIGHLY recommend this tour to anyone. The views from the top of the mountain along with historic relevance was a memorable experience.
The wine tour was great as well (and I don’t even drink wine), but Jordi made sure I had superb tasting grape juice while I learned about the intricate details of the wine business in Spain.

The tour description sounded interesting and who doesn’t enjoy a wine tour. We were completely amazed by our guide Max and his scope of knowledge about Montserrat, wine, Catalonian culture and Spain. All aspects of the tour were interesting and tasty.
We would love to come back and explore more of the monastery. There is so much to see. Would recommend the tour for friends and solo travellers as well.

We had a fabulous day out to Monserrat and a local winery. Our guide, Alex, was fantastic. He was very informative, had a great sense of humor and made the whole trip a lot of fun. The places we visited was very interesting and we just enjoyed all of it. We would do it again! Highly recommended.

We love Toni!! Not only a great tour guide, but also informative wine connoisseur! He also did a great job in telling us on how to enjoy Montserrat and all the great tips on what’s special in Montserrat. Will definitely refer friends to take the same tour. Cheers!

Our tour was incredible, our guide Daniel was so friendly and knowledgeable and truly made our experience fun and unforgettable. He gave us a run down of how to make the most of Monserrat and gave us a lot of cool fun facts about history and wine.The tapas were excellent, and the wine was truly in a class of its own. We absolutely recommend this tour, and thanks so much again to our guide Daniel!
-Eva and Lauren :)

We went to Montserrat on a half-day tour, and our guide was Pol. He was a great guide and made the visit even better. Montserrat is a mountain top monastery and church about an hour away from Barcelona. The views are incredible, and the day we went, there was a small cheese market happening. Those cheeses were outstanding. We also visited Oller Del Mar winery. The winery is housed where the same family running it today has lived there for 36 generations. We had a tapas and wine tasting. We really enjoyed the tour and would recommend it.

A quick drive from the North Metro station to Montserrat. The weather, warm and inviting. The views and the history, rich. Some tasting of liquors, some religious venues and a quick hike for a beautiful vista! After Montserrat, a 20 minute bus to a 1,000 year old winery!! So pretty, so delicious. Spent some time there and a quick trip back to Barcelona. Our tour guide was Toni. Top notch, phenomenal guide. Very knowledgeable and very funny (all the puns). 10/10 recommend!

This is a great tour. Plenty of time to walk around beautiful Montserrat topped off with wine and tapas at a local winery. The tour bus was very comfortable with big windows for seeing the countryside. Aurora our guide was the absolute best at narrating the tour and keeping us on track. We got back to Barcelona in plenty of time to relax in our hotel room before dinner.

Very nice tour. Only complaint it was very very hot the day of our tour and there was no stops or concessions made for water. I had to ask for water for our family and they brought one small bottle for our family of four. Our tour guide was very nice and seemed to like what she did.

Our guide David was outstanding! We were very happy.

First, he gave us lots of local history lessons on things we just did NOT know
It was really eye-opening and made the experience so much richer than if we went alone by ourselves.

We also enjoyed the extra 1 hour. We hiked to Saint Michael's Cross and had lunch on the side under a tree. It was very special and spiritual for us.

Oh and the Cogwheel train ride up and down was excellent, slow, safe, and easy; NOT a harrowing experience as one might think. It was chill and provided great views of the mountains and valleys.

Max was our guide, and he was perfect. Very informative and fun all in one. The tour provides plenty of time to see everything at Monserrat- boys choir, funicular, Madonna - the wine tasting shared great local and international knowledge on wines and was a great way to end the afternoon.

We had an awesome tour with 1/2 of the tour was touring the Montserrat and have time to pray to Black Madonna. Montserrat is a beautiful site with fresh air and tranquil surrounding. The tour ended with wine tasting at a beautiful winery. Overall, the tour is awesome and highly recommended!

We had a wonderful time on this tour!
Nuria was a very knowledgeable guide, both on the Montserrat region and the monastery. It was nice to see it through a local’s eyes!
We also enjoyed the winery experience. I very much appreciated the dietary accommodations that the winery made to a family member who is gluten free.
We would highly recommend this tour!

We had a great day in Monserrat and visiting a special winery - Oller del Mas. Our guide Dani was very pleasant, thorough in his information and guidance through the Basilica and at the winery. Oller del Mas was established in the year 964. Yes, same family for over 1050 years. Wine tasting was a treat and staff was quite pleasant and welcoming. We enjoyed a few bottles later in the week from our accommodations in Barcelona and the region

We had a very nice time touring with Aurora! The bus ride to Montserrat Mountain was enjoyable and very pretty. Aurora was very informative about the Monastery and has a pleasant sense of humor. The mountainous region outside of Barcelona is a must see. The winery, Oller del Mas, served tasty tapas and wine…they even accommodated the vegan in our group! I was expecting an employee or representative of the winery to provide the winery tour, as they do in Tuscany, but Aurora was clearly qualified. We enjoyed ourselves and all services provided! Thank you, Aurora!

My husband and I were bth a little unsure about what an "official tour" would be like in Spain but this day trip to Montserrat was amazing. It was beautiful, and wonderful experience. The tour guides were super knowledgeable, friendly, and funny; we had plenty of free time to explore, and didn't miss a thing. The wine tour was a fantastic end to the day as well. Make sure you have cash to take advantage of the farmers market. Toni was fantastic and we would totally recommend him to anyone!

We liked the tour wery much!
The guide Nerea was amazing. She had so much knowledge and a god sence of humor. 10 stars to her🤩 The onley thing we might have to change is to have a little bit more free time on Montserrat.
/Linda, Linda and Ann-Sofie

I was on a tour by myself my first day in Barcelona. The guides were so friendly, knowledgeable, and funny. I learned so much about the hsitory of Spain, Barcelona, and Montserrat. Plus Monserrat was absolutely stunning. The winery tour was stunning as well. Like it was out of a movie. I do wish there was more food available at the winery stop since it is such a long day.

It was really amazing and interesting! It’s definitely 10 from me! Great organization of the tour. The Montserrat is very beautiful place and Jordi gave us a lot of information about it. The wine degustation and tapas was really delicious and enough. Me and my friend are very happy we had this tour. So, very big thanks to our group guide Jordi. The price corresponds to the quality, it’s worth it.

Hope to come back one day!

Hands down the best experience we had in Barcelona. Our guide Paul/ Pul was wonderful, Amazing very knowledgeable, very good at explaining the history of Barcelona attentive and he made our trip fun. Monserrat is a such magical place, the Monestary the incredible views, the basilica and to finish our trip the wine tour: The visit to the winery, the tapas were terrific. Can’t recommended enough.❤️❤️❤️

A fabulous day trip from Barcelona. Montserrat was stunning. We had a wonderful very entertaining guide named Violets. During our free time we took the hike to the cross for a spectacular view of Montserrat. It’s easier than it looks and was very worth it. The lunch and wine tasting afterward were superb! Very worth it! So glad we went!

Montserrat has unforgettable views; hiking out to the viewpoint with the cross was our favorite part of the tour! The vineyard, and in particular the tapas, was a lovely experience as well. Our tour guide Anays was super friendly and gave us so much interesting information throughout the day. Her passion for the culture, language, food and wine of Catalonia was so clear and made the day even more fun! I would definitely recommend this tour to anyone visiting Barcelona!

Nerea was a really good guide to have around. She was knowledgeable and reacted to all of our questions properly. She took really good care of the whole group. The whole tour is a must have, and I would recommend it to everyone who is visiting Barcelona. Although it was a rather hot day it wasn't too packed. The vinyard at the end of the tour was a nice finishing touch and we were able to enjoy some fine wine.

The trip was very wholesome and well-planned. Tony guided us along the trip and set a light-hearted friendly tone right away. He answered our every question and provided great tips for the trip and for the future travels around Spain. A very pleasant experience that we will definitely recommend to our friends and family.

Awesome day with an awesome guide - weather, landscape, tapas, wine, it was a perfect fit. Additionally, our guide Anays was super funny, had a lot of interesting stories and facts. 5/5 stars and recommendation!

Great half-day tour with stunning views of Montserrat and wine tasting. Our guide Ona did her best to make the tour fun and relaxing as well as informative. It was a mini-group, so there was an individual approach to each group member. Ona managed to make complete strangers from different parts of the world feel like a family. Many thanks to the guide and the organizers.

This was a great experience the guides were friendly the monastery was interesting and hearing the history behind the black Madonna added more intrigue to the trip. If you want a break from the downtown scene and see the scenic side of Catalonia then this is a great trip. There are a couple of options that one can pick with this tour. One is a short train ride up the mountain versus taking a bus and getting lunch at the vineyard instead of tapas. Not sure if those are worth the extra price for those that did this but for me I was content with skipping these. All the guides with us were funny and friendly and definitely added to the experience by giving us all the history of the monastery and the winery. It was a fun and interesting trip

Our tour was amazing!! Anays was super knowledgeable on wine and the monastery’s history and she was super friendly. It was truly a perfect experience. We had a great time and would recommend this tour and Anays specifically to all friends and family. We give this tour a 10 out of 10! She even gave us recommendations for restaurants and we tried one for dinner yesterday, it was delish! Can’t wait to try another tour by your company soon. Thanks for everything.

Great day at Montserrat and then winery led by our guide Toni. His knowledge of the monastery, the region and the wines made for a truly enjoyable experience. He also gave us some great restaurant recommendations. Thank you Toni, La Acoba es Muy Bien!!

I’ve just done the most amazing tour whilst in Barcelona that I have ever done when I’ve been on holiday. A small bit of walking involved but nothing too strenuous and all on flat ground.
Daniel, our tour guide was absolutely brilliant and like a walking, talking history book. He made the tour so lighthearted and fun as well as providing us with so much history. He definitely made the tour for us! As well as the wine!
I definitely recommend this trip whilst you’re in Barcelona. Hopefully you get Daniel as your tour guide!

Visiting Montserrat was a highlight of our Barcelona trip! Spectacular views, interesting history that our guide Gus did an exceptional job explaining. The wine and tapas was a perfect way to end the tour. Highly recommend this trip and if your lucky enough to get Gus as your tour guide you will be in good hands.

We had a really fantastic day, the planning of the event was second to none and seamless. Coach, cogwheel train transport was so well planned. We througly enjoyed our day. Merek really made our day, he was clearly so passionate about barcelona and the tour, super helpful and a delight to be around! My only small criticism was the vegetarian tapas option was really not that great, but nice to have an option at all when abroad. The meat tapas looked great.

We had a wonderful visit to Montserrat. The ride was very comfortable in a coach bus. Absolutely beautiful scenery and great commentary from our guide Javier. He provided a very informative tour and then we had some free time to explore. We chose to visit the museum which had some beautiful artworks. The scenery is breathtaking and the church and grounds are beautiful. After we drove to a winery and had a wonderful tapas and tasting. Very relaxing and informative. Javier was a great guide. This is a great day trip from Barcelona. I highly recommend it!

Luis was the best tour guide I have ever had. He knew a lot about the history of Catulynya & the history of monserrat and the winery we went to. My boyfriend and I had a great experience and would go back again.

Toni made this experience a great one. He balanced history, humor and free time well. I only wish we had more time. At Montserrat we chose to go to the museum, which was impressive. At the winery, we had enough time to enjoy another glass of some fabulous organic wine. We were amazed that Toni was the guide, the server, the “sommelier” and cashier. We enjoyed the day.

We had a great trip and our guide, Edu, was outstanding. Highly knowledgeable and very funny. Montserrat is extremely beautiful! Some
great art in the museum. The winery and tapas were also very good.

I do wish the trip was longer to allow more time to explore Montserrat. We’d like to have taken the funicular to the top and had a chance to see the Black Madonna. Apparently you need to make a reservation to see the Madonna which we didn’t know nor was that stated anywhere. Maybe include that or make customers aware of that.

All in all, we really enjoyed the trip.

A well organized and fun trip. Our guide Aurora was really fun and nice, making sure we all enjoy the trip. Montserrat was stunning and the wines we tasted were excellent. Tapas were okay, nothing special, but fitted the wine.

I enjoyed learning the history behind the wines we were tasting and the gorgeous winery we were enjoying. Pep's jokes on the bus ride over were educational and kept things fun. The breathtaking views in Montserrat are worth the drive outside of Barcelona. We were glad we made the trek to see the Spanish countryside.

Everything went perfectly. Easy to check in, bus was nice. Nerea, our guide, was interesting and engaging. She was very knowledgeable and pleasant to spend the day with. Montserrat was interesting - with enough free time - and the wine and tapa tasting were great.

We missed the Bus at 8:45 am because of traffic. But thanks to the friendly and cooperative staff and tour guides, they adjusted us in next bus.
EDU & MERAK ....best guides...thanks for such a memorable trip.

Was supposed to be going with a friend but unfortunately she was very unwell and couldn't make it. I wasn't sure if I was going to go but decided to once we established it wasn't an emergency. Consequently, I arrived late for my booking. The staff were excellent - so understanding and accommodating. They booked me in the next tour that day. Edu, our tour guide, was brilliant. Very clear, informative and managed the group well. Natural wines and tapas were lovely too. There was also an opportunity for liqour and cheese tasting which I took full advantage of! Try the truffle cheese! Would definitely recommend this tour, well worth the money. 11/10.

I really appreciated everything our guide, Marcel, shared with us, such as the brief history of Catalonia and Barcelona. I also learned a little about the cultural values of Catalonia, such as the Catalan language and the sacred places (Montserrat and the monastery on it). The places we visited meant so much more because of his stories. (Marcel, I hope you will visit my country, Japan, someday soon!)

This was probably the best decision we've made by booking this tour. Montserrat was incredible & definitely a MUST see here in Barcelona. To top it off we had wine tasting & tapas at the end. It was incredible. Not to mention we had the best tour guide, Violeta! She was very informative, funny, and does her job well. I highly recommend this tour. just BOOK it! you definitely won't regret it.

This surpassed my expectations. I'm not a big group tour person but decided to try this. Everything about it was well planned and organized. Our guide Merak was incredibly knowledgable and funny. He did a great job making sure everyone had a good time. The cost of this tour was amazing. I felt it was a great deal for the money. Montserrat was amazing and the wine tasting was a lot more fun than anything I've done in Napa or Sonoma but also very classy.

My girlfriend and I had a great time. Merak our tour guide was great and very insightful and knowledgeable. We did not get bored once throughout the tour and had a amazing time exploring The Monastery and Winery. Highly recommend this tour if your looking to do something that takes up the day.

Thank you Nerea who was our guide- she was knowledgeable and helpful and made us feel well looked after. Monserrat is beautiful - well worth the trip alone for the scenery and the vineyard Oller del Mas is a family run winery (1000 years old) and very historical. We enjoyed the hospitality and culture and the whole team Nerea, Jon, Edo and Gus plus our driver (Isaac?) were witty entertaining us along the whole journey. We love their humour which is good natured and fun. Catalan culture is amazing and we are glad to be able to share in it. Highly recommended!

We had such a wonderful experience at Monserrat. Such an incredible place. We were lucky to have Max as our guide. He was very knowledgeable and friendly, and made the experience that much more enjoyable! Would highly recommend thisu quick day trip to any who have extra time in Barcelona.

Very well organised tours with excellent information during bus trip and in the monastery. Interesting people in the group.
Only I would give 1 h more free time in monastery.. such places need time to feel power

I can recommend the Tour. The bus was split in 3 some groups - good idea. Our guide Merak was excellent. He explained much and gave tipps for the free time in the monastery.
The tapas and the wine for lunch was interesting with funny explanations.
5 stars for the tour

This tour far exceeded our expectations. We don’t typically do tours, but this tour changed our perspective entirely. Toni was an excellent tour guide! He was incredibly knowledgeable, friendly and accommodating - not to mention funny.

The bus ride to Montserrat was smooth and easy. Upon arrival, Toni provided a great overview of the monastery and area. We then had 2 hours to explore on our own. It was perfect. Our next stop was the winery. Once again, Toni’s knowledge was invaluable. I learned a lot about Spanish wines and am now fascinated by the process. It’s quite unique.

I undoubtedly would recommend this tour to anyone. It’s very well organized and super fun!

Well organized trip to Montserrat Caballé.
Happy to see a guy with sunglasses on his backhead.
Four of us made it to the cross within 18 minutes.
Disappointed to see people in front of the black madonna.
Very difficult to find some "Gehäerztenes" in Montserrat Village.
Le porc du masque n'était pas "trop" obligatoire.
Then we come to our guide.

Hopefully you'll have Jon as your tour guide, because he's definitely the best. We were only disappointed, because he didn't spendéiert the night with us in the Carrer Blai.

Marcel was fantastic! He made the trip very interesting and educational! Note to those with motion sickness, this is a very long and winding road. Very much worth the trip. Learned so much about the history of Montserrat and such a gorgeous trip.

This tour was incredible. My wife and I went to Lisbon, Madrid, Barcelona, and Seville on our honeymoon…this was the #1 thing we did on the trip.

Daniel was the greatest tour guide we’ve ever had. Funny, and super knowledgeable (he is a historian after all) about the church, Monserrat, Spanish history, and wine!

Cannot recommend this tour enough! The tapas were plenty, the vineyard was beautiful, and the wine was fantastic.

Be sure to get the sweet bread when your in Monserrat, 10 out of 10!

Many favorite parts of the tour; the destination, the monastery, the wines and GUS - our fabulous tour guide. Extremely knowledgeable, great sense of humor and so personable. You can tell he really and sincerely loves his job. Great way to get BACK INTO TRAVEL after years of lockdowns.

Great way to explore outside the city. Monserrat was beautiful. The Basilica was magnificent. The wine tasting and tapas were exceptional. Our tour guide Jon was very knowledgeable, professional and funny! Definitely recommend!!

We had so much fun because not only were the views breathtaking but we learned so much about the Catalonian culture that makes up Barcelona. Ona, our tour guide could not have been better, she was filled with so much energy and made our day with her attitude. The history behind everything we saw was incredible and my friends and I had so much fun.

I don't typically go on tours, I find them quite boring and designed for tourists only. I'm glad to say that Merak has made it really fun and interesting. We had just enough free time to explore on our own. I would definitely recommend this to my friends.

Jordi our guide was a local with plenty of knowledge and a great sense of humor. The transport was well organised. Montserrat was fascinating and the winery stunning with lovely food and enjoyable wines. Met lovely people and is a must do on a trip to Barcelona.

Our day was wonderful. Our tour guide Marianna was very informative, pleasant, fun and great to be around. The full day was really good, on time, clean, etc. Montessarat is a very very special place and for sure worth the trip. The wine tasking was informative and the scenery was beautiful. We would recommend this tour.

We had a lovely day trip with Castlexperience! Monserrat is just beautiful and they made it so easy to get there and explore. Our guide, Monse, was fun and interesting.

After Monserrat we went to Oller del Mas winery for delicious tapas and wine tasting.

Highly recommend this excursion.

We had an AMAZING experience with Aurora and the tour she led for us. She was very informative, funny, and overall a joy to be around. Montserrat is beautiful and the tour made our entire trip to Spain worth it even if we had done nothing else.

Our tour guide, Marta, was the best. I walked away learning so much about Catalan history. The visit at the monastery was amazing. I do wish we had more time, but this is only the half day tour, so that is to be expected. The winery in of it itself was amazing as well. The rose and red wines we tried were divine. Please consider this tour, you won’t regret it! Although, you’ll probably be a little tired by the end of the tour from all the walking haha

The Montserrat and wine tasting tour was a fantastic experience. It was a great way to spend a day. Montserrat is simply breathtaking. The wine we tasted and the tapas were amazing. Appreciated that they had non meat options. Aurora, our guide, was very knowledgeable and funny and considerate. She took such good care of us. I highly recommend this tour!

If you are considering visiting Montserrat, you must do this tour. Our tour guide Anays was extremely friendly and knowledgeable. We had an amazing time and learned so much about Montserrat. The bus ride was comfortable and the tapas afterward were amazing. Can't recommend this experience enough!

The tour is organised very well. Our guide David was excellent, he explained very well, always with good sense of humour. I spent a wonderful day in Montserrat and at the vineyard. Unfortunately due to covid, we couldn't visit the cave to see how they make the wine. Would be an idea to do the projection of the wine making process. Thanks again..

Fantastic tour. I just wish I had a little longer at Montserrat because there is so much to do! I chose the Museum, which is world class. Of course the liquor tasting was delish, I went to the little out door market and got some amazing cheese. The tapas and wine tasting were perfect and the view from the vineyard, gorgeous. Of course I can't leave out our guide, Merak. He made it all easy and added to the very pleasant day. Muy, muy Bueno! Muchos Gracias, Merak and the crew from Castle expereience.

Our tour guide Aurora was just super and very helpful, friendly and knowledgeable. Aurora and David made the bus ride very enjoyable and interesting. David history lessons of Barcelona during the bus ride was interesting and knowledgeable two. I fell in love with the Montserrat, it was just stunning for November..... I can't imagine what it would be like in Summer months!! We got about hour free time here to go around on our own. I would have liked more time here. The Oller Del Mas Winery was great and you got two try 3 types of wines while eating tapas and to explore grounds and area and shop. You can sample some wines before you buy but you have to pay for them. I would recommend the orange wine. In all great trip and I would recommend.

Merak was awesome tripleader. He make our feel welcome and we enjoy every moment! And learn much! We didnt know that winetour can be also fun experience, we laihh much 😂 mountain and basilica was beautiful place. Thank u!

I am Altynay, from Kazakhstan. Want to say that I had a great time in Monserrat ❤️
#recommendtovisit There are sooo many activities to do, 1.5 hour of my free time was not enough. But still I loved the trip: wonderful place, incredible view, wine tasting and people that made all of these more special! Toni is the best guide ❤️ I will remember my trip to Barcelona forever! Thank you!

Awesome experience. The tour was very detailed and informative. Our tour guide Mr. Javier Rodriguez was the best we could ask for. Loved the scenary, the tapas and the wine. Kudos to Javier and his humour and his team. Will definitely recommend !!!

The tour guides are well prepared and did a splendid job of telling the story of Catalonia, Barcelona and Montserrat. Special mention to my tour guide Marcel for making it fun and funny throughout for my group. Well done. I will recommend this tour to my friends for sure.

The tour was very enjoyable and well organized.

We loved the wine cellar and private room we tasted the wine in.

Our guide Jon was really great and knowledgeable and made the trip extra special. We were very lucky to have him assigned to our group!

Would highly recommend.

Fantastic day of 2 halves. The morning spent up in the mountains and monastery. Sadly, the weather wasn't kind, but didn't distract from the amazing buildings and scenery. Our guide Nuria was exceptional with her knowledge and friendliness.
For the afternoon, we were handed over to Edu who led us down to a nearby winery to sample some excellent wines and Tapas. Again, he offered great knowledge of the offering and the surrounding area.
Great day out.

Merak was an amazing, friendly, & fun tour guide. His knowledge of history of the mountain and wine made the day! I enjoyed learning the Catalonia cheers too - all around awesome, affordable experience. And great wine!!!

Montserrat is gorgeous and totally worth the visit. The wine was the best I've ever tasted, and I don't much like wine. Our guide Pep was very well informative and very easy on the eyes! They were very thoughtful and offered to keep my luggage in their office so I wouldn't have to carry it around during the tour, which helped a lot. I recommend these guys 100%.

This was a great day trip from Barcelona with a perfect mix of history, culture, and wine. Beautiful views of the mountain with a visit to the monastery and a gorgeous local winery. Marta was our guide and she was absolutely wonderful - knowledgeable and so much fun! Would definitely recommend.

This tour was awesome! It fully met and even surpassed our expectations. It lived up to the description online. The staff was incredible, extremely knowledgable and friendly. It was the perfect balance of organised activity and free time. The food and wine was wonderful! Our tour guide, Dani, was the best ever. He made our experience so personable and enjoyable. He was hilarious and engaging. I am someone who does not enjoy listening to tours, but I was fully engaged with Dani!! Thank you so much for making this such a memorable day!

I highly recommend this tour. Our guide, Nuria, was wonderful as well as the other guides, Violeta and Gus. Nuria explained in detail all what we were seeing. From the monastery, walk to the cross on the mountain, the funicular, the local market, wine tasting, and just about every view, you had an historical as well as fun experience.
This tour did not disappoint!

We bought this trip as a last minute thing to do on our last day in Barcelona. Didn't really know what to expect. However, we had a great time visiting the monastery and then wine tasting after. Ona was absolutely amazing and was super helpful and more than willing to answer all of our questions. Thank you so much Ona! The vegetarian option for the tapas lunch was great and it was a good option. The bus rides were long but worth it! Also, you only get to taste 3 wines with the tour. For those, such as us, who want more wine, you can purchase extra glasses or bottles at the winery! lots of wine!

Sergio was our guide. He was super nice and provided us with many interesting tips for exploring Montserrat at our own pace. The wine tasting and tapas were a lot of fun and also informative. I would highly recommend this tour to anyone visiting Barcelona!

Wonderful experience. Our guide Violeta is well prepared and knowledgeable. Kind and flexible. It's a tour that everyone should try and see. Would love to stay a night or two next time. Montserrat is must in Barcelona.

The wine tasting was the best part.
Although all was very enjoyable. Maybe I would preferred more time for the winery.
Overall , very nice and professional guides, distinguished by our guide (Javi).
Good value for money. We recommend it!

This was a wonderful tour, very easy to pick up from the bus station in Barcelona. Merak was an extremely knowledgeable and entertaining guide. He even helped carry the 12 bottles of wine I bought at the winery to my hotel because they couldn't ship them back to the U.S.!

Merek was an excellent tour guide. He helped us to appreciate the history of the region and the country of Spain in general. It was an amazing tour which ended with a pleasant wine tasting experience. Take this tour and enjoy yourself.

We had a wonderful time in Montserrat, led by Merak. We learned about the region, enjoyed a beautiful hike, and had delicious wine at the Oller del Mas vineyard. Our boys, 10 and 12, were the only children on the trip, but they loved it too. Thanks, Merak!

This tour was amazing! We learned so much about the history of Catalonia, the monastery, and the wine of Spain. I would recommend this tour to anyone! Our tour guide Jordi was very knowledgeable and easy to talk to. We had an amazing day doing this!

Great short tour. Montserrat is breathtaking, definitely a must see while in the area. Anays is a great guide, super fun and full of great knowledge! And the wine and tapas is a very unique experience, gorgeous gorgeous property, delicious wine 10/10 for the overall experience.

David was a most excellent tour guide with his kindness, wit, and expertise. It was a pleasure to spend the day with him and the other guests. There are fabulous views to and from Monserrat, and the tapas and wine were delicious! I highly recommend this tour!

Great experience of having visited Montserrat monastery and having wine tasting after. Violeta, our tour guide has a lot of stories and history facts.
Definitely worth taking this tour while in Barcelona.

We thoroughly enjoyed our tour with Marcel. I am an old tour guide and so have a very high bar for guided tours. Marcel exceeded my expectations! He was very welcoming, interesting and created a magnificent day high in the Monserrat mountain and during our wine and tapas tasting.

Sergio and the team could not have planned a nicer event. The tour went just as described, and he was extremely knowledgeable. It was nice to have some free time to visit the summit and to see the Black Madonna. I would highly recommend this trip.

Nuria was an amazing tour guide. The tours of the winery and Monserrat were fantastic, the wine and olive oil makes great gifts, and it was a fantastic way to kick off my Barcelona trip. Would highly recommend.

Best tour of the trip! It was a breathtaking experience- the views were spectacular! Our tour guides, Anays and Pep, were extremely knowledgeable and entertaining which made the experience so much more enjoyable. I wished I had Anays as our guide for every tour in Barcelona. The wine and tapas were also delicious!
Beautiful views, delicious food, great wine, and Anays was a wonderful tour guide. The day was fun, educational, and memorable. One of my favorite things I've done on my trip to Barcelona.

Our guide for this tour was Marta, and she was a delight! She was very personable and professional. She added a lot of history that we would not have received without a guide. She added humor, which we enjoyed too! Her instructions on where to meet, what time, etc. were very good. At the winery, she was extremely knowledgable about the wines we were tasting, which we appreciated. Altogether, she was a wonderful guide and we were very pleased with her and the tour.

Thank you Marta!

Your Italian friends,
Mike and Marta
Excellent tour of Montserrat monastery. Beautiful mountain scenery. Nice shops. Wonderful tapas and 3 wines at Ollier del Mas winery, established in 964 (not 1964). Camillo, our guide, was superb!

Great tour, would have loved more time at Montserrat, but understand the day is limited. Wines were lovely too, not enough to call it food though (tapas), left a bit hungry. Overall excellent tour. English speaking, knowledgeable guides. (Thanks Toni)

The setting is incredible but it was cloudy and windy the day we went. Make sure you bring warm clothes as it is colder and windier than Barcelona. Our guide Carol was friendly and knowledgeable. On the "half day" morning tour you have about an hour of free time, which is enough to see the small museum and sample the food and drink in the shops. If you want to ride to the top of the mountain, take the full day tour.
the winery was very nice as well, with a lunch snack (pinchos rather then tapas) and three unique and delicious wines. Highly recommended.

I have been on many wine tours and this was below average.

From the their own website they described lunch as
"Before visiting the winery, you will stop at Oller del Mas country club to enjoy a multi-course traditional local menu with wine. In the afternoon you will walk the short way separating the restaurant and the vineyards."

We were seated in a huge tent with seating for well over 100. The lunch was not great, probably our worst meal on the trip. Additionally, they combined us with another group so it was very cruise like.

The vineyard, although housed at a historic location, Oller del Mas has only been producing wine since 2003. Again, very misleading. So, not surprising, the wine was below average for Spanish wines. One of the reasons I like Spanish wines is they are fairly consistent.

Our guide, was relatively new at it and her English was not great. I had trouble understanding her at times. It seemed like the tour company and bus were owned by the vineyard. Our guide acted as though she was an employee of the Oller del Mas.

The tour bus was nice.

In the (March 2018) morning of the tour the weather online said 62F but we had a lot of cloud cover and wind and felt more like mid 40's. So bring layers. btw: You can't leave anything on the bus. The traffic to Mount Serrat was awful. It took us 2 hrs.

If I had to do it again, I would have rented a car for the day and done it on our own.

I had visited Montserrat with my students twice in the past, but nothing compares with the attention we were given by Oriol and Borja. It was entertaining to hear stories and legends on the way up to the mountain, and after an orientation, to have free time to explore at will. The monastery museum was a huge surprise, since it contains not only depictions of la Moreneta, but works by several Spanish painters who leaned toward the impressionism of the French. The usual complement of religious art also was on display, reminding us of where we were.

After rejoining the group, we went on to an al fresco lunch at Oller de Mas, an organic winery in the area. The food was good, the wine was good and the company was good---who could ask for more?
We had a fantastic day, of course we visited great places but our guide Ona made it something special. Very nice day, filled with amazing views and nice experiences as well as new friends.
Jordi was an excellent guide. Very knowledgeable. Loved this tour! Montserrat was beautiful. The winery provided a very tasty lunch with wine included.

We booked this tour with the Tapas option and would not recommend. The bus trip to Montserrat went well and we enjoyed the tour of Montserrat. Wish we would have stopped there. The winery portion of the tour was a complete waste of time. We did not receive a tour of the winery but rather went into a board like room where our plate of tapas was already sitting out - no idea for how long, but the bread was hard as a rock, stale and very unappetizing. Tapas were OK, nothing special or memorable. There was no view, no decor and not at all what we expected. The wine was not out and our guide made several trips to bring it to the room. By the time this process was complete, the tapas were basically finished. The tasting was led by the guide, not a winemaker, and she was honest in advising this was not her expertise. It wasn't. We then were walked through the gift shop with time to purchase. The bus home, different from the 2 prior buses used, did not have working AC. The hour long trip back to Barcelona in August was miserable. Would not recommend.

From the time our guide identified himself, I knew that we would have a great time. Luis our guide, is a true professional made the tour informative and made us feel like family. There was nothing that we asked that he didn’t accommodate. The experience was well above our expectations. Thanks again Luis for making this experience the best we have had in a long time.

This was a really good day. We travelled to Montserrat first. For those who really don’t want to see another church this is your tour. You can spend 5 minutes in the church or all day or not at all. The mountains are amazing. And the walk to the cross (you’ll see it) is so worth it. Then there is liquor tasting and a cheese market. Then to the winery. Lovely lunch and wine tasting. Our guide Jordie was very informative and interesting and fun. All around a really good day

My husband and I had a wonderful time visiting Montserrat & the Oller de Mas winery with this group. Our tour guide, Pep, was excellent & very informative about the history & culture of the area. We had enough time to see the Monastery & take a short hike then off to the winery for tapas & wine tasting. Our group of about 14 people was a good size for touring & everyone was friendly which made it very fun!

Toni, our tour guide, with Castlexperience made our half-day tour of Montserrat and the Oller del Mas Winery a delightful experience: he is polite, professional, and knowledgeable - plus, he has a fun sense of humor.

The company focuses on small group tours (no more that 16 persons). And the company buses are clean, air-conditioned, and comfortable. The bus ride up the winding mountain was smooth and uneventful due to the stellar skills of the driver: due to this we were able to enjoy the scenery along our journey to Montserrat and the winery. Part of the spectacular scenery is the snow-capped Pyrenees Mountains.

The monastery, where the miracle of the Black Madonna and Child took place, has an interesting history, with working monks, and an impressive purpose for the 21st century.

It is a must-see!

My family and I booked the Montserrat Tour frm Barcelona with Tapas option. Pick up was at Plaza Cataluña and it took a little over an hour to get to the train going up to Montserrat Monastery. Montserrat was SUPERB. I would have wanted to stay longer and explore some more, but it would probably take a couple of days to do that. The flea market was a lot of fun too. Bus going down to oller del mas winery took around 30 minutes. Small winery fun tour. Tapas were filling enough. Cheese prior to the tapas was great. My kids were given grape juice since they still too young for wine.

Overall a great educational tour with superb and informative guides. A good intro to Catalan history and culture.

Tour was very well organized and fun! Ana, our tour guide was candid, funny, informative and did the job done so well the entire group became friends (and wine experts) at the end of tour :) Highly recommended!

We took this tour and enjoyed the entire experience! Montserrat was beautiful and Sandra was an awesome tour guide . . . She gave a great historical approach and then we had time to explore on our own . . . Next we traveled to Oller del Mas Wine vineyards and got a fabulous winery tour followed by tapas and wine tasting. Sandra was so very knowledgeable about wines and gave tips on how to properly taste and know more about the wines. Great tour with an excellent guide!

Literally booked this tour the night before. So glad we decided on the Montserrat and winery tour. Victor our tour guide was AMAZING beyond words. He truly went above and beyond to take care of my family. He loves what he does, and it shows. He’s incredibly knowledgeable about wine and gave us an exceptional tour of the winery.

Stopping by the market once you’re done with your Montserrat tour is a must. You will try amazing cheeses and tons of them. We HIGHLY recommend this tour and HIGHLY suggest taking a day trip and experiencing Montserrat. You will not regret it.

Thank you so much for everything Victor. Keep treating everyone with that genuine kindness, and that selfless personality to go above and beyond to please your clients. We are extremely thankful for all you did, and will be recommending you to everyone we know that is heading in your direction.
The Cuban family from Miami

The bus ride to Montserrat was filled with outstanding scenery as we drove out of Barcelona and into the mountainous region. Montserrat (serrated mountain) was very beautiful and filled with history, and of particular interest was the story of the Virgin of Montserrat. A walk to the Cross of San Miguel was exhilarating, and there was a stunning view of the Santa Maria de Montserrat (Benedictine abbey) and the valleys surrounding it. From there, we went to the Oller del Mas Winery, an ancient winery handed down to each first born son through the centuries. We had tapas and tasted various wines. In fact, I bought a bottle of their Syrah I Merlot (2016). We then went into the vineyard, which was also stunning as you could see the Montserrat mountains in the background. This tour was well managed and was at a nice pace. Jordi Colobran was a delightful tour guide and shared detailed knowledge about Montserrat and the Oller del Mas Winery with us. I very much recommend this tour.

The church is nice but was not the highlight of the tour. It is the location that gets your attention. The jagged mountains are beautiful and provide the opportunity for some solitude. Jordi, our guide did a great job of providing background and history of Monserrat. And he made the wine tasing and Tapas an educational experience.

I went with a group of friends to Montserrat and Castelle de Oller Del Mas. I went with the mentality that I would be drinking wine in a castle and that seemed pretty legit to me. As soon as the tour began, Victor (our tour guide) began throwing all this knowledge at us. This honestly was one of the most amazing experiences I’ve had. I’m not necessarily a very religious person, but I respect what the place stands for and find beauty in what their religion has accomplished. I would recommend it to anyone. Get wine and learn so much about a culture you’re not too familiar with.

Our tour was amazing! We went from Barcelona to Montserrat to visit the monastery and take in the views and finished with wine and tapas at a beautiful vineyard. One thing to note if you take this tour is that you may not eat until later in the tour - we suggest packing a snack or bringing some spending money to take advantage of the market at Montserrat for a snack. This full day tour was well-worth every penny - the views at Montserrat were breathtaking and we learned so much about the history of Barcelona and the surrounding area. The highlight of the tour, hands down, was our awesome guide Xavi! His humor made us laugh and his depth of knowledge was incredible. He had wonderful suggestions (including which treat to try at the farmer's market - cheese with honey! Amazing!) and even gave us some tips for our evening back in Barcelona. Thanks Xavi for making our honeymoon so special!

My two boys (21 and 25) and I had a wonderful and memorable time on this excursion. Aurora was an enthusiastic and knowledgeable guide. If you are an art fan, don't miss the museum at the top of Monserrat- I was astonished to see works by Caravaggio, El Greco, Picasso, Monet and others in this remote location. The tapas and wine tour was excellent and we all agreed it was one of our favorite days in Barcelona.

This is a very beautiful place. Its very touching to see the black madonna. The cathedral is gorgeous. Transportation was easy. The guide was a bit indifferent. If I had one piece of advice, it would be go to early in the day. I went in December and it was dusk when we got there so we were unable to walk the paths on the mountain to go to the cross and the caves. There just wasn't time and it was dark and cold. Also, the tram to the top was closed for the winter while we were there.

This tour company and tour guides are absolute pros. They know this tour backwards and forwards. They were professional when it came to logistics like timing and transportation but also not rigid when it came to fun things like talking about the wine and the food and the views and stuff. Our tour guide Marta had a genuine desire for everyone to have a good time and learn something on the way too. She knows a lot about both Montserrat and the surrounding areas which she told us all about as we travelled to and from the monastery. She gave great recommendations for our free time. We felt like half-day was fine, but if you really want to soak in Montserrat, which it very much deserves to be, I would suggest opting for the full-day trip. We were there for four days so we did a half-day one, but if we were there for a week I would do a full-day. The wine section of the tour was fun too, the winery is gorgeous even in the winter without any leaves on the vines or grapes. The vineyard has been been family owned for 37 generations and just built a brand new building which hosted our wine tasting. The best part was being greeted by the vineyard's resident dog Vino. The tapas was nothing mind blowing, especially after having had some incredible tapas the last few days in the city, but there was nothing offensive. The wine was wonderful, as was Marta's no-nonsense non-stuffy education on wine tasting basics. We left with a few tricks for evaluating wines and knowledge about the wine making process that we'll take with us for the rest of our lives. I highly recommend this tour.
Skip the wine tour! Monsterrat was the main event while the wine tour sounded great it really wasn’t.

It was a fantastic day with great travel mates and a fantastic guide named Ona. All was well organized, Ona very knowledgeable, sympathetic and helpful. She provided us as well with a very good list about bars, restaurants, things to see, where to hang out in Barcelona and what not to miss around Barcelona.
We were lucky as Montserrat was not too busy on our visit and it was a sunny-azur-blue-sky-dayso I was able to enjoy its beauty and mystique. The landscape is just stunning.
The winery - ok. It was an add on for me and not the main reason to book this day trip. Ona had a lot of entertaining info about the history, the aims etc. The wine tasting was very humorous.
Thanks to Ona, the Wine Castle Experience and the travel mates for this fantastic day.
Ana was the best tour guide!!! She made the experience so much better with her knowledge of Spain’s history & her outgoing personality. Highly recommend this tour, it was an amazing day!!
Great day tour. Our tour guide was very nice and knowledgeable, explained the history the place in details. It was an excellent tour!

We had Jordi as our tour guide and he was AMAZING!!! I loved how happy he was and you can tell he really enjoyed doing these tours!!

Jordi was so knowledgeable and very nice. Giving us the overview of the monastery and pointing out the important things you would expect, but Jordi made it more personal to the group and answered all questions. He gave little nuggets of knowledge during the drive as well.

The winery tour and tasting was so much fun and really added to the experience so much!

Definitely ask for Jordi if you do this tour.

Montserrat is such a nice place with rich religious vibes and breathtaking landscape. Joining a tour save you a lot of trouble. The tour gives you sufficient free time. The wine tasting is icing on the cake. The staff are so personable and amiable. Being professional on one hand, they also make you feel like they are just your friends.

This is a must do tour while visiting Barcelona. They do keep it to 16 people per guide which makes it easy to follow and hear all your guide has to say. The guides give you a very informative tour at the monastery and then you have ample time to experience it yourselves. The views all around the mountain are amazing and the basilica is simply beautiful. The wine tasting with tapas is also kept to your small group and very enjoyable. Two things to be aware of are 1) this is not a half day tour - We took the 9:30 tour with meeting time at 9:15 and returned at 5:30 and 2) you are always in a different bus with one or two other groups. Therefore you can't ever leave anything on the bus. So if you buy anything on the mountain (they do have a nice liqueur tasting opportunity) you have to carry it with you to the wine tasting. Our first two buses were comfortable but the third bus back was old and very musty smelling. For the price, it would be nice to be able to leave things on one bus for the entire day. Didnt really care for all the switching of buses.

I decided on this tour last minute after a friend highly recommended it and I'm so glad I took his word for it! Ona was an incredibly warm and informed tour guide who seemed to learn the name of everyone in our group quickly.

Quick tips:
-expect the "half day" tour to go from 9:15am-5:15pm
-wear comfortable walking/hiking shoes if you plan to summit Montserrat
-eat breakfast as tapas are just that: pa amb tomaca, jamón, butifarra, queso, aceitunas,potato salad (a few bites of each)

The hike to the cross is not too strenuous but if you're looking to go higher (i.e. ermita de Santa Magdalena) know that it takes some effort and much longer than 25 minutes). The views are absolutely gorgeous--even from the base where the Monastery is.

There's a cafe if you need coffee/snacks and some stores where you can buy the products that the monks make. Our bus was delayed due to a capacity issue so we had the pleasure of taking the train down to the bottom which again offered incredible views.

The ride to Oller del mas is about 20 minutes and the history is fascinating. The building where you'll sample 3 types of wine and enjoy tapas is brand new (opened Aug 2018) so it's super clean and impressive. The room itself reminds me of a conference room. Apparently the tour used to go through the castle where the family lives (would have been cool) but makes sense that they prefer groups to not walk through their home constantly.

You'll have an opportunity to sit outside on the terrace which looks at Montserrat and the vineyard. There's also opportunity to but wine which I highly recommend since they do not sell it in the states. It's 90 euros to ship which only makes sense if you're purchasing multiple bottles so grab a few for your checked bag.

Going back to Plaza de Cataluyña took a little over an hour which was perfect for a siesta. Overall, great way to spend a Saturday and I'll be recommending this to others.

This was the perfect way to visit Montserrat and Max, our guide, wad the perfect guide. He was personable, knowledgeable, and friendly. Transportation was comfortable and fast. Max made the ride seem like only minutes long. I highly recommend this tour and that you ask for Max as your tour guide.

Absolutely wonderful day visiting Montserrat! Xavi, our tour guide, was phenomenal! We loved everything about this excursion!
Trip to Montserrat took only one hour from Barcelona. The tour was informative and provided personal time, which we used to purchase liqueurs and awesome organic cheese from the small farmer’s market. All cheese produced locally and an unbelievable shelf life of 4 months!
We all enjoyed the wine tasting and the tapas was ample and delicious!
What more can I say? You won’t be disappointed!
Marta was the best tour guide!! we had a great time on this tour the winery was beautiful & the history about this place was even more beautiful. def a most do tour

An enjoyable visit to Montserrat. Toni was an incredible guide with a great sense of humor. He filled us in on the history of the area and was knowledgeable about its wines. So much to see that I wish we had taken the full-day tour! Thank you, Toni.

The trip is 2 hours out/back, with a stop in a small medieval town after an hour on the bus. The "market" was open and there were tons of vendors and people. A hustling and energetic place. Montserrat itself was very impressive, build into the mountains and offering great views of the valley below. Afterwards we hit a local winery where we tried 3 organic wines along with a nice meat/cheese plate. A wonderful day...

Myself and my girlfriend did this tour on our trip around the area. I cannot reccomend this enough. Montserrat is beautiful the winery is stunning and even the bus journey between them is beautiful. Our guide Merak was very informative and very likeable. It's a must do if in the Barcelona area.

Dean and Danielle.

Would recommend this tour to anyone - we had a brilliant day! I had previously booked for a different date but having looked at the weather forecast it looked like a very rainy day, I was able to revise my booking online very quickly and easily to a later and a much sunnier day!

Everything on the day was arranged to perfection from pick up all the way through to being dropped back off again. Our guide Luis was brilliant and engaging all through the tour.

Montserrat was absolutely wonderful, the views are amazing and would absolutely recommend the walk to the cross during the free time. Perfect balance between guided walking and free time to enjoy. The winery was really interesting, food was very nice and enjoyed the wine very much.

Would definitely recommend this tour, brilliant day out with spectacular views and good wine!

It was wonderful. Very informative and fun at the same time.

So happy we made the decision to join the tour.

Xavi (Mr X) and his colleague were both great guides.

Went to Montserrat w Rubi and just had the best day. He was a wealth of information about history of the area as well as the wine we were tasting. Very caring and thoughtful. Entire tour was well organized . Particularly enjoyed the couple of hours of free time once we arrived in Montserrat. Would recommend without hesitation.

Montserrat was the absolute best part of this tour. I wish we had one more hour here so I could have squeezed in everything. Carol was our tour guide and she was great! Very knowledgeable and did a good time keeping our energy up in between places. However, the wine tasting portion of this tour was severely lacking. You only got to taste (1oz pours) three wines. That doesn’t even equal one glass of wine and there wasn’t any options to even purchase a glass on your own (the only option was to purchase a bottle to take home with you). This tour should definitely be better marketed as heavy on Montserrat (which was lovely) and a quick tour of a vineyard (it shouldn’t even mention tasting). I would say book this tour if you are interested in Montserrat. Do not book if you are interested in wine tasting.

This tour was amazing. My husband and I like to spend time in our Rocky Mountains in Canada so we thought this tour would be fun. It was more than that. It was amazing. The tour guides were great both Laura and Aina. They were professional, knowledgeable and really fun to be around. Thanks for the great experience both at Montserrat and at the winery. It made our last day in Spain amazing! Thanks so much.

Hola,
This is a small but mighty company who caters to their clients!
Rubi was great 👍
He was energetic, well versed in the History and provided insights into Spain, Catalunya and Barcelona.
Thoughtful and always looking to ensure his guests were taken care off.
I would recommend Rubi and your tour as a great adventure and must do in Barcelona.
Gracias,
Capn Greg
