We went on a great tour up to the monastery and then afterward to a vineyard, owned by the same family since the 10th century. I'd be lying if I didn't say the wine was my favorite part!! The scenery was beautiful, the tour was fabulous and the wine + tapas were really good! Our tour guide, Silvia, was seriously amazing. So much great energy and knowledge. She was always checking in individually to ensure we were enjoying ourselves, and taking the time to get to know our names and stories. She was absolutely great. The tour from start to finish was entirely seamless. They take care of everything - get you on the bus, on the rail car up the mountain, back down, to the winery and drop you off safely back in the city center. It was a wonderful tour and Silvia was just the BEST!

We loved our tour it was very organized and was better than we expected! Alex was our guide for the whole day and he was very knowledgeable, energetic and friendly. Would definitely recommend to friends! Thanks Alex

Our group of four had a wonderful day with Ana, our tour guide. On our bus ride, she gave an engaging overview of Catalan/Spanish history and previewed the importance of Montserrat to Catalan culture. The monastery itself, and the small village that contains it are perched on a beautiful hillside. After our introduction to the environs, we chose to take the 20 minute hike to the cross that affords a look back at the monastery. Upon our return, we toured the basilica, then tried the various kinds of liqueurs for sale in the shops under the church. After Montserrat, we went back on the bus and headed to Oller del Mas winery. It is situated in an old stone castle, which we toured, and were then served a series of traditional Catalan small plates and three different kinds of wine made by this organic winery. After lunch, we checked out the vineyards and then hopped back on the bus for the ride home. Ana was an excellent, engaging tour guide who really took time to talk with all of us and answered all our questions about Montserrat and the wine making process. Thank you Ana!

If you have a day to spend while in Barcelona, this is an outstanding option. Montserrat is historically significant for the region and is just beautiful. Spending time at a nearby winery for tasting and tapas was a great way to spend the afternoon. We enjoyed getting to know our tour mates from all over the world. And Maria was an outstanding guide - fun, engaging, knowledgeable, and committed to making all of us enjoy our day. Highly recommend.

I would highly recommend this tour! At first, we were between the full day tour (10 hours) and the half-day tour (7 hours return by 330pm). We ended up taking the half-day tour which I think was the perfect time at each location. Jordi was our tour guide and he kept the energy light and fun! The drive to Montserrat did not feel as long as others say and honestly, I think it was a good escape from the city. Side note: I would wear sturdy sandals or shoes as the hike can be steep. Also, the meeting location is at the Hard Rock Cafe and you literally look for a plain pink umbrella to check in. The half-day tour included 30 minutes of free time. For some people, I could see that it may not be enough time for them, but for me and my boyfriend, it was a great amount of time to see the church at your own pace and walk out to the cross for a perfect view. A couple on our tour also got engaged on the cliff of the cross which was very romantic! It definitely made going to the winery even more of a celebration. The winery itself has an interesting history which made it special and I ended up buying the white wine. Overall, it was a great day of information and touring with time to spare when coming back to Barcelona.

The guides are very funny and amusing, I like the pink umbrella idea which tourists can easily find the tour operator, bus is clean and new, the driver is good.
The Montserrat part is really good, we had enough time to explore the beautiful area. Lunch is okay, the guide helped us to order vegan food, wine tasting part is a bit long, as we are not big fan of wine, and there isn’t too much to see in the winery, may be better if the lunch time is shortened and get back one hour earlier to Barcelona.
What a beautiful and amazing tour. Merak our tour guide was the best. So knowledgable, friendly and outgoing. Loved this stories.

If you enjoy breathtaking scenery and wine tasting, then this tour is for you. Aina, our guide, was excellent, possessing all the qualities of a great tour guide. It was nicely paced, although it would have been easy to spend more time listening to the choir at the church or hiking the trail to the overlook. The tour of the winery was most interesting and the wine and tapas lunch was enjoyable. This was definitely a vacation highlight.

This was a perfect day trip from Barcelona. My husband and I did this as an excursion prior to our cruise that left Barcelona. Our guide, Pep, was friendly and knowledgeable. The coaches were very comfortable and the drive went quickly. We enjoyed the brief tour around Montserrat before having time to explore on our own. Then, we went to the vineyard for a tasting and tapas. The wines and tapas were very good and Pep did a great job giving us the history of the family vineyard. I would highly recommend this tour and company and Pep!

There were multiple Castlexperience tours departing from the same place but the check-in was very organized. We did the half day tour because we had an evening flight, so we knew we would not have time to see everything in Montserrat. Our guide Carol was informative and easy to talk to. Montserrat was beautiful and we hiked to the cross during our free time. The winery tour was interesting and the three wines were very good. We had about 16 people in our group from different countries and Carol was able to spend time with each group to get to know them.The buses were clean and comfortable. The different guides on the bus took turns giving us some history and information and they all did a great job.

I booked this tour because I am fascinated with monasteries, but this was so much more! Our guide Luis gave us so much history in such a fun way. The views are breathtaking, the monastery is beautiful, and the hike up to the cross is so much fun. The wine tasting exceeded my expectations. We all left with several bottles, and again, Luis was so knowledgeable and engaging that we wanted to pack him in our suitcase and take him home! I highly recommend that you book this if you are anywhere near Barcelona!

We thought this was a great way to spend half a day experiencing the country side and taking in views. The Montserrat was excellent and just the right amount of time spent. Our guide Carol was enthusiastic, informative, and entertaining. We did wish we got some more tasting (only 3 were included) and had more time at the winery though.

Beautiful day!! Our tour was perfect! We left Barcelona in the AM to spend time in Montserrat (approx 2 hours to explore at Montserrat). This gave us time to snack and walk around. We then left for Oller de Mas (my favorite part) as it’s a beautiful winery and castle. Great history and our tour guide Sylvia did a wonderful job! We had a tour of the grounds, learned about wine, had a 3+ course lunch, and tasted several types of wines (all delightful). Highly recommend and would love to do again!

We were a group of ex-colleagues on a reunion in Barcelona and this was a good way to combine history and culinary experiences. The visit to the monastery was somewhat rushed through; the winery visit and wine tasting were excellent experience from which we all felt we learned a lot.
I would recommend the tour operators to extend the free time in Montserrat to at least 90 min so to make it possible to have a coffee or bite AND visit the cross observatory or the museum. Will have to go back to see the museum.

We spent two weeks traveling around Spain and this was hands down one of our favorite days! All of the tour guides for this experience are so friendly, informed, and welcoming. The wine and food are amazing, and the views from the monastery area are once-in-a-lifetime! We actually had a great amount of free time (2 hours) to explore the area on our own which was the perfect ratio of guided tour to alone time. With that time we chose to hike to the cross which has amazinnnng 360 views! Then afterwards we still had time to leave a note in the mountain by the Basilica (a tradition).

This was a pretty great tour. Pol was a really good guide. You can tell he has taken time to study and understand the content for the tour to articulate fully what we saw and tasted. The Montserrat portion has breath taking views and Pol provides interesting history lesson about the monastery. Oller del Mas was wonderful, with a nice snack and great tasting. Additionally, you get a little tour of the winery which also has some spectacular views.

Laura was an excellent tour guide for our Castlexperience Monserrat and winery tour. There was plenty of time to explore and sightsee on our own after a very informative and interesting tour led by one of the best tour guides that we have encountered. We enjoyed the beauty, the history and the wine tasting. You won't go wrong if you choose this tour.

The tour was phenomenal from the start. We were separated into smaller groups to fit on the bus. We met Toni, one of the tour guides and he was very friendly, professional, knowledgeable, and knew a lot of dad jokes.

This tour took us to Monteserrat where Toni told us some history relating to the place. He gave us the option to hike to the cross, go to church, check out the museum, or roam around freely for 30 minutes.
We couldn't get lost because he directed people towards their hikes or otherwise.

We proceeded to the winery and he gave extensive knowledge about it. Both my friend and I really enjoyed the historical side of it. The wine tasting was provided by him as well and the wine pours were bigger than in California :)
We had some delicious cold tapas along with the tasting and many laughs were shared by the group of 25 people. A lot of Californians were on the tour!

After the winery we checked out the castle and went back to Barcelona via air conditioned bus. The buses are comfortable and clean. If you can ask for Toni to be your tour guide, I would. He was entertaining!

This tour was a great experience and I did not know how significant Montserrat is as well as the jaw dropping views from the top. The tour was perfect mix of providing information of Montserrat while also letting you go do your own thing including seeing the church, hiking towards the cross or visiting the farmers market. Afterwards you head over to the beautiful winery for lunch and wine tastings. I would recommend to anyone visiting.

We were unfortunate with the weather on the day of our trip but we still had fun. Due to the weather there was a lot of fog so we didn't see much of the monastery and most of the tour was cancelled so we were left to our own devices. We went to the museum which you have to pay abotu 8 euros for which wasn't really worth it but since the weather was bad we didn't have much else to do. We also went to see the boys choir. Got there 15 minutes early and still only just managed to get a space at the back. There were only 5 boys singing so it was quite quiet and kind of got drowned out by tourists talking, taking photos and phones going off so was a bit underwhelming.

The second part of the tour, the wine tasting, was great. We didn't see much of the vineyard because of the weather but the lunch in the castle was really nice though we only had 3 bottles of wine on the table to go around about 15 people. After lunch we did the wine tasting - the wine was really nice and our group was quite lively which made it fun.

The tour was well organised and the coach was quite luxurious which was good. We also learned a bit about Barcelona's history while on the coach which was a nice touch. I think the fact that the guides were so friendly and upbeat made the trip better - despite the weather letting us down we did still have a fun day thanks to the guides.

First and foremost let me say that you MUST visit Montserrat. That portion of the tour did not disappoint however everything else did. The guides were friendly and helpful and I certainly have no complaints about that....but lets start from the beginning. The bus trip was less than pleasant...were were roasting hot on the trip up and freezing cold on the trip back. The driving, and I'm not one to get motion sick, caused sever nausea....I would recommend finding another way to get to Montserrat like the train or by car. Once there we had plenty of time to explore and view some of the incredible iconic and structural art..very happy with that. There was a delightful little farmers market that had samplings of lots of cheeses and honey etc. Thumbs up on that. Then the winery.....if you have ever been on any other winery tour you will be disappointed with this. While the mini-tapas lunch was decent...it was typical of anywhere. We only tasted 3 wines and none of them were amazing. The room we were placed in was kind of thrown together and not at all professional....this was especially apparent when we viewed where the other tour group got to do their tasting and lunch. While this has a lot of potential...the owners have a long was to go to even come close to being a first class wine tasting and tour experience.

My girlfriend and I had a great time. Our tour guide, Silvia, was very insight, entertaining, and fun. It was the perfect amount of everything. Your choices for free time are either mass at the church, hiking, shopping, or a trolley ride to the top of the mountain. You only have time for 2/4 if you’re quick.

The winery was fantastic as well. Tried three different wines. One red and two white.

Highly recommended.

Amaizng place to visit, its a whole other world it seems up in the mountains.

We departed from Plaça de Catalunya mid day which was good - I would of given this 4 stars due to the fact that you are expected to arrive half an hour early, which is understandable however our bus was over half an hour late! But I don't want it to reflect poorly on what a stunning place Mont Serrat is.

The journey was pleasant and the tour guide very knowledgeable and interesting.

Instructions and the stricture of the visit was clear which was good, we walked around with the group tour for around 45 minutes. We then had a choce to visit the winery and taset some wine or to go off alone. We do not drink so took the latter option which was lovely, the scenery was amazing.

We took a nice free walk around to enjoy the views - you have the choice to take the tram further up the mountain but we opted not to do this

Timings were clear and once we were all back on the bus it was clear that everyone had enjoyed how they spent their time.

The tour is fine. The guides are knowledgeable and engaging. You are limited (fairly obviously) by the fact it is organised. Whilst there I wished we were free to do our own thing as we would have done it differently and saved a lot of money. Organising a train from Barcelona (Espanya station) would have been easy and the funicular to the monastery also easy. I loved our time in Montserrat but found the Castle tour uninspiring. We missed the choir due to time restrictions/whilst listening to tour guide, we hadn’t got time to queue for the black Madonna (not my thing but if it’s yours, this tour restricts your options) and we didnt have time to get to the Steps of Knowledge. The castle winery felt like a front rather than a real working winery. I’ve done wine tours and visited the vines more, visited the cellars where the grapes are crushed and watched the bottling process. Here you were shepherded into a large hall and served mediocre food (soup, salad, bread, cannelloni and a yoghurt albeit ...in a glass pot with red fruit sauce swirled on top). You then drank three glasses of wine which I didn’t enjoy but am sure this is just personal taste. So nothing to criticise about the tour as it was well organised but I felt underwhelmed and frustrated at missed opportunities for exploring both Montserrat and the winery. I’m sure this tour will suit some but if you are active and like exploring maybe not for you.

The group met outside Hard Rock Cafe in Barcelona. The check-in process was very organized. Our tour guide Alex provided interesting history of Spain and surrounding landscape we passed through on our way to Montserrat. Montserrat Monastery and the surrounding views are incredible. Alex gave the group enough time to explore on our own - take a short hike, visit the museum, or shop before we headed to Oller Del Mas Winery. At the winery we enjoyed cold tapas and sampled at least 3 wines before touring the interior of the winery..Alex kept the group on-time during the entire tour and his enthusiasm made this excursion fun and educational.

Pep was a great tour guide on our Montserrat and winery exploration! He started with a "thorough" review of Catalonian history (we only had a 7 hour tour...) and contextualized everything we were experiencing. Plus the wine was great!

Thanks Pep :)

Myself and my group of 9 friends booked this tour last minute and we are so grateful we did. Montserrat was breathtaking and was made very interesting and fun with the help from our first tourguide Albert. Definitely would recommend having him as your guide! He is so nice, funny and enthusiastic about everything that he was showing us. The winery was incredible as well, also made better with our second tourguide Ana! She was also very enthusiastic, kind and a great person to be around. HIGHLY recommend this tour and these tour guides!

My husband and I both agree that this is the best tour we had in Barcelona! Luis is our tour guide and he is so knowledgeable! We learned a lot from this tour and Luis made it a fun experience as well! The wine and tapas were perfect, and they even catered to your food preferences! I highly recommend this trip!

My wife and I took this tour and it was truly excellent. We would strongly recommend that anyone traveling to Barcelona make time in their schedule to see Montserrat and the Oller del Mas Winery. The tour was well planned and our guide Jordi was just great! He was very knowledgeable and professional.

My best friend and I decided last minute to book the Montserrat and Wine Tasting tour from 10 -5:30pm including a tapas tasting and we couldn't be more pleased with the experience! Our tour guide Xavi (Mr. X) was the BEST. He helped make the experience as great as it was. There was a really good balance of history, jokes, and free time to explore individually.

I will definitely recommend this experience to all my friends who travel here! We loved loved loved the wines too! If i could change just one thing it would be to maybe clarify how little amount of food is available between 10-5pm so that we would have maybe brought with a snack or two.

I went on this wine tour with my mom (who ADORES her wine) and we enjoyed every bit of it! Montserrat is absolutely beautiful and our tour guide was amazing. The wine tour is also very nice and fun as well, the tour guide is very well informed on both Montserrat and wine in general. If you wish to have more free time in Montserrat however, then we recommend taking the full day tour!

We did the the half say tour pick up at 8.30 back at 3.30

Our guide was Albert his knowledge of both Montserrat, the winery and wines was second to none.

Can not recommend this tour or company highly enough

Easy pick-up in front of the Hard Rock cafe. Our guide Pol kept us entertained during the bus ride to the monastery with great stories and history of Barcelona. Monastery was very interesting but I really enjoyed the winery and tasting. I would recommend purchasing a couple of bottles to enjoy later, price is right. They do have shipping available but was a little pricey. Left at 9:00am and was back by 3:00pm.

This tour exceeded our expectations! Xavi was our guide, and he was funny, informative, and kept us all on schedule so we were able to see all of the important sights and have some free time at Montserrat. The wine tasting and tapas lunch was so much fun and went above and beyond what we had hoped it would be. Xavi led us through tasting the wines, and the food was delicious. I highly recommend this tour!

We had a good day doing the half-day tour of Montserrat and Oller del Mas. Agnes was a great tour guide and the wines were surprisingly good if you are into nice light whites and garnacha / syrah blends like we are. Montserrat is stunning and Oller del Mas was a nice experience. Buses are comfortable.

We booked this tour fairly last minute while we were visiting Barcelona. This tour was very well organized and fun! Our guide, Jordi, was a very nice young man. Very informed, articulate and raised in a nearby village he was able to answer many questions with confidence. My wife and I were very pleased!

We took this tour on the recommendation of our daughter-in-law, and I'm glad we did. We had five days in Barcelona before our cruise, and it was great to get out of the city. While we were on a large bus, we were broken into smaller groups, and our guide, Lorenzo, was excellent! We had plenty of time to see the monastery and wander around, and then we had a full wine tour with the tapas that were promised. Each group was in its own room which was very nice. The presentation of the tapas was lovely, as well as delicious. This was a great day!

My mom and I had an amazing time on this tour, especially thanks to our guide Miguel. We booked this in advance before arriving in Spain and didn't really know what to expect. However, the mountains and monastery were absolutely gorgeous and the winery was gorgeous. Our guide Miguel spoke English really well and had so much knowledge of the places we saw.

My husband and I chose this tour through Trip Advisor before leaving for Barcelona. I'm glad we did. We were broken into smaller groups with tour guides before getting on the bus, Jordi was our guide. Our group that day had a van for the drive to Montserrat. The other groups were together on a coach. Jordi did a wonderful job giving us information and history during our bus ride. He showed us points of interest as well. Montserrat was beautiful. Part of our tour was guided and then we had about an hour on our own. My husband and I opted to take the walk to the cross. The path to the cross was paved but rocky, and it was an uphill walk almost all of the way. The views were so beautiful and made the walk worth it. There were also opportunities to sample cheeses from small stands and the Monks from the Monastery make liquors that can be sampled as well. I wish we had a little more time there on our own so that we could have done and seen more. We met with Jordi again and the other groups and boarded the coach to go to the winery. This was a nice relaxing time. We had the opportunity to see some of the castle that was built in the 900s. We tasted a few wines, then had some lovely tapas and dessert. We had the opportunity to purchase wines if we wanted any, then we went out into the vineyard. We got back to Barcelona a bit before our scheduled time. It was a very enjoyable day. Jordi did a great job as our guide. I would and did recommend this trip to others.

The info desk at Espanya was not helpful. They don’t want to hear you and they want to send you to kiosk. Some of my fellow English speaking travelled felt the same way. So do your homework before you go

There is a several type of tickets. Based on my research and my trip, round trip tickets plus two funicular access is the best option for the most people. It will cost you about 36euros. The ticket also includes one subway ride in Barcelona.

Pack your lunch. Food option there is limited.

We had a great day although it was sooo cold and windy on top of the mountain. We loved seeing the Black Madonna and listening to the Catalan Boys Choir- truly a special experience. The wine tasting was fun and informative , but not as long as we had hoped. Our guide Chavi was super knowledge and informative. I would recommend this tour .

Everything about this tour was great. Booking was easy even with ten people in our group. Pick up location was easy to find. Bus ride was smooth and comfortable. Our guide, Marta, was fabulous. Super knowledgeable about the monastery and the wine tour. Very funny and entertaining. (We laughed a lot!). Best thing we did while in Barcelona. And we did a lot. Thanks, Marta!

I cannot say enough about this tour! From the beginning to the end it was well planned, organized and informational. Carol was a gem! She was very friendly, presented the tour and background information so well. We were treated like VIP's on this tour and she even made sure that we got in to be able to touch & say prayers at the statue of the Black Madonna even though it was so close to closing as the daily Mass was set to begin. Montserrat was a magical place as well as the winery. We could not have picked a better tour to go on and please pass our compliments on to Carol as she really made the 1/2 day trip even better.

Great tour to Montserrat and the wine tasting and tapas. The perfect amount of time. The winery was great and our tour guide taught us a lot about wine. We had great weather and the bus was very organized. Our tour guide was Dani. He was fabulous. Dani was very informative and funny. A pleasure to be with. We would take another tour with Dani.

It was a perfect day to spend with our guide Mariana who shared a lot of information and good food and especially wine in a half day which gave me time to come back to the city by 3-4 pm and still take things in. The experience there especially in the mountains was just breathtaking, highly recommend

Great things:
1. Our guide, Nuria, was very knowledgeable and funny. She obviously knows what she is talking about.
2. You get to see a lot of very interesting things on this tour, including Monserrat and all it has to offer, the winery where the property dates back to the 10th century, and interesting local wines to taste.
3. You don’t have to drive yourself and figure out where you’re going, tolls, etc.
4. The views from the monastery are incredible.
5. We met some very interesting people.

Not so great things:
1. This is not a small group tour as stated on Viator. The bus seats at least 60 people. It is not a small eight passenger bus.
2. The tour meeting spot is located on the second floor of the north train station. This is not indicated in any information we got prior, and it would have been helpful to know. There is no signage outside the station to guide you. We had to call to get specific directions. Please put this information directly in the booking information.
3. There is no choice for lunch. We would recommend a buffet vs. a plated meal.

Overall we had a great day, our guide was wonderful, and we learned a lot.

Sadly 1 hour free time in Monserrat. Not enough time to take the funicular or even hike to the cross. The guide was knowledgeable but kept asking us if we knew about this or that and expecting someone to explain what they knew. It was really awkward. At the winery the same guide explained the wines, or did she? She kept quizzing us on the color, flavors and smells putting people on the spot to answer and laughing when we didn’t know. At the end no one wanted to participate as she was being condescending. Definitely not what a professional sommelier would have done.
3 wine tastings and a plate with few tapas. Limited water.
Will not use this company again.

Great tour, well organized.
Luis, our tour guide, made it super fun and interesting. He can easily tell you about Barcelona, Montserrat or wines.

A beautiful experience. The Monastery is breathtaking with mesmerizing scenery. Our tour guide, Victor was awesome. He made the experience engaging and fun.

The wine testing was lovely and the facilities were beautiful.
Excellent. Loved it. Amazing experience. Must visit place. Guide was awesome. Thanks we would love to visit again

The trip to Montserrat was amazing! What made it extra special was our guide Dani! His passion for history, Catalonia and wine, along with his fun-loving personality, made it a day my wife and I will never forget! I can’t recommend Castlexperience, AND Dani, enough. If you find yourself in Barcelona, book this trip!

Wonderful day with Toni and the team. Weather was excellent, the views magnificent and the company was terrific. Couldn't have asked for a better day.

Well done.

We did not have a ton of pre-planned activities scheduled prior to leaving for Barcelona, but the one thing we were sure of was that we had to take this tour.

Montserrat was recommended to us by a friend, and once we found this tour we knew it was for us! Wine, tapas, and Catalan history? Yes, please! While we did not entirely know what to expect, our tour guide Max was extremely knowledgeable throughout the whole day. He was professional, yet very friendly and down to earth. He was able to articulate the information well, and even though we were coming from a place with very little knowledge of what we would encounter, Max was able to guide us and tell the wonderful story of Montserrat, weigh in on Barcelona's current political climate, and expertly teach about the wine from the region.

It was a little chillier than we expected (despite knowing this was on a mountain) so do bring an extra layer, especially if going in the winter time. Walking shoes and a camera are a must, especially if you want to move around Montserrat during the free time.

Overall this was an amazing experience and an absolute must see while in Barcelona. Thank you Max!!
Take this tour and ask for Agnes. It was the hi-light of our trip. We’ve already recommended it to 4 different people.
Fantastic day outside of Barcelona - seeing and tasting the local culture and cuisine. Highly recommend. Sergio, our tour guide, was great. Very knowledgable, helpful and friendly.

Our family of 4 had a wonderful time with Ona & Jorge on our tour of Montserrat.
We loved their stories of the area and the energy that they brought to our tour!
Toni was an excellent guide. the places visited are amazing. Monserrat is sensational. The visit to the winery was great.
I would highly recommend doing this trip. Out tour guide Ona was absolutely adorable and personable. She made us feel very welcome and included. The views are gorgeous and the winery was great!

Booked the trip last minute whilst on a weekend break in Barcelona and wasn't disappointed. Jordi was friendly, knowledgeable and humorous and was an excellent ambassador for the tour. He made it interesting and fun, whilst giving in depth history guide. Would recommend without hesitation

The guide talked too much. I get it we need the information but it could’ve been shortened. Maybe give out pamphlets. we get there and only have one hr to do something. I heard going to Montserrat by tour is cheaper than going alone. If I knew I would’ve be rushed I would’ve paid more to go alone But overall it was amazing. 2 c the Virgin Mary to the boys choir sing. Wine tour was cool. It’s not really a half day tour. Starts at 930 u get back by 5/530.

I had a fantastic time with Silvia leading our little group. The tour was really well run. Silvia was very professional with a vibrant personality, great fun and was very knowledgeable and passionate about both Monserrat and the wine industry. I appreciated the structure of the tour, including both explainations and sufficient free time for exploring as well. Silvia encouraged the group to be punctual, without feeling rushed at all. 

I also appreciated Silvia recognised an opportunity to visit the Black Madonna and the chapel and took us through after checking with the guard. I doubt this would of happened without Silvia's awareness, flexibility and knowledge.

It is definitely a day I won't forget. Thank you so much to Silvia and the team for a great experience!!

The tour to visit Montserrat and the winery were fantastic. Montserrat is amazing, and the tapas and wine tour were very tasty. Our tour guide, Marta, was very knowledgeable and pleasant, and I would highly recommend both this tour and Marta.

Outstanding tour, it was a very small group of 6 people guided to the perfection by one and the only Marta. Her impressive knowledge about both chief topics: history of Barcelona and wine indulgence made a joy of learning and entertainment for all of us on the tour a memorable experience. With Marta one can accomplish in 7 hours on this tour what, otherwise would have been an impossible task over a few days. Thumbs up!!

This was a fun day trip from Barcelona. I don’t think the tour would have been as fun if it wasn’t for my tour guide, Pep. He was so knowledgable plus hilarious. I loved learning about the history of Barcelona on the trip to Monserrat. If you can, try to ask for Pep. He was a lot of fun and a a wealth of knowledge.

My boyfriend and I participated in the half day tour at Monserrat, and it was magical! Not only did we get to see the beautiful monastery from the outside, WE GOT TO GO INSIDE! This was rare for our tour guide, Toni, and to many public tours that occur on the monastery, something I was unaware of when booking, so this was something extra special! While inside we got extra views and I was able to touch and say a prayer with the Black Madonna.

It felt like everything thing this day was going right. To top the experience off, our tour guide, Toni, provided us with an entertaining yet informative history lesson about Barcelona, Monserrat, and the winery we attended. Toni is friendly, enthusiastic, and a wonderful tour guide who went the extra mile to provide ya with great food recommendations after our half day tour.

I have nothing but great things to say about the tour! I felt honored to be able to visit the inside of the monastery. I believe that without the enthusiasm of Toni’s love for his work I do not believe we would have made it with through those doors in time. Highly recommend and if you are lucky to get Toni, you will be very pleased!

Wonderful Day Tour!!! Marta was our tour guide and she was the BEST tour guide I have ever had the pleasure to have for any tour experience!!! SHe made the trip! She was very relaxed, knowledgable and entertaining!!! We spent 8 hours with Marta and our group and it went by in a flash. She made everyone feel welcomed, had us share our names with others in our group so that we could interact with eachother if we wanted. My brother and I had a nice small group to spend the day with once we arrived in Monserrat. We met the guides at Placa Catalunya (by Hard Rock) and boarded the bus for one hour ride to the mountain. We took a short train ride to the building where after some history, we had about 75 minutes to explore on our own. There is a lot to see here and a lot of walking. There is a restaurant, museum, church and hiking spots. I chose the 20-30 minute steep hike up to a cross where there are amazing views.
We then boarded the bus for a short ride to a winery in site of the mountain. Marta gave us the tour here too and does an excellent job. We paid $15 extra for a full lunch and we were very happy with it. We had duck and the restaurant did a good job. Lunch included a bottle of wine for 4 to share. We had more wine at the tasting and Marta gave a great, relaxed wine tasting lesson and made that a fun ending to an awesome day!!! Thank you Marta, Louise and Dan from Maine, USA

Our first time in Barcelona and after 6 days in the city we decided to go further afield. We looked at all the options and chose this tour. My wife and I just loved the tour, it was excellent and we'll no doubt do another one next time.
Rubi was one of the best guides I have ever met (and I had just got off a Mediterranean cruise and had done 12 other tours so had met a lot of them in the last few weeks) he was clearly very intelligent, well prepared and highly entertaining - we loved having him as a guide
We also liked how the team of guides took it in turns to entertain and enlighten us and the whole busload.
Thanks for a magical day from us (now back at work in NZ)

Super trip to Montserrat and winetasting! Ona, our guide, did a very good job (5*) - and the food at the winery was also tasty. Only minus was I didn’t like the wines that much and think 3 types to taste was too few-on other similar trips in other countries, we have received 5-6. But other than that, a good day!

First and foremost, Sergio was a fantastic tour guide!

My girlfriend and I took the tour today and had the best time. From start to finish, this tour was well organized and fun! Sergio was super knowledgeable and very funny so we had an excellent time learning about Catalonian culture and tasting wine.

You won’t be sorry for booking this excursion. As a quick note - if you’re wondering if the half day is all you will need in Montserrat, it is. You’ll have plenty of time to do everything you want to.

You’re gonna love it!

We had the best time on this tour. Perfect for a short trip to Barcelona as you still have plenty of time when you return to the city to see other attractions so it does not take up an entire day.

We loved having Toni as our guide - very friendly and helpful!! Definitely recommend having him as your guide.

The weather was beautiful the day we went so we got lucky with that. Wine was delicious, beautiful winery. Montserrat is wonderful to visit, lots of yummy cheeses to try and beautiful views.

Definitely would recommend this tour to anyone visiting Barcelona!

The wine tasting was very good and exceeded expectations. Our guide ANA was fantastic. Very knowledgeable regarding the wines and the production process. ANA is a huge asset to your company. I would recommend this tour to friends. Good job.

Rubi our guide was really pleasant, enjoyable and fun! He explained everything and activity along the way! He also made sure we got to snap pics and have time to spend socializing. I was fortunate to be on the tour with wine enthusiatists and met really good people. The transportation was really comfortable as well. Definitely recommend this tour.

We set out for Monserrat on a dark, rainy day with Castlexperience Wine Tours which we had booked before leaving Australia. We had a wonderful tour guide, Daniel, who entertained us from beginning to end. He was incredibly knowledgeable and spoke such perfect English, had a great sense of humour and was fascinating to listen to. With thunder crashing and lightning flashing in the sky we were up in the ethereal world of Monserrat. It was amazing even though we couldn’t go up the funicular. The samples we tasted at the markets and the liquors we had were delicious! As for the wine tour and tapas - wow! I would thoroughly recommend this tour to everyone and hopefully you’ll be lucky and have Daniel as your guide!

Whole day was great from the cog wheel train up the mountain to the monestry at the top and some amazing views. Clara our guide was enthusiastic & very knowledgable on Barcelona, Montserrat & wine tasting. The wine tasting was very good with a selection of very nice wines and a lovely tapas lunch, first class day out.

I really enjoyed this trip. Marta was the guide and she was fabulous. She gave our group good suggestions for our free time in Montserrat. She was knowledgeable about the area. The wine tasting was nice. The wines were good and we also tasted a vermouth. The tasting experience is very casual but the wine portions were generous. This was a nice way to see an interesting location outside Barcelona while here on business. Many, many thanks to Marta!
Great experience, we enjoyed the different activities and Sergio is a very nice, enthousiastic guide! I highly recommend the tour!

Loved the tour with Laura. She was very attentive, warm and informative. We started with a entertaining history of Barcelona on the bus ride up to the cog wheel train. While up at the Monastary, Laura gave us a good history of the place. Loved the hike up to the cross on the mountain side. The views were spectacular. We followed up with wine tasting. The wine offered by Castle winery was ok. But then I am spoiled by California wines :-)
It was a nice place and a well organized tour. Comfy bus and lovely guides. Enough free time to see the places, make photos, walk around.

We had a wonderful time visiting Montserrat. Our tour guide Aina was wonderful.
Very knowledgeable, friendly and considerate. The wine tour was exceptional as well.
Great food and vino! We thoroughly enjoyed it.

Incredible tour. Our guide, Mercedes, gave us bits of history of the monastery and gave us options as to what to while there. I opted for the museum and was surprised by the depth of art there. It wasn’t obvious on the site that this museum was there: Monet, Renoir, Picasso, Dali, Pissarro plus so much more. Then listened to the boys choir sing two songs (all we had time for) and it was so spiritual to listen to these angelic voices in this sacred space. Then off to the winery for tasting of three wines and some cured meat and cheeses. Beautiful scenery. Mercedes has a depth of knowledge of the winemaking process and regional wines. So happy with this tour! Note that it says half day but it’s a full day with travel time.

We really enjoyed this tour. We'd been to Montserrat in the 70s; it is now overcrowded but still fascinating. Marik and the other tour leader Albert kept the bus tour interesting but the icing on the cake was the winery tour and wine-tasting, hosted by those two guides. Great tour, great wine, great sights...great value in this tour.

Our guide Pep did a great job every step of the way educating us on what we were seeing and why it mattered. He was able to do it with personality and humor, which made it easier to pay attention. The site itself was spectacular. I’d say it was the right mix of activity, free time, and snacks.

I loved this tour Marta and Mercedes were very knowledgeable about the history of the monastery and the surrounding areas.
Don’t miss this tour it was great...

The bus ride to Montserrat was wonderful. Ana and Luis did a fabulous job explaining the history of the area… They were also a lot of fun! The views were amazing. The black Madonna was awesome! I definitely recommend this trip. The wine tasting was another wonderful experience!

The Monsterrat and winery tour with Pol was great! He was very knowledgable about the area and provided a fantastic tour - a good mix of history, walking, eating, and drinking. He mentioned lots of local things like what to eat, see, and do. He also recommended great restaurants. Overall, I would recommend the tour to anyone and would definitely go on it again. Thanks for everything!

This was the highlight of our trip to Barcelona! We met so many nice people and Laura did a fantastic job as our tour guide! The bus was so clean and comfortable with huge windows to view the scenery! The history of the monastery was incredible. We enjoyed every minute there! Then we went on to the winery which was also amazing! The wines were fresh and delicious! The tapas were delightful and we had a very relaxing and interesting time! A must do if you are in Barcelona! Ask for Laura! She was awesome!

The tour was amazing and the Exceptional Tour Guide made it even better! Thank you Pol for an awesome time we would highly recommend this tour to anyone who wants to see beautiful sites and experiance a wonderful time. If your lucky you might get POL as your tour guide! Thanks again for an excellent trip!

Thanks to all the team. Everything was perfectly organised and we had the chance ti have a breathtaking view from Mont Serrat.
My daughter and I had an amazing day and a wonderful time. We wish to personally thanks our sweet and great guide Laura!!! Places are beautiful but your kindness and professionalism made them very special for us. Thank you for that perfect day. Karen and Emilie.

This is a fantastic way to spend a day and get a bit of knowledge of Catalan culture. Our guide, Clara, was an absolute sweetheart, very kind, and smart. She explained everything to us about the food we ate, the wines we drank and the vistas we explored. The winery we went to was lovely and has been in the same family for 37 (!) generations! I would definitely recommend this tour as a way to see a bit of the life outside of Barcelona.
The ride up mountain was great the blackmadana was worth the trip the church was great the views was the best

We absolutely loved our experience on the tour of Montserrat and Oller del Mas! Our tour guide, Marta, was incredibly knowledgeable and friendly, and ensured everyone enjoyed the tour. We appreciated her humour and energy so much! 110% would recommend this tour if you are going to Barcelona -- it is a must see!

Our guide was Clara and we enjoyed ourselves from start to finish.
She was very knowledgeable, humours and helpful.
The tour itself was thoroughly enjoyable, with Montserrat being quite impressive and the winery a delight.
The tasting in the winery storeroom was great fun. We welcomed the cheese and jamon options.

A tip to travellers that get motion sickness though, be sure to take a tablet in the morning before departing. The windy roads up and down the mountain can be a bit much.

Great tour. The tour guide was amazing. The only down part is that we did not get to see the Black Madonna. The line is too big. We hiked to the top for amazing scenery. Had amazing cheese and sweet bread. The winery was amazing. Definitely a must

A “half day” tour that actually ended a quarter past 5:00pm, this Montserrat Tour was great fun, and informative. We got paired with guide Agnès, who had a great sense of humour, and enough energy to keep everyone engaged throughout. At lunch, she explained the various tapas we were eating, as well as a mini course on the various wines on offer at the winery we were touring. Refreshingly, while you can certainly choose to buy a bottle of wine, there’s no pushy sales pitch. Montserrat was, as expected, beautiful and we got an hour and a half to wander around by ourselves and take in the nature.

I would highly recommend Dani as a guide leader. He was friendly and knew the history of the area. The absolute best thing about Dani was that he was able to get me into the church at Montserrat to attend mass. That was an experience of a lifetime and I will be forever grateful for this opportunity, which would not have happened without Dani’s help.
We used this trip to meet up with American friends who were visiting Barcelona. What a day! And our guide Daniel made it extra special. Thank you for a wonderful day.

My wife and I were very greatfull to have Max as our guide. He spoke perfect English and was very informative. He truly cared that we got the most from our time on the mountain. His knowledge of the wines we shared was very good also. We recommend this tour and Max is a must!

We really enjoyed our visit to Montserrat. We were able to see the Boys Choir perform at 1 PM for a little while before we had to leave. Tried to do the funicular to the top, but ran out of time waiting in line. Borja was a great guide and a lot of fun, very knowledgeable about the history of Montserrat and the region in general. We are from California and have toured many wineries there, this one was OK, but the highlight was definitely Montserrat.

We booked this specific tour because it says we will be touring a 10th century winery Oller Del Mas and stated we would be provided with tapas so “no need to budget for lunch” NOPE! They take you to some tiny, clearly unpopular winery. We were only given about 1.5 oz pours of 3 terrible wines and then 9-10 thin slices of cheese and bread to share with 2 other people. TERRIBLE!!!! DO NOT BOOK! YOU WILL BE LIED TO AND BROUGHT SOMEWHERE ELSE.

I had a fabulous day on the tour. The smaller groups were great, the tour guides knowledgable and also engaging and passionate about the region and culture.

Clara was excellent and deserves acknowledgement for her work. She really loves what she does and it shows.

Montserrat and the winery were very beautiful places, lunch provided was excellent.

It's a full day but well worth the trip.

All up, a very wonderful day.

We were honored to be part of Ona’s first group to whom she gave the history of Barcelona - and she did a great job! The bus ride was quite pleasant, then we rode the “zipper” train up to Montserrat, then a bus ride from the top directly to the winery for a little charcuterie plate and sample portions of 4 of their wines. Ona and team provided great service, and my husband commented how informative and enjoyable the tour was. For my part, I appreciated that there were bathrooms all along the way (even before we boarded the first bus!) Many thanks for providing a well-planned day!
We loved our tour of Monserrat and the following winery tour and tasting. Our guide, Max, did a great job and added greatly to our enjoyment

We went with the guide Albert. It was a very Nice, funny and interesting trip. We was well taked care of and the guide was so great and told us interesting and funny history.
Nice day! The trip to Monserrat went quickly, could have more time there, we went with the funicular and walked to the cross and back and we have to hurry to go back.
The winegarden was great, good wine and tapas food.

What an experience to visit Montserrat! Our guides, Luis and Max, provided context and historical information with good humor and engaging the group. All this led to a great wine tour at the Oller del Mas Winery. Highly recommended!

We had a great time from pick up to drop off.
Our tour guide, Ana, was very friendly and we learned a lot from her about wines and the winemaking process. We also learned about the history of Montserrat and the Black Madonna.
The tapas were tasty, and although I generally don’t drink wine, the wine tasting portion was fun.
We spent our spare time at the museum, which I enjoyed because I had never seen a mummy in person.
The weather was chilly at Monserrat, so a light jacket was nice to have.

Luis was a terrific guide. Montserrat is a beautiful place to visit. We hiked up to the viewpoint, which was terrific. Even lucked out getting into the church to hear the boys choir. The winery visit was also lovely. Beautiful setting in the countryside.
All in all a great day trip. Would recommend without hesitation

Our trip to Montserrat was one of the highlights of our stay in Barcelona. Our guide , Ona, was a delight to be with. Her sunny disposition, sense of humour combined with a thorough knowledge of Montserrat made our visit very special. We then proceeded to the Oller del Mas Winery Tour where we were shown how the wine has been produced in this family for generations. Everyone was dedicated to making our experience ( tapas and wine testing helping) a very happy one indeed.

The museum adjacent to Montserrat is worth visiting it contains some major works by famous painters.

We would strongly recommend this trip.

Marie-Christine and Maryann

I dont know why Montserrat and winetasting is combined. There are two different themes, and the vineyard isnt even close to Montserrat. Thought it would be more of a package deal, but most of the trip is just wandering around, and the busride from barcelona to montserrat, then montserrat to the vinery.

The guides are good - lots of knowledge, humour and good english, but its the tour package thats lacking. Montserrat is nice and you get a good intro to what you can do and see there, but i honestly think you could go there on your own and figure it out. Its a nice place, but not a must see compared to sagrada de familia and parc guell. Then over to the vineyard later, where you dont really get to go into the vineyard, you just see the vine being made through a glass window, from a souvenirshop area. The winetasting and food is good, but you dont get the cultural feeling i thought i would get at the vineyard since its so modern and you are inside a dark room. We might as well have been at a fancy place in NY.

My rating is average because you get to go to Montserrat, and there is a winetasting with good wine. The guide was also great. But its definitely not a must do. I think it would be a better investment of time and money to find a local restaurant in barcelona rather than this tour.

While Montserrat is about an hour from Barcelona, the area is beautiful and has spectacular views. We hiked up to see the cross from Montserrat. While the hike is quiet steep in spots there are some level areas on the hike and the views once you arrive are absolutely incredible.
The visit to the winery was wonderful as well with views of Montserrat in the distance.
Our guide Mercedes was great - very entertaining and knowledgeable.
The only downside is that we would have loved to have a little more time exploring Montserrat.
We would recommend the tour - a must do!

Today's Monseratt tour was great.

We both enjoyed Marta's knowledge of the area en route, Monserat and the wine tour.

Especially enjoyed Marta's enthusiasm, informative, fun and humorous delivery.

A pleasure.

My sister and I decided to book this tour because we wanted to explore outside of Barcelona and because we love wine! It did not disappoint, and I’d definitely recommend this to anyone interested in the history and the culture of Catalonia.

A few great logistical details - this trip was simple to book, the itinerary was clear, and it was easy to find the tour guides the morning of. The bus ride to the Montserrat train was about an hour long, and one of the guides, Marta, offered funny and informational commentary to give some historical and cultural context for the tour. We then took a quick and scenic train up the mountain to the monastery, where our groups’ guide, Max, gave us a ton of details on the history. He was super helpful and knowledgeable throughout the day, giving us on what to take note of in the monastery and suggestions for our free time in the town.

The next stop was the winery - again, the bus ride was made more enjoyable by the fun and interesting commentary from the guides. At the winery, Max offered incredible insight into the long history of the winery and details on the wines themselves. And wine and tapas were great, too! We definitely bought some wine to
take home on our way out.

Overall, this was such an awesome experience made even better by the top-notch tour guides!
Highly recommend this tour! The guide Tony was amazing. The views are amazing and it’s a great escape from the city for a day!

This was one of the highlights for our stay in Barcelona. Alex, our guide was fantastic, with a great sense of humour and wonderful knowledge. The trip itself was worth it, with fantastic scenery, and the coaches used very comfortable.The Montserrat Monastery was very interesting and we also visited their museum which is well worth it. The Oller del Mas winery proved to be a great venue for our lunch, with basic but tasty Tapas and really enjoyable and unique wines which we enjoyed by everyone, and would surely also satisfy the wine aficionados too. Highly recommended.

This tour was one of the highlights of our trip to Barcelona. I highly recommend it. Montserrat is breathtaking and the wine was fantastic. It was also just the right amount of time to spend. Additionally Silvia was the most amazing guide! She was funny and knowledgeable and I learned a ton!

My friends and I did the half day tour of Montserrat with Silvia. It was incredible! The views and the architecture of Montserrat were stunning, and Silvia was a blast to have as a guide. She gave us tons of background information about Montserrat’s fascinating history. She even gave us a great wine tasting at one of the oldest wineries in the world outside of Montserrat. We all had a great time, and Silvia was an excellent tour guide. I would recommend this tour to anybody visiting Barcelona!

Our tour started out very fortuitous as we met our tour soul-mates from Australia while waiting to board the bus! We were the loud ones on the bus but our guide Ana kept up and continued the merriment on the way to the magnificent monastery of Montserrat. She was very fun and knowledgeable about the history of Barcelona and Spain and the sites we visited. The winery part of the tour was also fantastic and even more fun (with wine and tapas) and turned out Ana knew her stuff when it came to tasting those wines! Very enjoyable day and wouldn't have missed it for anything.- Made some new friends and great memories!!!

We toured Montesarrat and the winery on Tuesday with Marek. The day was exceptional. The tour guides were friendly and knowledgeable. I was traveling with my 82 year old mother and Marek was very attentive to her needs. Everything was perfect—-the food, the wine, the tour—even the bus ride. I highly recommend this tour

This tour was a great little surprise in Barcelona. The tour was well organised, assigning guides to each group (we had Toni, who was excellent, taking the time to get to know everyone in the group). The bus was comfortable and the trip up to Montserrat was smooth. There was a brief guided tour of Montserrat, followed by 2 hours to explore the place. The guides give a very good run down of activities and how much time each will take so you can plan what you will do (it's worth noting the line to see the Black Madonna can be huge and take over 2 hrs).
Oller del Mas is a beautiful vineyard and the lunch there was delicious (tapas of course) there were 3 generous wine tastings of some very good wines with lunch. The tour got back at 5.30pm, so there's still plenty of time to do more with your day if you'd like.
Highly recommended if you have a free day in Barcelona.

Our family took this all day tour and were placed with Maria as a guide. The tour was an excellent way to see Montserrat. The air conditioned buses made the heat tolerable and we were given plenty of free time at the mountain to explore the area that interested us and we even had time for gelato. Maria was quite knowledgeable on the monastery and its history. The winery was a nice complement to the tour. We tried wines that were unique and not readily available elsewhere and could purchase the ones we liked. Maria knew the winery and wines to the last detail. We thoroughly enjoyed this tour and would recommend it and Maria as a guide.

I enjoyed the tour a lot even I was doing it alone.
Thanks to my tour guide Silvia who is a knowledge, lovely and charming girl who brought up the vibes of the tour!

My partner and I spent a week in Barcelona so we decided to spend one day and explore the surroundings, so we made a decision to book this trip to Montserrat and the Winery tour. It was one of the best decisions we made during the trip - the monastery and mountain heights are breathtaking (literally, the bus trip was a bit scary for me, but really worth it). There was enough free time as well as part of the tour to explore the nature and go to some view points. Definitely recommended to take a small 15min hike to a cross on the cliff, offers beautiful views on the valley and the Monastery. Winery was located at a family estate that produces wine for generations, wine was quite tasty, we even bought a bottle, and the family castle is really a great venue. Wine Tasting experience in itself was not so glam (I have experienced some better ones) but quite funny and educational - we learnt how to estimate the wine's tastes and subtle notes. Our guide was great, super funny, very gifted linguistically. It was a well arranged and organised trip. Please be aware if you go in Summer to have water with yourselves, sunscreen, hats, etc, weather up the mountain is more extreme than in the city.
All in all, I would definitely recommend it!

I love this tour , this is great local tour company
On time pick up and good coach car
Explain detail of history during the tour like personal tour ! The lunch is good and tastes 3 wines organic , Yum !

especially Pol is very nice kind and pay attention on every minute to take care people . He is wonderful , hope this company will keep him long and train after, potential star good manager
Thank you very much Pol ! Wish you best

With best regards
Candy

We loved our tour to Monserrat. We would definitely reccomend it to other couples. The tour was informative and fun. Our tour guides Dani and Rubí were so friendly and couldn't do more for us. The wine tour was also great in the vineyard. Our favourite day in Barcelona.

We had a great time at Montserrat. Our tour guide Mercedes was fun, informative, and funny. She truly made our experience a highlight of the trip. She has such a pride for Spain and for Catalonia and was a brilliant ambassador for the culture and country. Keep her, she's great!
The most amazing Tour, our guide Borja made us most welcome and his knowledge of the history of Montserrat was exceptional. You must do this tour when in Barcelona, so much fun.

We really enjoyed our trip to Montserrat and the wine tour. We were in Carol’s group and she made the experience fantastic for our group. Her knowledge of Montserrat was very thorough and her wine and food information was very thorough and she was so upbeat and enthusiastic that you couldn’t but enjoy the day. We had people from Chicago, New Mexico and Toronto in our group and everyone was friendly and it was good to chat around the table at lunchtime with this group. I would recommend The Castle Experience to all who visit Barcelona as it was an excellent day and most enjoyable as well as good value for money.
10 out of 10 for Carol too.

Montserrat is a must see if you are in Barcelona the wine tour was the best way for us to see it and Marta, our guide, made the entire trip fun, carefree and engaging. Even the weather cooperated with us! The lunch at the winery was delicious and the wine was great! We laughed so hard the other groups wanted to join us!!!

Well worth the money. An excellent tour which was mainly due to the expertise of Alex our tour guide. Super friendly and polite, and so very knowledgeable. Montserrat is amazing, but Alex was the reason we loved it so much...thank you Alex!

There’s more to Barcelona than the gothic quarter and La Sagrada Familia - there are ancient castle wineries one should be drinking at, and magic Black Madonna statues guarded by monks for a 1000 years that have apparent healing powers in the incredible Mountain scenery of Montserrat - so do yourself a favour and devote a half or full day to this tour!! Borja our guide gave us the history, showed us where we could try the best local food ( the best souvenirs are food he will tell you) and generally just make sure we had the best time ever. Total highlight of this trip to Spain!!

This is the greatest day tour we have at Barcelona. The guide Ana speaks very good English. On the way she has given lively information about Barcelona and Montserret, the history, legends, development, and a bit of culture of Spain and Catalunya... etc, realistic and humourous. The journey is pleasant and we enjoyed it. Montserrat has great scenery with the park and monastery. We did not have enough time to try the trails around. The black holy Mary is actually quite small and hard to see from the church. The queue was too long if we want to touch it. The wine tour in the afternoon was great. Ana is so familar to the place with great introduction of the vinyard, the plantaton, the making method and the types of wine, etc. We had a great tasting with cold cuts and cheese, yummy! Everything is great , we enjoyed it a lot. Recommend.

We have a fantastic time on this tour! We thoroughly enoyed Sylvia our tour guide. She was very knowledgeable and accomodating. We were very impressed by her vast knowledge of the winery and wine making process! We will definitely be going back when we return next year! If you love wine, this is a must tour to take while you're in Spain. It will not disappoint!

Very nice trip, excellent guide Mercedes! Thank you!
We had a lovely day in Monserrat and at the wine yard.

We only spend 4 days in Barcelona and decided to spend our last day out of the city. Really great trip! Nice view, on the top of the mountain. And good tapas with wine. The guide Agnes was fantastic and very enthousiastic !

Jordi was the best tour guide that we’ve had in our overall tour around Europe. His fluency in speaking English is excellent. He’s so knowledgeable, fun and very entertaining. Our experience in Montserrat became extra special because of our great understanding of their culture and history provided by Jordi. I highly recommended this tour to my friends, family and colleagues. I would definitely come back and do this again. This is a must when in Barcelona 😊👍

My husband and I had an amazing time on this trip! Meeting with the group was very easy outside Hard Rock Cafe. Our guide Toni was very knowledgeable with a great sense of humor. All the transportation was very nice and comfortable. Monserrat is beautiful and we felt like we had enough time to see everything we wanted. The samples at the farmers market were incredible and we enjoyed the complimentary liquor tasting. Everyone was very friendly. Oller Del Mas was beautiful and the wines were all delicious. The tapas were yummy and they accommodated dietary restrictions. Overall it was a relaxing way to experience two great places near Barcelona. I definitely recommend!

My husband and I took this tour as a way to see more than just the city of Barcelona and it was so worth it. We had Alex as a tour guide and he made the tour so fun and was very knowledgeable.I highly recommend this tour if you enjoy history and obviously WINE! Plus the views from Montserrat are unbelievable!

We had a fabulous experience. Rubi, our chief guide, and Toni, who led the wine tasting, were wonderful in every way - they had such knowledge about the history, were so funny and charming and made our two children feel so welcome. Our kids didn’t even get bored for the wine tasting because Rubi kept them entertained with grape juice in wine glasses and good humor. We were very impressed with Toni’s knowledge of wine and the history behind the castle. This was such a treat for us and we hope Rubi and Toni get recognized for the special care they took with us. We are sending lots of good wishes to Rubi for his upcoming wedding!

Ana was a fabulous guide. Great history lesson of the area during bus trip. This was a great day for our family. We really enjoyed the trip to Monserrat and Oller dl Mas. Especially since we didn’t have to do any of the driving.

Jim K.

The good start was that the guide was standing exactly where the tour company said and the exact time.. with her pink umbrella. There were a number of tours travelling together and our guide was Mercedes. She has the right personality to make for an informative and fun day. Montserrat is awesome in the true sense of that word. There was a lot of free time after Mercedes had taken us through the complex to the Basillica. The afternoon was a little underwhelming after the monestry but I would still choose it. The bus driver was excellent on the difficult terrain. Good value for $.

Montserrat is stunning and the castle winery tour was really nice. I would make sure to eat a hearty breakfast beforehand because the food during the winery tour is pretty light (meat and cheese plate) and we didn't get back until 5:30pm. My specific tour guide noted that he hadn't given a tour in a while so he seemed a bit less practiced at Montserrat. He could have provided a little more context about some of the history but he made up for it with his thorough details at the wine tasting. It was a really nice day trip and there are options for a variety of interests/accessibility needs (museum or basilica tour if you want to be indoors, easy hike up to the cross of Sant Miguel if you'd prefer more activity -- my choice).

Laura was a perfect tour guide, she was happy, funny and very attentive to our group. She made an effort to learn our names which was sweet and got to know each of us individually. She was very knowledgeable and I would highly recommend her to anyone!

Our tour guide Carol was absolutely amazing!
She was so knowledgeable and kind the entire day. She was full of energy. She made us laugh. She taught us all sorts of things about Spain and wine and the culture and history of this amazing country. She even gave us some of her personal favorite dinner recommendations in Barcelona. We would 100% go an another tour with her. She deserves a bonus or a raise!
Thank you for hiring her and letting us spend the day with her.
Beautiful Experience Awesome guide didn't expect for it to be as nice as it was...the Winery being Organic was a bonus

My family of 7 went with the carriage, wine, and dinner tour. The carriage ride was easy on the body and very informative, with beautiful sites to see; the wine tasting was very professional and in a great setting. The staff were great, very friendly and attentive to us, especially to my mother, who is in a wheelchair. The lunch was amazing --- 3 course meal with several great chooses. A definite must if you visit Barcelona.

Fantastic half day tour, excellent value.
Finding the guide who directed us to Carol, our tour guide for the day was easy

CAROL was informative and casual but with enough authority to keep us on time

Tapas great and the wine tasting with the castle setting fantastic

Monestary beautiful

No complaints 

Highly recommend

Well done to all!

Very good day out with interesting comments from Pep, our guide. Besides visiting the monastery there was time for a decent walk to St Michael's cross which had great views. Winery good with good tapas. Personally not sure what doing the longer tour with more time in Montserrat would have added as not much else to see there.

Found this tour thru the Sandeman site, and it was like striking gold. Jordi was my guide and he is an amazing individual whom was extremely knowledgeable and great at what he does. Tour brought us into the Montserrat monastery first where even though it was Good/Holy Friday, I was able to get a chance to see the Black Madonna. Next the tour took us to the Oller del Mas winery for more history, tapas, and wine. For a non-wine drinker such as myself, I thoroughly enjoyed it and having Jordi as my guide!

Such a unique and beautiful tour that gets you outside the city of Barcelona. The Basilica was amazing on its own, but to then get to have tapas and wine in a 13th century castle was the icing on the cake! If you get motion sick, take precautions as the bus travels winding mountain roads as you near Montserrat.

This was one of the best tours I have taken while in Europe. Merak was an excellent guide and gave good advise while at Montserrat. Lived the interaction and historical information provided while in route to Montserrat and winery. If you are looking for a day trip to Montserrat, look no further. You will not be disappointed.
We had the best day!!! Dani was good fun...the group we were with made our day. Beautiful place!!! So much to do and see

This tour was one of my favorites on our trip to Spain. We chose the tapas option to limit how long we would be gone from Barcelona.
Our guide, Carolina Castellano, was extremely friendly, helpful, and honest. I feel usually you get a guide who toes the line when it comes to political discussion/history, but Carol gave us her best objective view as well as her subjective opinion.
First, we took a bus out towards Montserrat as our guide gave us a brief history lesson of the city of Barcelona and the current political atmosphere, explaining the yellow ribbons everywhere. About 40 minutes later, we arrived at a station to take the cogwheel tram up the cliffs to the monastery. The cogwheel tram was pretty neat and you get some good views out over the cliffs.
Once we reached the top of the tram track, Carol started listing things to do during our hour of free time that would be coming up. We were guided through the monastery grounds and into the basilica. After a viewing of the basilica, we were given an hour to explore on our own. A few of us briskly made our way up to the cross that offers a breathtaking, panoramic view of Montserrat. Then we walked back to the basilica to hear the choir boys sing. Finally, we made our way to the shop to get our tasting of liqueur. There was a farmers' market that we didn't have time to see.
We loaded up on the bus to head to Oller del Mas.
Oller del Mas is a rebuilt castle where the winery has been passed down in one family for many, many generations. Only in the last 20 years have they commercialized the wine. The cobbled floors and old decor have you feeling you've traveled to the past.
I don't know much about Spanish wine. Or wine at all for that matter. Either way, I enjoyed drinking wine, eating cheese, jamon, and other tapas while discussing what we smell and taste in the wines. Our guide was not snobby, thankfully. She invited us to be honest and talk about what we can taste. We purchase a few bottles to bring back to the states. Some of the bottles at the winery you can't buy outside the walls.
Overall, a very positive experience. We had a great guide and a fun group that allowed everyone to be more open and laid back. If you have the time for a half day trip, I would definitely recommend this!

I took this tour while visiting my daughter studying in Barcelona this semester.

I wasn’t expecting much, but, I must say, that I was quite pleased with this afternoon out of the city.

Oller de Mas produces some nice wines, but one in particular I favor. As opposed to me telling you about it, though, I would suggest that you ask to be guided by Clara—and let her tell you.

As I noted to her company, Clara is a little gem. Incredibly knowledgeable about the wines, but also the area’s topography, history, and Catalan culture. She literally made the trip that much more worthwhile.

This is a great adventure when you find yourself with a free afternoon.

My wife and I booked the Montserrat & the Oller de Mas winery with this group, opting for the half day visit, which was ideal. Our tour guide, Pep, was fantastic, providing an informative insight into the history & culture of the area, delivered with often hysterical humour. There was plenty of time available to visit the Monastery & take a short hike (not for the faint Hearted) up to St Michael's cross, where you can take in some breathtaking views. You are then whisked off to the local winery for some tapas & tasting of their wines (1 White, 2 Reds) which you have opportunity to purchase before you head on back to Barca.
The half day tour (08:30 - 15:30) was perfect, representing good value for money and is well worth a visit.

I think it is a good place to visit, certainly great for those who are religious and want to see history. Overall, I think the tour is too long, I does take a little drive to get there from the city, but they can cut the tour short and you can still have enjoyment. This would be a place I would either rent a car and drive, or take a short visit unless you plan on hiking the mountain. the church is beautiful, nice boys choir and the see the monks. The wine tour was okay! the food was not bad, but if you are looking to walk the vineyards, have wine and cheese on the balcony (not going to happen). Our tour guide was good he was the brightest light next to the church.

The tour was AMAZING. It was one of my favorite days of my trip. It was the perfect pace, the right amount of guided experience and free exploration time, a group great of people, and Merak was a really wonderful, friendly, funny guide! Plus he let me practice Spanish with him the whole bus ride and shared such interesting stories about his travel adventures! I would recommend the tour to anyone. The price was rather reasonable as well, especially considering the delicious tapas and wine at Oller.
A fabulous experience that was enhanced by the knowledge and humour of our guide Dani. He is a credit to the company and I would certainly recommend both the tour and him

We have to thank Agnes for her commitment and happy tour! Me and my girlfriend just loved the tour, it was our first time in Montserrat and with Castle experience it is definitely worth it because you also visit a traditional wine cellar - Oller del Mas!
Once again, thank you so much for your hospitality

We had a really nice and enjoyable tour. Our leader Luis was great - good knowledge of history, recommendations for what worth to be seen there and tips how to do it, fantastic relationship with the group :) The monastery, the winery and this experience I will remember forever. Thank you, Luis! Many thanks to the other leaders as well - Dani and Marta! :) Regards, Bilyana

Pep was very friendly and super knowledgeable of the Barcelona & Montserrat history.
We highly recommend this tour and Pep as a top notch guide.
Our tour guide for the day Pol was amazing. Gave us a brief but interesting history on Barcelona and was extremely knowledgeable on Montserrat and the wines. 👍🏼A definite “must”!
Our tour guide Alex was wonderful, the tapas were delicious (we are vegetarian and they accommodated) small group experience. Will recommend to our friends.

Our guide Carol was awesome! She and Pep explained a lot about Catalonia on the bus with a great sense of humor! When we approached the Montserrat, thick fog yielded visibility of like 1 meter. Our bus driver safely got us there. After Carol's guided tour of the Montserrat center, we were hoping for the fog to clear up. By the time we reached the cross, it mostly did! We could take fantastic photos of the Montserrat from the cross.
We had the goat cheese (Mató) and honey as snack from the farmer's market.
We were then driven to the winery. I bought a couple of bottles which were reasonable. Tapas for the tasting were delicious (especially the olive oil provided).
This tour was very popular on the day we participated, but Castlexperience guides did a good job managing the large group. My guide, Carol, even gave me her number just in case we were lost whilst wondering around in the Montserrat.
I highly recommend this tour.

It was an outstanding experience for us: we enjoyed it so much. In particular, the guide from Castelexperience, Dani and Clara were both excellent: they were not just helpful, but took the extra mile to ensure we all were fully satisfied. Also they were knowledgeable on the history, local area and winery too.

Great experience and I will recommend your company to my friends.
Really enjoyed this trip to Montserrat & Oller de Mas winery. Ana, our tour guide, was fantastic - very friendly, energetic & well-informed. I would highly recommend this tour.

My mom and I came to Barcelona not knowing what to do. We had a few free days after visiting many of the local sites in the city. Our hotel navigator suggested this tour especially since I LOVE wine. So we decided to go ahead and go on this tour.

Right away from the moment we checked in, there was just an atmosphere of positivity and fun. Jordi was our tour guide and he was super kind, helpful, and accommodating.
