He felt more like a friend than a tour guide, which was nice. He took the time to personally introduce himself to each person and made an effort to try to get to know us.

The tour itself was an amazing experience and if I ever do come back to Barcelona, I will definitely come back and go on this tour again. Honestly, I have nothing except good things to say about both, the tour, as well as Jordi.

Thank you for such an awesome experience!!

The overall trip was outstanding. Seeing Montserrat and doing a small bit of hiking was fabulous. Incredibly beautiful area a short distance from the city. The lunch was excellent as well. Since the food was served family style, we were able to make new friends and it was a lot of fun. The winery tour as well done too. Scenery as incredible. Great views turned into great pictures! Wine as good as well.
One of the best parts of the tour was our guide, Clara. Her knowledge of the area, sites and winery operations is amazing. She's articulate, helpful, and makes good suggestions to make the trip better. She was OUTSTANDING. Wonderful trip. We'd all do it again.

We loved this approximately 7-hour-long tour! We met up at Plaça de Catalunya where we were directed to join our guide Miguel and the rest of our small group. We would be sharing our bus with a few other groups as we headed to our first stop. Along the way one of the guides on our bus gave us a super funny run through of Barcelona's history.

We finally arrived at Montserrat, where we had a 45-minute guided tour of the area with Miguel followed by an hour of free time (more than the tour description lists, which was nice). The mountains themselves are beautiful, truly a sight to behold. As you can imagine, having limited time here can have its disadvantages. Even though we had an hour of free time that was nowhere near enough time to wait in line to touch the famous Black Madonna.

I also highly encourage anyone who does this tour to grab a snack at one of the cafes here at Montserrat, because you won't be eating your tapas lunch until after the wine tour. My sister and I shared an Iberian ham sandwich, so we had something to hold us over until our late tapas lunch.

On our drive from Montserrat to the Oller del Mas vineyard we passed this eerie stretch of land which was the victim of a 3 day long fire in July 2015. Firefighter Marc Sellares later returned to the area and carved 1,200 crosses out of the burned trees. It's now called El Bosc de les Creus, or the Forest of Crosses and serves as a memorial to the lost woodland. Honestly it's pretty creepy but also pretty cool. It felt very Tim Burton-esque.

Finally we arrive at Oller del Mas, a vineyard, wine cellar, and 10th century castle half an hour from Montserrat. The castle was founded in 964 AD, but many parts were rebuilt after Napoleon's reign. The current owner Frank is the 36th generation of the same family running this vineyard.

This is a chateau winery, meaning all of the wine making steps are done here onsite. Also all the wines made here are ecological aka organic. After a tour of the castle where we learned a bit more about aging the wines (all done in French oak casks, which are milder than other oaks), and a look at the view from the roof top, we sat down for our tapas lunch and wine tasting around 1:30 pm.

There were a couple different options for this tour. One included a multi-course meal, and the other a lighter tapas lunch. Honestly, the tapas were quite satisfying, however it didn't hurt that we also ate a sandwich earlier at Montserrat.

After a fun and informative meal and wine tasting, we headed back to the bus for our drive back to Barcelona. This was a fun adventure outside of Barcelona which I would highly recommend to visitors to the city.

This tour was just the right amount of time for a day tour leaving around 8:45a.m. and getting back about 3:00p.m. A very pleasant bus ride up to Montserrat. Our tour guide Xavi Roses was very knowledgeable and gave us plenty of time on our own after his tour to explore the area. Another bus ride to the winery gave us time to relax after exploring Montserrat. The winery tour is both educational and very good wine to taste.

Fantastic tour and tour company! I did the half-day trip to Montserrat and Oller del Mas Winery. Every element of it was perfectly timed and executed. Our tour guide, Dani, was wonderful. He provided interesting historical information in just the right amounts. I was traveling solo but was completely comfortable on this trip. Dani referred to us all as 'familia' and it certainly felt like family by the end of the day. I would highly recommend Castlexperience and this tour. TIP: I didn't dress warm enough for the November weather. It was about 20 degrees colder at Montserrat than in Barcelona. Warmer at the winery but inside, where we had tapas for lunch, was freezing (it is a castle so understandable). Dress warm or in layers - check the weather forecast.

We went on this trip the 22:nd of November. This was a day trip to remember! Everything was working like a clock. Professional staff from pick up, during the trip until the end.
Everything that was promised at booking confirmation is correct!
Not to speak about our lovely guide Aurora..😍. So much energy, knowledge and joyfulness is hard to find! We were very lucky with the weather, but she made our day perfect with alot of history and stories. You can tell she enjoys her job! Thank you Aurora 😍, the team of guides and driver.
Paula & Tasos from Cyprus.

The best part of the Excursion was Agnes - she was enthusiastic and personable. She was extremely knowledgeable about Montserrat and the castle with the wine tasting. We thoroughly enjoyed everything.

I missed my original schedule but their customer friendly staff was very accommodating so I got on the next available tour. Simply fantastic because I enjoyed every minute of it. Pol our host/tour guide was very knowledgeable about the overall history of Barcelona and was fluent in English. He was also warm, friendly and very professional. The tour was very well organized and the places we visited were amazing. The views from Montserrat was breathtaking! Thank you for making this a memorable trip Pol et al!

We did the full-day Montserrat plus tapas and wine tour. We fully realized that this is a large tour group, as we normally would try to do something a bit more intimate or specialized, but this was a great price and had tapas and wine included. Our group consisted of about 14 people and we checked-in at the downtown plaza and then rode in a large bus with another group approximately the same size (both tours part of the same company). Our guide was Luis, who was beyond terrific (more on him at the end).

It was just over an hour drive to the cog wheel train, with a lot of historical information pointed out on our way out of town (another reason why having a guide is beneficial rather than driving ourselves). We arrived and waited for ~10 or so minutes (it was “high” season for tourists there), then took the train up to Montserrat. We walked around and toured as a group (14 of us) for about 45 minutes, then ventured out on our own for close to an hour. My wife and I were the only ones in our group that hiked to St. Michael’s cross, which I highly recommend! It’s about 20 to 25 minutes up if you don’t make many stops – all on impervious surfaces, so hiking shoes aren’t necessary, but I’d suggest tennis shoes or comfortable walking shoes at least. The views from here are breathtaking! The walk back is about 15 minutes (mostly downhill). I’d suggest taking some water for the uphill climb, as it’s a decent workout if you go at a decent pace – but again, it’s not very long.

We had tickets to do a liquor tasting of what’s produced there at the monastery (included in the tour) so we quickly went there to get some samples before meeting back up with the group. The hazelnut was by far my favorite!

Next, the group met back up and we took a different bus (4 tour groups total now) to head to the winery. We dropped two of the groups off at a lunch location, then our original two groups headed to the winery. We started off with a bit of history about the winery (Oller del Mas) and a tasting of one of their wines, then did a tour of their facility (really neat history). Then we went to one of their barrel rooms and were seated at a large table for (cold) tapas and wine. Note, it’s a winery, not a restaurant, so our expectations weren’t to taste the most incredible tapas of Spain, but they were plenty sufficient and of course went well with the wine. We tasted two whites and two reds, which were very different than typical Spanish wines (Rioja, Priorat, etc.). Luis explained a number of things related to the wine during the tasting, which I was quite impressed with considering he’s not a sommelier or a worker at the winery. After the wine was finished, we did a quick walk around the grounds and tried a couple of the grapes hanging on the vines (harvest had just begun). I was again impressed by Luis’ knowledge of the varietals and the methods of the winery.

Finally, we took the bus back and Luis pointed out a number of other things along the way. We were incredibly thankful we had Luis as our guide on this trip, as he was funny, jovial, and clearly wanted his guests to have a great time. He was even gracious enough to share some tips with my wife and I for our upcoming stay in the Canary Islands (he has family from there), which we were so grateful for. We can’t recommend Luis enough! Thank you for the wonderful tour!

Montserrat is interesting shaped and rugged Mountain and our coach tour up the mountain to the Basilica was very scenic. The Basilica has wonderful views and inside is beautiful. We didn't see the resident monks but it is used for services daily and naturally you have to be respectfully quiet at these times. There is a gift shop and cafe available. After our tour of Montserrat it was time for the winery tour. Our coach took us about 30 minutes to the winery where we toured the vine yard then had a tasty lunch. Our guide then served the 3 wines. We got information about each wine and the opportunity to purchase but no hard sell in fact it was briefly mentioned. The wine was very nice. Our guide for the tour was called Aurora. She was helpful friendly and generally a perfect host. I would recommend thus to anyone who fancy a easy going little bit of culture beyond Barcelona city.

We only had a few days in Barcelona, but really enjoyed this tour and we are glad we went on it. The views from Montserrat are amazing and we had a good time taking a short little hike during our free time. The winery was also beautiful and great food/wine during the tasting. We had a funny, personable tour guide as well.

Enjoyed the tour overall. I usually prefer doing tours with smaller groups, but this was a 2-3 guides of 12-15 people groups in a large bus. Montserrat got very busy. The wine tasting was very good. Simon was great!

This excursion was a wonderful experience! In my 5 days here to date, nothing has equalled my enjoyment of this tour. I've been on perhaps 80 vacations, and tend to be a bit picky when reviewing events.

We had the good fortune to draw Carol as our guide. She is very knowledgeable, has a good sense of humour, and provided each of us clearly what to do and timing with tact & diplomacy so we could relish every moment and not worry when to move on to our next activity. She briefed us in advance on the positive as well as things that were less feasible to try.

I've done wine tasting in many locations including Napa and Sonoma in CA, as well
as many others. This was superior to all of those.

In short, this tour was an experience of a lifetime.

Clara was a wonderful tour guide. She was informative and knew everyone's name in a matter of minutes. She is definitely one of the better tour guides we have had while vacationing. The tour was great, Montserrat and Oller del Mas were amazing. Clara gave a great overview of the Montserrat and the winery. My wife and I would recommend this to anyone looking for a day trip outside Barcelona.

What a wonderful trip we had with our extra special guide Albert on 25th September. I booked the Montserrat and Winery visit half day tour as a treat for my wife on our 25th wedding anniversary and it was better than I had expected and my expectation was already high from reading previous TripAdvisor reviews.

Key points to highlight:

The meet and greet at 08:30 outside Hard Rock Cafe was managed like clockwork; and Albert and the other guides were ready and well rehearsed in handling so many people from across the world who were all waiting and wondering if their money had been well spent.

We had a lovely air con coach (very comfortable) and the talk by Albert about the history of Barcelona, Catalonia and Montserrat were excellent, and we gained a lot of new knowledge, which made the time fly by on the way. Albert is a complete natural and professional and made us all laugh and relax.

The views of Montserrat on the way up by coach are breathtaking and beautiful.

The Montserrat tour including Albert’s talks and our free time were just right - not too long and yet more than enough time to take in the magnificence of such an historic and holy place. Plus we had time to use the cafe and visit the gift shops and stalls.

The trip afterwards to the winery was just as spectacular. What a fabulous place in the valley with over 1000 years of history and winemaking and so expertly explained again by Albert.

Finally the lunch of tapas and then Albert helping us understand and enjoy three amazing wines really capped a wonderful day.

Albert you are the top man as we say back in the UK. You made a great trip extra special and we both thank you for this.

Lisa and Sean D, from Devon, England, UK (please keep us in the EU!)

We went on this half day tour on the 19th September. Ana was our guide and she was brilliant. She gave us all the information we needed to visit the monastery which is beautiful. The walk to the cross is well worth it as the views are breathtaking. We went on to Oller Del Mas and were able to pick some grapes off the vines to taste. Ana is so passionate and knowledgable about the winery and the wines. She made the wine tasting fun without any pressure. So pleased we found this tip via TripAdvisor. Ana is a credit to the tour company and I would highly recommend taking the tour.

We truly enjoyed our tour of Monserrat and the winery with the meal. Luis and bus team were spectacular and so knowledgeable of the locations we visited. The logistics were smooth and straightforward and the time to spend on your own was perfect! At one point we asked Luis how long he'd been with castle experience.  We were both shocked to hear that he only been with your team for 3 weeks!! We never would have thought he was there any less than a few years...he was fantastic and really fun to be around! He is a keeper!! 

The tour itself was thorough and informative and the meal and wine tasting enabled great conversation with new friends from all over the world!

This is our second tour booked through viator and both were outstanding!!

Keep up the great work!

Thanks for a great experience.
To seek blessing from Black Madonna go through the queue. It's an hour's tour. Have lunch at the restaurant nearby. Have lunch while enjoying the view
Very nice tour with Pep, he is so polite and talented. The whole trip was an unforgettable experience and you meet new nice people. strongly recommends.

We decided on the half-day tour, which is almost 7 hours long, and we were not disappointed. The day begins around 830am and you are on your way to Montserrat by 9. Along the way, you are treated to stories and history by the guides, keeping you engaged and entertained. Our guide was Ana and she was absolutely incredible. Her knowledge, insight, and recommendations made a huge difference. You'll have an hour after the tour to engage in a number of activities (hike, museum, etc), then it's back on the bus to the winery. Ana was extremely knowledgeable on wines, the winery history, and led us through a tasting, including tapas, that was delicious and educational. We really enjoyed the day with this tour company and especially with Ana. A must do when in Barcelona!

The trip to Montserrat was definitely worth it. I wouldn’t say I would recommend the winery tour. There was no one working at the winery, and the food they provided seem to be a little dry, like it had been sitting out for a while. But overall, really appreciates Montserrat!

I was in Barcelona for 4 days and this trip was definitely the best thing I did!! Montserrat is an amazing place with spectacular views and impressive architecture in the monestary, but my favourite bit was the exclusive access to Oller Del Mar winery which is an amazing place with a great variety of top notch wines which we tasted with some yummy tapas. Our guide, Pep, was extremely nice, helpful, informative and knowledgeable of the many aspects of this tour, especially the history of Montserrat, the winery and the wine making process. Would definitely recommend it and would do it again!

Montserrat is a must if you are visiting Barcelona! The views are surreal and the city is quite charming. The trip to the winery was interesting and the wine was great. I liked the white wine created my the owner's son! The tapas were okay, but nothing great or out of the ordinary. Our tour guide was very energetic and made the day really fun!

We had a lovely trip to Montserrat and the Oller del Mas Vineyard. On the half day we had enough time to look around Montserrat although there were more things to do if we had had more time. The info from our guide Borja was useful in understanding the history of the place but it didn't feel like he was just giving us a pre written presentation and we could chat and ask questions. The tour of the vineyard was fab and the wines were lovely. It was a relaxed tasting and enjoyable. The lunch could have been a bit better, the bread was a bit too dry but we still cleared our plates.

My friends and I took the day trip to Montserrat and Oller del Mas Winery and we had an AMAZING time! Alex, our tour guide, was so knowledgeable about Barcelona, Montserrat and especially the winery! His wine tasting was our first ever but we didn't feel like beginners. Montserrat is beautiful and full of culture and history and it was only about an a hour away on the bus. Truly a great day, despite the heat, and we would recommend this to anyone who is looking to do a day trip from Barcelona!

First the good. Our guide (Ana) was delightful, informative and really enthusiastic. Montserrat was an interesting locale to visit, although the free time is limited. (We opted for the hike to the cross, which was easier than it looked.). The winery tour is fairly interesting, and Ana gave us some good information about Spanish wines. The presentation of the tapas and wine tasting needs work. The tapas in particular were mediocre at best, and was not much there. Also, the presentation of the wines was unconnected to the food itself. Did a wine tasting in Positano a year ago, and this was a far cry from the excellent presentation we had there.

We've toured numerous wineries and are seasoned travelers. This day trip was excellent and more informative than any wine tour we've had- including Napa, Melbourne, France....you get the point. It was excellent. The guide, Carol, was delightful and knowledgeable. The monastery and winery are a perfect day trip from Barcelona and the sites are beautiful and rich in history. Five stars.

The surrounding away from Barcelona is unique.
Its a special place that really makes this monastery so great.
Love the choir that sings each day in the monastery.

This tour was super convenient and very educational. Ana was very knowledgeable about both the history of our destinations and about wine. We saw the breathtaking views from Montserrat, touched the Black Madonna, and quickly toured the Montserrat museum. The wine tour was really fun too! We go to taste some very rare wines that can only be found in the area and learned how to tell the age, alcohol content, and body of a wine by just looking at a glass. Highly recommend this tour if you like amazing vistas and wine :)

Agnes took us from Barcelona to Monserrat and on to the Oller del Mas Winery for tapas and wine tasting - amazing tour! We were a group of 9 with 4 kids under 12 and she did an absolutely wonderful job of entertaining the kids and guiding the adults on this journey. We've been home for a bit and the kids are still talking about how awesome Agnes was - easily the highlight of the 3 days we spent in Barcelona! Thank you Agnes!

Thank you so much to Dani for being such an amazing tour guide! I was a bit overwhelmed at first when we arrived and were put on a large bus to be driven out to Montserrat--there was a lot of people! However, we split into smaller groups once we got out there and he kept calling us his "family" which was just a very nice touch! Made the experience seem intimate. If you were looking for a lot of time to spend out in Montserrat, probably not the best tour for you. We were just looking for a nice half-day type tour and this was the perfect amount of time for us. We were able to hike out the the San Miguel cross from Montserrat and see breathtaking views--make sure to wear better shoes than I did--flip flops not ideal! The winery tour was very chill and relaxed--it's cool because it's in an old castle and Dani did such a wonderful job at giving us the history of the place. He was so nice in being patient while we all took all the pictures we wanted and even took them for us! I highly recommend this tour. The bus was very clean and the people very sweet! Their love for Barcelona is obvious :)

Xavier was our tour guide. Xavier was informative, polite, funny and he knows his wines! Our Montserrat wine tour was the best tour l have done from Barcelona. Ask for Xavier.
Vicki

We both really enjoyed the tour and thought our guide Pol was excellent! He gave great explanations and we learned a lot. We also liked having time on our own and we thought the overall schedule of the tour was great. Visiting the winery was great too! The fact that it’s a small family owned place was really nice too. Once again, Pol provided great insights and we enjoyed his knowledgeable explanations on wine, wine making and the family business. Thank you so much! We would definitively recommend this tour!

1) Winery: Incredible! The wines, the location, the building!
2) Friendly guides, full of knowledge,willing to help you and talk with you.
3) Punctuality!

After having spent 9 months in Barcelona, I decided to gift this trip to my family who was visiting the city. The tour is made in a wonderful way, the information shared is incredibly useful, the tour is not "touristy" and it allowed us to live wonderful moments outside of Barcelona. I can't recommend the winery enough! Xavi, our guide is incredibly passionate about wines and he could assist both experienced wine drinkers, as well as novices like me and my family (we barely got anything correct in the wine tasting!). Everything from the wines, to the olive oil of the tapas were of really high quality!

A big thank you to all the team!

We had a great time and Ana our tourguide was an excellent guide full of knowledge with a funny twist. Initially we were ensure that the 10 hours tour might be too long, but in the end it turned out great. Even Joanne, our 9 year old didnt loose interest and had a great time, not the least thanks to Ana.

We had a great day out. Montserrat and Oler del Mas were certainly worth the trip. Warmly recommended.

Congratulation to Ana.

Best regards,

Joanne, Gine & Louis

This tour was a great combination of activities. We met at the Hard Rock Cafe in Plaza Catalunya were a lot of groups get together and depart, ensure you are with the correct group (destination and language) for a change this tour order was modified and did the Wine tasting at Oller dl Mas (Castell, Vinyes y Cellers) first and later the visit to Montserrat. We had no problem with this and it worked out excellent.
Dani our tour guide was fun, professional and engaging. He provided plenty of historic background at both locations. The winery is small but charming the visit to the cellars is interesting and the walk around the outdoors very enjoyable. Inside the small castle the pairing of tapas and wine was fun. The short wine tastings experience was very well done and explained by Dani. Wines and olive oil are available for sale. We continued the tour towards Monserrat, the scenes are beautiful and the trip is one hour aprox. Monserrat is an impressive rock massive that has a monastery and a church at the top. It’s a place of religious pilgrimage to visit the dark Virgin at the top of the church altar. Arriving at the early afternoon allowed our group to attend the performance of the boys choir in the church. A short but impressive work. One can walk around and visit the full church, the line to visit the dark Virgin can take 30 minutes. There is a museum and many stores with souvenirs and a restaurant. There was also a farmers market offering local grown products, jams and cheese.
There are other activities like the cable car and diverse hiking routes. Time in this tour was tight to take the shortest scenic hike. A couple in our group did venture to the cable car and made it on time to return. We were back to Plaza Catalunya by 4 pm on time to continue with any other additional activity in Barcelona.
We highly recommend this tour, don’t miss this well balanced activities to combine with your plans when visiting Barcelona.

Info is clear. Our tour group was 15 people. You see a lot during the travel, besides Montserrat and wine yard. Guides are young, fluent in english and observant. They make a little to many jokes about the effect of drinking wine but the jokes are working. Tour is a great paus from vibrant Barcelona.

This tour company impressed me with their witty, knowledgeable guides, (thanks Miguel, you were awesome), scheduled activities and relaxed pace. MONTSERRAT is stunning and has been a highlight for me. I also appreciated the fact that we were given 2 hours of free time to do what we wished. I hiked up to the cross and went through the museum which I also recommend. Our lunch was at a restaurant connected to the Oller De Mas winery. We had a 4 course meal which was average but the wine tastings at the winery were excellent. The winery has been in the same family for 37 generations. Small production so these wines are not found in retail stores. The tour lasted the entire day. Great value for the price.

We did this tour unexpectedly when the tour we were supposed to be on failed to find us as we were directed to a slightly wrong meeting point with a different tour company. Danni helped us when we were upset and allowed us on this tour a day earlier ( we were supposed to be on it the following day)
We had a difficult time in Barcelona as we had a mobile phone stolen on the 2nd day and we missed the tour. Danni our tour guide helped cheer us up and made sure we had a good time.
It is a lovely trip and the wine tasting was enjoyable. Only one negative 2as how busy Montserrat is on a Sunday. The inside of the church was so busy and it was quite uncomfortable. The queues to see the Black Madonna were also too long to be able to see this. I am sure it would be much nicer on a week day. There is also a tram that takes you higher up the mountains but again there wasn’t time to do this either.
We did however love the scenery which although it was cloudy was breathtaking. The buses were clean and comfortable and Castle Experience is a brilliant company compared to others we tried!
Wouldn’t hesitate to recommend this tour but preferably not on a Sunday. Big thanks to Danni as he is adorable x

We booked this trip somewhat last minute when we found it on internet. What a fantastic experience! The tour of Montserrat was well organized and we arrived before the large crowds. Carol offered us a history of the region on our drive out, which was a real bonus, especially since it was the week-end of Sant Jordi. Montserrat offered us a nice break from the city, but my favourite part was undoubtedly the tour of the winery. I would return in a heartbeat. The wine tasting, the tapas, the surroundings, it was all perfect! Thank you to Carol and the other guides for making this a perfect day. My only regret, now that I'm home in Canada, is that I did not buy two bottles of wine rather than just one! Asta Luego Espana!

The views were amazing and our guide Alex was the best. He knew lot about Monserrat and wines and spoke very well english. I warmly recommend this trip!
Maisemat olivat todella upeat ja oppaamme Alex oli mahtava. Hän tiesi todella paljon Montserratista ja viineistä ja puhui todella selkeää englantia. Voin lämpimästi suositella tätä retkeä kaikille!

This was a great tour from start to finish! It was well organized and delivered what was promised. Our guide Clara was informative, enthusiastic and knowledgeable. A small group made for great conversation and atmosphere. Monserrat was breathtaking, and the wine and tapas following was interesting and enjoyable. Overall, a tour well worth taking and recommended by us Canadians!!!
We had a great time at this tour. The area is beautiful and our guide Clara was very knowledgeable about the area, the Monastery, winery and wines! This is a must if you're visiting Barcelona.

Our tour guide, Agnes, was terrific! From the time we met, she wanted to get to know all of us. The bus ride was interesting as one of the other guides gave the history of Barcelona (as we were driving through the city). Whenever there was anything of interest one of the guides pointed it out.
As we neared Monserrat, Agnes told us not only the history, but legends associated with the monastery and the mountains. The tour was just the right length of time before we went to the wine tasting.
The wine tasting was in a private castle winery! Agnes was an expert on the winery, and the wines we tasted. She got our whole group involved in the experience, asking questions and having people share their thoughts.
I highly recommend this tour, get Agnes as a guide!!!

Despite the staff being delayed at starting the check-in after instructions to those on the tour to be punctual, the sorting process divvied the crowd up and we boarded a clean deluxe bus. Clara provided information on our route as well as the plans for the day. Our group of 14 began interacting during the hour on the bus following her initial talk.
At the base of the mountain, we debarked to the cog wheel tram which brought us up to the multiple monestary buildings. More information as we moved around to get to the church, including advice on how to best use the 50 minutes of free time. As no guides can lecture inside, individuals interacted with Clara one-on-one.
Those who read and researched the monestary voiced that no new information was provided, but most were pleased with her talks. Clara is friendly and informed, but receptive to new and additional information.
Folks took the hike to the St Michaels lookout. Some shopped. I spent half my time in the church, the other half on part of the other Camino overlooking the natural preserve.
We gathered at the rendezvous point on time, and used the bus to the winery. Our group had the first tour, which included two white and two red samples at a small family owned castle and winery. Five tapas were served, with options for folks with special food issues. Clara was charming as she poured the tastes.
With a bottle of water, the bus got us back on time to Plaza Catalunya.

I really, really enjoyed the tour we had, and spending my free time poking around the mountain surrounding the monastery. I did feel like we didn't really have enough time at the monastery to explore without feeling rushed. But my guide was knowledgable about everything, friendly, and overall the experience was great. And, of course, the views can't be beat...

Our trip to Montserrat was wonderful. Jordi was our guide thru the area of Montserrat, we had time to explore the area on our own. We were also able to hear the boys choir sing before we boarded the bus again to head to lunch, then the winery. Lunch was great and then we had a nice wine tasting at an old family owned winery. Great day, highly recommend

Montserrat wow!!!! Incredible, incredible, incredible. Our tour guide Ana told us that it had not snowed at Montserrat in quite some time and it was magical. The Basilica was so beautiful and we were very fortunate to hear the Monserrat Boys Choir. Once we were done, we proceeded to the winery and what beauty, history, very very nice people and the food was great.
Ana was/is one of the best guides i have ever encountered in my travels, very knowledgeable, so warm and friendly just awesome. The company is great and i would highly recommend taking this particular tour.
Gracias por todo, Y nos vemos otraves.
Jesus Y Elena
San Francisco, Calif
Very professional company. Pol our tour guide and was excellent, knowledgable and the perfect host. I would highly recommend this tour and Castlexperience.
My son and i had the good fortune to take the tour with Agnus. we had a wonderful time, on a beautiful day, and with a terrific guide. highly recommend.

My husband and I had a wonderful tour. Agnes was our guide and was absolutely fantastic. She answered all our questions about the monestary. She also gave us some great recommendations for tapas and shoe shopping. Highly recommended.

My sister and I went on the tour with Jordi who was very fluent in English and knowledgeable of the wine as well as the region as he is a local. The monastery was absolutely stunning and the winery was just beautiful! I am a vegetarian and was provided tapas that suited my dietary requirements. This tour was definitely a highlight of our time in Catalonia! The pics I took do not capture how truly beautiful this was.
Thank you Jordi and TripAdvisor for the experience of a lifetime!
💃🏻🖤🍷🍽

The team ensured people from different nationalities got along well. Insights & information was nice. Lorenzo as a guide, could relate to almost every other nationality person. I had misplaced my gloves outside the church. When informed, the crew ensured the gloves reached me on the bus at the next stop. Over-all a nice pleasant experience.
The day I went, was really cloudy at Montserrat, but the friendly crew more than made for that.

Day trip to Monserrat Monastery and a wine tasting with tapas in the afternoon was a wonderful experience. The pickup location was very convenient and the bus was modern and comfortable. Monserrat was beautiful and we were lucky to have a clear day so we could see for miles. The wine tasting was great. It was held in an ancient castle that had been been in the family for generations. Our tour guide was Marta and she was excellent. Knowledgeable and entertaining, she made the day more enjoyable. She helped us to better appreciate the beauty of Barcelona and the surrounding area.

Montserrat is probably one of the more breathtaking landscapes in the area of Barcelona. With its high mountain peaks to the churches nestled into the mountain sides, the infamous town is surely one to visit. Our guide Alex was very knowledgeable about the landscape and the history of the churches and monuments. And the wine!!! After spending the morning in Montserrat the team takes you to a small local vineyard where you can try/buy delicious tasting wines. If you are travelling to Barcelona I highly suggest this tour.

My tour was great! The weather did not cooperate and we all got wet but our guide, Marta, did a great job keeping things light and funny throughout the day and not letting the weather get us down. She was funny and knowledgeable and made everyone feel welcome. Learning about the history of the city as well as Montserrat was wonderful and the options we had during our free time were great. I chose to tour the museum and was not disappointed. I had no idea I would be able to see paintings from legendary artists such as Monet and Picasso, so I was thrilled. We had an excellent trip of Montserrat. Nuria, our guide, was outstanding- she had a deep understanding and passion about the history and explained it in an interesting way. The tour starts at the North bus station in Barcelona and goes to Montserrat, a beautiful monastery and basilica nestled in the mountains. The group takes a slow-moving cogwheel train up the mountain, which provides beautiful views. After a tour of the grounds and basilica, there is extra time to explore on your own, including tasting of 4 liquors local from the monastery. Note- there are tours with and without the cogwheel train and liquor tasting. We upgraded to the one with these features and were happy with the choice. The next leg of the trip is a visit to a centuries old vineyard, run by 36 generations of the same family. Tasting of several wines and a tapas plate is included. Nuria provided excellent explanations of the wines and vineyard history. The trip ends with the bus ride back to Barcelona- in total about 7 hours of time we’ll spent.

Enjoyable small group tour out of Barcelona. Tour guide Laura was humorous, knowledgeable, and told us interesting local history on the scenic drive into the mountains outside of Barcelona. Montserrat means "serrated mountain" and the jagged outline illustrates one of several legends she told about the origins of the mountain, the Black Madonna enshrined at the monastery there, and the mysticism of the place (including supposed disappearances of tourists!). Despite the crowds that day, the monastery (still 70 monks there, and a resident boy's choir and school) invokes an air of quiet serenity. Spectacular views, excellent gift shop, but best of all the church itself, with the beautiful side chapels and paintings, and the serene Madonna and Baby Jesus on their perch above the chapel, overlooking it all. Arrive in the church a half hour before the boy's choir performance to get a seat; it's standing room only. You can also stand in line to touch Mary's hand, which holds a golden orb to symbolize the universe, and extends from the sheet of glass protecting the rest of the Romanesque icon. After Montserrat, we drove to Oller del Mas Winery, established in 964 A.D., and owned by the same family for 37 generations. The wine tasting included 3 types of wine and cold tapas. Highly recommend this tour, and thanks to Laura for contributing to my understanding of Catalan history and culture.

Amrish from Mauritius.
It was a great day. Our guide Tony was fabulous , funny and very knowledgeable. Thank you Tony for making our day great.

MONTSERRAT

I loved the tour guides, Jordan did a great job ralking about the history of Catalonia. David was my guide and did an excellent job of educating us about the history of Monserrat, and how it was a honeymoon capital dyring the Franco years

The monastery is wonderful, and has breathtaking views everywhere.

THE TAPAS AND WINERY

My favorite part! I enjoyed hearing about how wine is different in Spain and the US.

My friend and I attended this tour, with Laura as our guide. She gave us a nice background in a brief history of Barcelona in our way to Montserrat. The tour bus was very clean and our travel was comfortable. It felt like we got a lot done during our time both at Montserrat and the Oller del Mas vineyard. I would definitely recommend if you’re looking to learn something about this region outside of Barcelona, also if you’re looking for a fun time with wine and great photo ops! 🍷📸

Sergio was our guide for this wonderful experience and we absolutely loved our time with him! He provided such insight about our surroundings at every step of the way, was kind, funny, and extremely helpful to everyone in the group. Very thankful for this trip and the beautiful tour!

We had a great time. Very easy to find the meeting point, the guides were very knowledgeable, and the views were amazing. I had been to Montserrat before, so it was nice to pair it with a winery this time. I would highly recommend.

Beautiful half day trip w/ Sergio with lovely views and history at Montserrat and fantastic tapas and organic wine at a 1,000 year old winery. Guide gave a good introduction but we also had enough free time to wander and explore Montserrat on our own which I prefer. The optional Montserrat hike was short but very steep, the fantastic views were definitely worth it. The tapas and wine were delicious. Would be good if the winery had some smaller size bottles for sale (for those of us with limited luggage capacity).

I was in Barcelona on business and took this tour so I could experience a bit of culture on the weekend. Even though I was alone, everyone made me feel very welcome. Upon arrival, everything was seamless and you are assigned a group and a leader. Our group was lucky enough to have Borja, and he was informative and knowledgeable. The trip to Montserrat is about an hour from Barcelona, and for those of you like myself who are prone to motion sickness, be prepared for a bit of a challenge on the winding mountain roads to get you there. This is absolutely no fault of the tour guides, they were kind enough to offer me seats towards the front of the bus... it's just the landscape, so be prepared or take a motion sickness medicine. Montserrat is gorgeous though,so it is well worth the trip! With the half-day tour, you don't have time to wait in the queue to see the Madonna up close so if that's what you are looking to do then take the full day trip. The choir also does not perform on the weekends, so be aware when booking. We then met back up with Borja after some free time (about an hour) and got back on the bus for a 30 min trip to the winery. It was beautiful and rustic, and we got to see a bit of how they make it while Borja told us all about the history and process. We then got to enjoy some wine samplings in a private room with our group (and a light lunch). A bit more of free time to shop in their gift shoppe, and then back on the bus to Barcelona for another hour ride home. The tour guides pointed out many things on the way there and on the way home for us, and I feel I learned a lot about the city and region. Everyone was very friendly, and Borja called our group "my family" which was sweet. I would certainly recommend this tour to anyone, and I will be returning to this company for any future tours. For any single travelers, don't be worried about being alone, they will make you feel welcome! Thank you Borja,

Amazing tour, we were 2 couples and we had a great time. Our guide Ona was outstanding. She was very attentive and informative. The tour even had a little free time but Ona was always close by when we needed her.

Tour guides were there on time to sign everyone up and split into smaller groups. We had about 10 people in our group. Bus was full size, nice and comfortable. Plenty of time to look around on your own at Montserrat. Beautiful area. Then we went down to the vineyard, short tour, then into a tasting room with just our group (not the whole busload). Tapas were fine, wine was good. Mercedes, our guide for the day, ran us through the tapas, and the different tastes of 3 types of wine.
Very enjoyable day, left around 0930, back to the starting point (Hard Rock Cafe) around 1730.
Mercedes was awesome! She was very personable, knowledgeable, and fun loving. She gave us tons of great info, both at Montserrat and at the vineyard. Really enjoyed talking to her during the day.
Tom and Lisa from Arizona

The tour of Montserrat and the Winery was fantastic. From the moment I arrived at the Hard Rock Cafe until drop off in the afternoon, I felt welcome and well informed - the tour exceeded my expectations for the day and was delighted that it was such a small group - very personal!

Luis, our guide, was also fantastic - engaging, entertaining and very well informed not only about Montserrat but the wine industry. The tasting was informative and drinking wine / eating tapas a great way to spend the early afternoon.

I completely enjoyed the tour (I am not one who typically takes tours) and highly recommend if you come to Barcelona in future.

I booked this tour primarily for the Montserrat portion, with the tapas lunch and wine experience as more of an afterthought. Some people booked it for the wine and didn't care that much about Montserrat. Both portions of the tour were so good that I'm glad they were linked into one.

We stopped at the mountainside monastery of Montserrat first. Unfortunately, because of a late bus, we lost a half hour and so had less time than we should have there. Still, Ana had enough time to give us a history of the monastery and for us to see the interior of the church. The line to touch the Black Madonna looked hours long, but you can see her from a distance. (If you want to touch the Black Madonna, go on your own and not on a tour because of the time issues.) I also had time to hike up to St. Michael's Cross to see the view. I chose those two activities instead of going into the art museum, going up to the peak in the funicular, or shopping in the farmer's market. We had about an hour and ten minutes of free time.

The wine tasting was surprisingly good. I know a fair amount about wine, but most did not. Ana gave everyone a great guide in how to taste wine, the characters of the grapes in the wines, and other tips. She really knows her stuff. I think that even those who didn't particularly like wine found it fascinating.

The title of this tour is a little misleading because it's a half day tour of Montserrat PLUS a wine tasting. We were supposed to leave at 9:30 am (didn't leave until after 10) and returned around 5:30 pm for a full day. It was worth every minute!

¡Qué una experiencia! Our tour guide, Ona, was knowledgeable, funny, and so very personable! Montserrat is an incredible site to see and the organic wines at the 36th generation run winery were wonderful and they paired well with the delightful Catalan tapas served! Highly recommendation!!

We can’t say enough great things about this excursions, Our guide was knowledgeable, funny and interactive...MARTA couldn’t have been any better. This tour has everything; bus, train, food, drink, shopping, absolutely the most gorgeous views on earth and An array of history and beauty.
If you get the chance to take this tour...do it. You won’t regret the experience.

Hola
The day was absolutely perfect. Rubi was charming, cheeky, funny & a perfect guide. I did learn many things about Barcelona I did not know before, & have been here many times.
Thoroughly enjoyable day. Highly recommend
Fantastic day! Content, duration and guidance were perfect. Thnx Alex! Definitely a trip to advise 👍

We truly enjoyed this tour! Of all the tours we took on our trip, this was the BEST! David was GREAT tour guide. He was social, fun and informative.

The other guides were awesome as well, but think we had the best with David. He made our trip fun and exciting! Looking forward to our next time in Barcelona!

Borja was an excellent tour guide with fantastic knowledge of not only the area but of the winery, the wines, the tapas and anything else we wanted to know about Montserrat
His English is excellent so it was very easy to understand.
The company should be pleased to have a fine employee like Borja

This was my second visit to Montserrat and the first for my husband and friend. We appreciated the some structure/some free-roaming balance of this tour. One could always spend more time in Montserrat. If anything could change, I would say to allow an additional 30 minutes at this site. The winery tour was just the right amount of time between tour, food tasting, and enough time to walk around and take a few photos (or use the bathroom). I noticed a few tours offer a Montserrat / winery (wineries may vary). I appreciated the smaller scale and intimacy of this one rather than the commercial scale and more wider known Cava tour. Our tour guide Dani did a great job being informative, friendly, and concise.

We all had a fabulous day at Montserrat and the wine tasting. Sergio was a great guide, very funny and knowledgeable. We can definitely recommend you and the company to anyone visiting Barcelona. First class! Thank you.

We were very impressed with this tour. Sergio was a wonderful guide. Friendly, funny, personable, and knowlegable. He took the time to explain things. The tour itself was amazing. A lot of variety. Enjoyed the train ride and the hike to the Cross. The liquor samples was a nice added treat. The wine tour was awesome. Excellent tapas and of course the wine. A job well done Sergio. From the Canadian group,
Ken, Fran, Brian, Janet, Steve and Laurie

Carol was a fabulous guide and had a kot of knowledge of the areas and wine of Barcelona.
It was a perfect amount of time at the Monsterrat with breath taking views and the wines were beautiful!

It was great!
we had a really good time!
this experience was one of our best choices in this trip!
Marta and the other guiders of the tour was the best!
thank you so much!

Tour was awesome, going to montserrat was great and this was a cool way to do it. Loved the pairing with heading to a winery after, the wines were good too! Wish i had a little more free time at the mountain and maybe a faster paced tour but i guess it went according to the audience. Tapas were more like charcutery not as filling when i expected it to be almost a full lunch but I’m still glad i went! Carol the tour guide was awesome! Definitely worthwhile, i just recommend eating throughout the day too, tapas arent really saving u money, still get a light lunch or have a big breakfast
Had the most amazing time on this tour. Carol was our guide and she was outstanding. She was more than accommodating, funny, knowledgeable, and kind. I would highly recommend this tour!!

It was great!

We all enjoyed a wonderful day with the nice guy, Sergio. He's professional and take care of us in every details.

We had a great tour to Montserrat in a comfortable bus and got a lot of information about the sight and its history. Our guide Luis was very nice and funny and could answer any question. The wines and Tapas were a delicious completion for this trip.

My wife and I had a great time on this half day tour. Our tour guide David was great. He was very informative while keeping the tour light hearted. David provides us all the information we needed and asked about. I would highly recommend this trip if you are in Barcelona for more than a day.

We had a fantastic time on this tour, and would definitely recommend it to other travelers. The company made everything easy, so we could just relax, learn and enjoy. We were met by multiple CastleExperience team-members at Plaza de Catalunya, where we checked in and were introduced to our guide, Pol. Soon we were on a very clean, modern bus on our way to Montserrat.

Pol was a remarkable guide. He is intelligent and articulate, knowledgeable and entertaining. We felt lucky to have him introduce us to the region.

Montserrat is a breathtakingly beautiful location, and the architecture, history, geography and the views all make it worth the trip. Pol first gave us a tour of the monastery and basilica, and then we had free time to enjoy it as we pleased. My daughter and I walked the trail to St. Michael's cross, which took about 20-25 minutes each way (including stopping for lots of photo ops). Then we bought some delicious local cheeses at the farmer's market, did a little shopping inf the gift shop, and then we headed on to a winery.

Apparently, the wineries visited can change, but we visited the Can Bonastra winery, which was beautiful, and makes some delicious wines. We were able to inspect the vines, pick some grapes, tour the working part of the winery inside, and then sit down in the wine cellar for tapas and wine tasting. By that time we were hungry and ready for some local refreshment.

Overall I would say this is an excellent experience and well worth the price.

Great experience, our knoeledgeable tour guide Mercedes had a great personality. The wine tour is usually 2 family wineries that are not Oller del Mass. Still a nice looking place with good wine. Montserrat was 2.5 hours of free time which was a perfect taste but not enough to do everything.

My husband and I had a wonderful experience with our Montserrat and Wine tour.
What made our trip the best was our tour guide Carolina. She was funny, knowledgable, friendly and I would recommend her to everyone. We had a wonderful time in Barcelona and will not forget our experience. Thank you!
Knowledgeable and entertaining tour guides. Beautiful scenery. This is my second time in Montserrat and I still enjoyed it.

It was so nice: nice View, nice wines, nice Spots, nice Tour guide (sergio) 😉 Everything was brilliant, the guides sergio and Marta were friendly and had good stories to tell😊 i really recommend that Tour!

Ona,our guide was terrific-very knowledgable and helpful.
The tour was a highlight! We would recommend this tour to any visitor

All the way from Australia! We absolutely loved every minute of the spectacular tour. Sergio our guide was incredibly hospitable and so much fun.
The history behind both Montserrat and the winery tour was mind blowing. Five stars all the way! I would give more if I could.
We will be back to do this again 100%.
Lots of hugs from Brisbane Australia
Awesome experience. Beautiful tour of the Monteserrat mountains along with a great tour of a Spanish winery. Tour guide was amazing and knowledgeable.
We enjoyed our tour and time at Montserrat, but we felt it was too short. There is so much to see and do that a couple of more hours would’ve been better.
We had a great day - nice and relaxing - our guide David was pretty good and informative - we went to a winery that was lovely and had some great local wine. Considered the price was fair.

This is the best way to see Montserrat and Castell Winery! The mountain and monastery are beautiful and the wine is excellent, but Sergio made the experience really special and memorable.
Sergio gave city background, location highlights, art information and connections, and then awesome detail on the vineyards the grapes and the wines.

If you can request Sergio as your guide, I'd recommend it (but I'm sure they're all awesome). You'll learn a lot, see gorgeous sites, and enjoy great wine! The only sad thing is that you can't find the wine in Barcelona!
Fantastic tour guides and great for amateur wine lovers and the mountain was very impressive. Excellent little art gallery too. Overall an enjoyable day.

This is a very good tour to take, especially on a Sunday when a lot of businesses are closed. For the half day, there is not enough time to really explore Monserrat, so I would recommend the full day tour if you want more time to explore. Our tour guide Toni was great, very knowledgeable, friendly and lively. The views are incredible, if you have time, you can climb the stairs further up the mountain or visit the museum. The wine and tapas were very good.
Great tour, wine and tapas! We loved our tour guide, Agnes! She was adorable and extremely knowledgeable about the art of wine making in Spain. Gracias!

My boyfriend and I went on this half day trip for his birthday so we would have time to go out for dinner in Barcelona at night.
The entire trip was planned extremely well, and the tour guides were very good: they were very good English speakers, professional, and made sure that everyone was having a good time even during the bus ride!
Pick up location was easy just outside Hard Rock Café, very central at placa de Catalunya!
Make sure to bring clothes for the weather. Allthough it was a warm and sunny day (for October), we still wore jeans and shirts, cause it is colder on the mountain. Also remember good walking shoes!
We were lucky to visit Montserrat on a clear day so we could see all the way to Barcelona, so if you have the possibility, check the weather forecast in advance and pick a clear day!
The tapas and wine tasting was the last part of the day, so I suggest that you bring a snack for Montserrat or buy some at the farmer's market (but there is little free time, so if you want to spend more time in the monastery or hiking to the cross, bring a snack from home)
The winery was absolutely beautiful with views overlooking Montserrat from below and the tapas and wine were very good! At first when we saw it, it didn't look like a lot, but it was enough so we were full! We could have used some free time at the winery.

We had a fantastic day with Jordi on the Montserrat & wine tour. Jordi was a fantastic guide with his knowledge on Montserrat, it was very interesting & informative. The wine tour was excellent. The vineyard is beautiful & again Jordi was an excellent guide with his knowledge of the vines & the winemaking process. The wine tasting & tapas was fun and a great way to finish the day! I would highly recommend this tour and Jordi.

Excellent tour, provided by our two knowledgeable guides, Mercedes and Aurora made for a very interesting day. They were both open to answering questions and made the day very enjoyable with the information they provided. Aurora was especially knowledgeable at the winery and explained in an easy to understand detail about the wines we were tasting. She is a benefit to the company and her sense of humour added to the fun trip. Hope to see her again!
The tour was very good. Our guide, Jordi, was excellent. He was well spoken, knowledgeable and informative, all with a good sense of humour.

The trip was interesting, the site was fascinating and the winery was a pleasant end to the excursion. The day was made all the better by our excellent guide, Max Shrady. Speaking perfect English, Spanish, Catalan and a smattering of Portugese made for fun interaction with a wide variety of travelers.

Albert was an absolute pro! His stories and pace were excellent. I appreciated he was mindful of closure times and walking times needed to get to several attractions and nudged slower tour mates to stay on time.
Castle wine tasting paired with Monserrat was fun. A nice variation of experiences for people who don’t like tours. Brilliantly paired!
Would recommend without hesitation.

This is a great tour! I went with my mom when visiting Barcelona. Our guide was Xiva, or Mr. X, and he was amazing! Informative, entertaining and very knowledgeable about all things Barcelona, Montserrat and the Oller del MAS winery. We chose the 8:45 departure and returned around 4pm. Montserrat was breathtaking and the winery was beautiful. I would highly recommend this tour!
This trip was amazing!! Our tour guide Merak was wonderful and made the trip SO funny! Recommend everyone to try this when visiting Barcelona!

We really enjoyed this combo tour! Our guide, Agnes, was terrific! As we wound our way to the Montserrat monastery, she told us so many great things about Barcelona and the Catalan region. Afterwards, we headed down the mountain to the winery, where she provided us information about both the winery and the region's wine history. It was a very enjoyable way to spend the day (away from the crush of center-city).

The organization is perfect and Sergio, our tour guide, has been very informative and knowledgeable! We had a tour in Montserrat, then free time to spend there and finally we went to the winery for the wine tasting and lunch.

It's worth spending this money!

Thank you for the lovely day!
The tour was excellent in al facets - Sergio was super knowledgeable and was very friendly where the tour itself was run very well operationally, no hiccups :)

My husband and I recently took the tour of Montserrat that also included wine tasting and tapas. We would highly recommend the tour itself (beautiful monastery, cathedral, as well as gorgeous scenery), and especially our tour guide, Luis. He has a wonderful and likable personality that helps make the stories of the history of the monastery and the area so interesting. He also has a wonderful sense of humor. We were also amazed at his knowledge of wine and winemaking. We would highly recommend this tour and if you can request Luis, do so!

We purchased it at home. Communication, documents = easy peasy. Our guide was Marta - helpful, informative, knowledgeable and. funny. Has good leadership skills and can get anyone out of shyness or quiet moods. Did I say she was funny? Seriously, next trip, we’ll look for castlexperience.com first. The only possible negative the fog at Montserrat, but even then, didn’t stop out small group of 14. Soooo worth the price.

It was a memorable visit to Monserrat monastery.Surreal listening to the boys’choir.The trip to the winery was educational & the tapas are filling.Our guide Anna,was awesome.She knows her craft👍. This excursion is a must in Barcelona.
The tour was very well organized. Our guide Toni was a super guide. He had a very good knowledge about everything and was good at communicating it. Our best recommendations 😊

My friends and I had a wonderful experience with Clara. She was always ready to provide the history of the places. Super friendly and always smiling. We were delighted with the experience we got from got this tour.

Thank you so much Clara, for helping us build great memories about our trip to Monserrat and the Can Bonastre winery.

We are not big into tours but are so glad we decided on this one. The tour is in two segments. The first is to the monastery at Montserrat which is a beautiful and interesting place to visit. Bring your camera! The second half is to a winery in the valley where you will be provided quality tapas and wine tasting while you learn about vineyard operations and producing the wine. Both of these experiences were excellent.
We also want to thank Castle-experience wine tours. They are perfect in every way. Friendly, efficient, knowledgeable and engaging. Our guide was Marta Fontanet and I couldn’t recommend a better person to lead the tour. Thank you all.

Our Monserrat Half-Day with Tapas and wine tour with Alex exceeded expectations in every way! His knowledge, enthusiasm and great sense of humor added so much to the incredible landscape, the historic monastery, the art. The second half of the day at the equally historic winery and beautiful tasting room made calling this a half day tour is an understatement! We learned so much, saw so much, enjoyed every minute of our day with such a personable and guide. Thanks so much Alex!

Daniel and the other guides were all fantastic,  very friendly,  knowledgeable  entertaining,  and animated. the wine tasting was more like wine pairing with the different items that were served

Made this experience well worth our time here in Barcelona 

Richard and Jane 

Las Vegas NV

This was an excellent day trip - the ride to Monserrat was pretty quick and once you get near the mountain the views are breath taking. Our tour guide Clara was fantastic and gave a really interesting history about Barcelona and Monserrat - she was happy to answer all questions. The visit to the vineyard was also excellent - tried a bunch of great wines and enjoyed some tapas. Highly recommend the trip!

The tour was worth the cost. It was well planned. We had plenty of time to spend at Montserrat and the winery. Our guide, Ana, was phenomenal. My father decided to call her Ana Rose because she was so sweet and kind. She was a very good guide!

This tour was absolutely lovely. The guides were charming and funny. Our guide, Marta, was hilarious and very knowledgeable not only about the monastery but also about the wine! Great tour! I highly recommend.

During our recent visit to Barcelona, my wife and I had a hankering for visiting Spanish wineries. Due to our language barrier (English speakers from America with little Spanish and no Catalan), we decided a local winery tour through a reputable company would be a smart choice. And we were correct - and then some.

We ended up choosing this company because of the combination of touring Montserrat plus a Catalan valley winery under the guide of English speaking experts within the comforts of an air conditioned bus (being from San Francisco, the humidity and heat in Barcelona were definitely several levels above our usual climates).

Merat took us and a group of around 12 or so (mix of couples and a family) in just all the facets that were promised. We even actually missed our first booking (the bus leaves at 9:30 on the dot) due to our own directional challenges, but the company was kind enough to allow us to join the following day at the same time.

The bus was within the luxury category, almost like a refrigerator in A/C (a lifesaver for us), spacious with chairs that reclined back, expansive windows to see the gorgeous scenery and lots of elbow room. Another tour group from the same company joined us and one of the tour guides gave us an excellent, informative and witty history tale on the way out of Barcelona taking us through the Roman era, through the Franco years to modern times, using local architecture and viewpoints as posts for his stories.

Montserrat was stunning. The drive up was spectacular, with views of the entire valley with breathtaking scenery and a driver that flawlessly handled the jaunt up the enormous serrated mountains. Merak, our tour guide, was extremely friendly and knowledgeable, giving us tidbits and showing us around the area before letting us have 1.5 hours to explore on our own. While others have said the exploration time was too short, we felt it was perfect; due to Merak‘s tips and recommendations, my wife and I were able to do everything from hiking the holy cross road, grabbing a quick meal and coffee, visiting the church to see the Black Madonna, having some delicious gelato, exploring the farmers market and even shopping at the gift shop.

We hit a winery in the valley after we descended the mountains and were treated to a full tour of the wine production, allowed to taste grapes from common varietals and seated to a beautiful dimly lit tapas and wine spread at a communal table in the cellar. The food was excellent - a delicious blend of meats and cheeses with hearty bread and tomato spread, while
Merak gave us the highlights of tastings from 3 wine offerings.

We had a little time afterward to purchase a full glass and lounge outside on the premises before the bus came and took us back to Barcelona.

The combination of easy traveling, friendly and informative hosts, solid wine and food, insider tips and tricks to maximize a historical site visit, the breathtaking views, the blend of history knowledge with a beautiful drive, AND the stress-free atmosphere this company has put together, are just the highlights of why I’d recommend this visit to anyone looking for a great way to spend a morning and afternoon in Catalonia.

My daughter and I chose the half day tour and were delighted with our “guide” Mercedes! Wonderful smile and sense of humor were “icing on the cake” to her knowledge of the Park and Wine! We had a great day, enjoyed the bus ride and scenery as well as the Basilica. We were very happy we followed her suggestion to hike up to St Michael’s cross. Also great was her team who also shared the history of Barcelona (2000 years in 20 min! Wow!)

Although our goal wasn’t the wine tasting we loved the winery and it’s location. Mercedes offered a very nice vermouth to start followed by three of the winery’s lovely wines.

Our only dissatisfaction was with the tapas but again that wasn’t what we came for. Bottom line: Mercedes and her fellow guides gave us a lovely day and experience.

Thank you!

We had a fantastic visit to the monastery and the castle winery. Both locations were well worth the time spent. But the experience really was created by the team of excellent tour guides!! We cannot say enough about the knowledge and professionalism of this young team. Our small group guide for the day was Aurora and what a wonderful and warm person! She did a great job sharing her knowledge not only of the sights we were visiting, but also gave us a view into life in this wonderful part of the world. Fantastic sense of humour and created a great day for all!!
Well worth this trip!

This tour was an excellent experience from start to finish. On our bus we were divided into three smaller groups, each of the tour guides were wonderful but Rubi lead us for the day and was incredible. His knowledge, friendly and very helpful manner meant everyone felt included and had a great day.

We had a really good experience overall. The tour guide was very good and spoke great English. We definitely needed more time at Monserrat to see everything. Then our wine tour at the castle was substituted due to a wedding with a different winery. It was still a very good tour with good wine but it wasn't the castle experience we had booked.

Great day out in the country with Rubi and his colleagues. We were welcomed and introduced to other participants and on our way. A very informative and amusing few minutes on Spanish history while we drove to Montserrat.
Lovely spot with mists swirling around the mountains. The basilica was interesting and the path along the mountain looking onto the valley just superb. Rubi then took us onto the vineyard and we immersed ourselves in viticulture, wines and tasty tapas. It was a lovely experience and not to long in the bus. Our thanks to Rubi and the team, keep up the good work!
Rex and Daniella from Oz.

We had a great trip to the monastery which is beautiful and then on to a winery where we had some tapas and wine. The day was terrific and Ana our guide was the best. She had such a fun personality and along with that she was so informative. We enjoyed the trip very much and will be back!

Amazing tour, our guide Mr X was very knowledgeable,friendly and funny! Well worth it!We left at about 10am, on a luxury bus with 4 other groups and visited the beautiful Montserrat first.Lots of opportunity to shop and take photos! Then of to the winery for a cheese and ham platter! We arrived back at 5 in Barcelona!
Very enjoyable tour with guide Rubi who was excellent, knowledgeable of the history and very friendly. Would recommend this tour.

This trip was great value for money and the guides were vibrant and knowledgeable. A nice comfy coach and the winery tour was fantastic. We were able to sample and purchase some great wines from this family run business. The only drawback is we could have had perhaps another hour to explore Montserrat... but all in all a fantastic day out!!
We really enjoyed the trip to Montserrat. Our guide Aina was fabulous - always cheerful and informative. The buses were very comfortable and everything was on time and smooth. Highly recommended.

I normally don’t write reviews and this is my first one. I felt it was necessary to give major props to Clara (our tour guide) for such an awesome time. She is the sweetest and her energy is amazing. She’s extremely knowledgeable and keeps you intrigued. I would book this tour again if I ever go back to Barcelona !

This tour was the highlight of our trip, Agnés was our tour guide and we absolutely loved her ! Unfortunately we were not aware there was an event taking place that day so we lost 40min of our explore time waiting to enter the parking lot. Besides that, we had an amazing time. Montserrat is definitely worth more than just a couple hours I would suggest staying the weekend on the mountain to soak it all in. The winery we went to afterwards was not Oller del mas- they were booked with a wedding which we were also not aware of - but their backup winery was amazing! Not sure of its name but Agnés made sure to take care of us, her “family”.
It was a great experience and our guild was wonderful. He knew a lot about wine making, the Monastery and the area in general. I would definitely do the tour again.
What a wonderful way to spend a day. Max, our tour guide was full of useful information and was fun to spend the day with. Highly recommend.

Montserrat was great. We were lucky to hear the boys’ choir in the church-beautiful. Winery was not as enjoyable- wine was eh, tapas were not good. Not much of a tour just ate tapas and sipped wine in a basement. Luis our guide was personable and knowledgeable.

We had a wonderful experience. Pol’s depth of historical and cultural knowledge was well told. The bus tour was a welcome change for us in that, in the previous 3 days, we did all the work so to speak in seeking experiences in Barcelona....this tour we could sit back and enjoy great scenery, see the natural beauty of this part of Spain and experience the story behind a local winery - let alone great tastings both in food and wine. Montserrat was an even greater and fulfilling story in so many ways that I think only a Catalyan like Pol could share - he set the historical context...and with sufficient detail that we could feel an intimacy between the place and its’ people.

The Montserrat experience was the most memorable that we had during our travel to Spain. It was well organized and our guide, Agnes was a cracker!. She really made a difference to this guided tour. We truly enjoyed the tasting of the wines and tapas too. I recommend this tour to everyone who visits Spain.
It's a memorable experience. Had a great tour guide - Max. Thank you, maraming salamat, and mabuhay!

This was a delightful trip. It was very interesting with spectacular scenery and views. Our guide Jordi was great. Very informative, funny and friendly. The winery part was excellent. They gave high quality wines to sample and the food accompanying them was delicious. Lovely presentation and generous portions. The whole operation was very well organized and smoothly run.

Definitely would recommend this tour. Small groups and very well organised. We opted for the Montserrat and wine tour full day and so pleased we did as there is so much to see and experience. Marta was an excellent tour guide.

Great guides! They made it worth every while. So much compassion and knowledge, there was a sick passenger on the bus and all were pretty shaken up; Max made it all so easy. The Madonna’s temple, the surroundings, the wine tasting and tapas were delectable. We recommend these folks and specifically Maximilian. Thanks
Jay and Vaishali Senjalia

We thought the whole experience was fantastic, the small group worked very well. The schedule of the day was just right, very relaxed and informative and Rubi was an excellent guide. We have already recommended this tour to friends. Loved it!

Our tour to Montserrat and the winery was a highlight of our trip. Our tour guide Dani was fantastic and made our experience so much more then we had expected. He was extremely knowledgable, personable, and very funny. He gave us the perfect amount of information and also free time so that we could make the experience our own. The size of the tour was also very nice and allowed us to ask any questions we wanted and get to know the other people on the tour. Overall, we give this experience a 10/10!
Very nice tour with Luca to Montserrat and interesting to learn about how they at Oller del Mas grow their Grapes. Good Tapas Lunch and Winetasting.

We went on this tour yesterday. From start to finish it was wonderful. Everything was well organized and right on time. Sylvia was our tour guide and she was the best. Sergio was also our guide and he was great also.

Our tour with Aurora was wonderful! She was an excellent tour guide, keeping us entertained as well as informed. We were especially impressed with her knowledge of wine. Should we be in Barcelona again, we will look for your tour company for another experience.
Had a really great day, Mercedes and the other tour guides were very knowledgeable and made the trip a lot of fun. A highlight of our trip to Barcelona & would highly recommend

This tour was an amazing experience which provided a great tour of Monserrat and an excellent lunch and wine tasting/tour at the Oller del Mas winery. Our guide Xavi was the best and primarily responsible for this amazing experience as he was very fun and knowledgeable throughout the entire tour. Highly recommend this tour and Xavi as a guide!!

Great history and views abound at this mountain top monastery.Learn about the black Madonna and how the Monastery survived the war and how the madonna became the symbol of the place. Visit the street vendors for great cheeses and sweets while you walk in the footsteps of the clergy.

I was pleasantly surprise by the tour professionalism and organization. or us it was just long enough, we had plenty of time to visit Montserrat. The wine tour was good at a small vineyard about 45 minutes away from Montserrat. There we tasted some original wines that are biological with some nice Tapas.

But this tour highlight was our guide Agnes. She was wonderful, funny and very informative. If you are looking for a nice wine tour and don't want to be out a whole day, I strongly recommend this tour.

We had the best time on our tour. Jordy was our guide and he was funny and helpful. We learned a lot and got to take in some amazing sights! Will definitely book another tour with this group when we return!

This tour offered a wonderful opportunity to see Montserrat and visit a winery in a castle run by the same family for over 30 generations. Clara is a fabulous guide: warm, friendly and knowledgeable. A great day.
I enjoyed the trip a lot, it was interesting and well organized. Rubi the guide was very friendly and professional. I highly recommend it.
After 36 generations you have to have gained quite some knowledge. This recently renovated winery is very up to date and while retaining all of the old buildings has now added a superb new addition.

My boyfriend and on were visiting Barcelona for an end of summer excursion and booked this trip to get away from the busy city for a day. Everything about this tour was wonderful. The staff was both friendly and knowledgeable and Toni, our personal guide for the visit was absolutely fantastic! The views were breathtaking, the pace was good and the wine was delicious. All in all a great time and one that I highly recommend to anyone who enjoys beautiful views, great history and delicious wine!

Jeremy

We enjoyed the entire tour, which was well organized and efficiently run. Our guide, Merak, was great. We could have used a little more time in Montserrat to fully enjoy the incredible museum there, but otherwise it was a wonderful day! Recommended!!

This was a fascinating tour enjoyed by our party of four. Well organized from start to finish, pickup to delivery. Comfortable bus, competent driver, humorous and informative dialogue delivered in the language of your choice. Group size was small enough to form a comfortable comaraderie. Adequate touring and free time at Montserrat before heading to vineyard where we enjoyed a superb lunch and wine tasting.

Can’t say enough about our group guide, Sylvia Travieso. She knew us all by name, chatted with all group members individually, and had the sweetest personality imaginable. And what a sense of humor! As I recall, she speaks five languages, and is very knowledgeable about history and architecture. The trip was great, but much enhanced by Sylvia.
