This day trip was beyond what I could've expected for the price. The bus was spacious and cool. There was plenty of free time to explore the monastery at Montserrat, but if you want to hike up the mountain at all, there isn't much time. The winery tour was great. They had just opened a new tasting room within the past few weeks that is beautiful. We happened to run into the owner of the winery which was very cool. Our guide, Albert, was great the whole time and especially knowledgeable about wine. Overall, one of the highlights of our trip to Barcelona.

The bus was comfortable. The friendly guides provided interesting information re Barcelona history. The drive up the mountain was beautiful; the scenery was the highlight. In Montserrat where we had 1.5 hrs free time. There was a mass in the church so we waited half hr. Once inside we saw the alter, stained glass and statues. The black madonna is not really visible unless you get in a long line. We went to the Museum which was worth the 8 eu and had cheese samples from an outdoor market. On drive to the winery we sat near the front to help with motion sickness. The driver did a great job on the winding roads. The winery was a disappointment. The winery “tour”was not as described. There was no “Stroll around the vineyards and delve into the wine-making process as you tour the barrel room and production areas.” ‘We didn’t see any of that. We walked past an old castle to a modern building, watched a few minutes video (no audio) and then went ito a conference room where we tried 3 wines. There were plates of snacks (tapas) in front of each seat. Cured meats, croquettes, manchego, dry toast tomato spread. The green olives were delicious. A piece of spongey cheese cake which was interesting. I liked 2 of the wines. The food was not paired to the wines poured. We didn’t learn anything about wine making in this region. Nothing about growing grapes, soil types, climate, etc or anything special about this winery. Would have been okay if the description better described the experience.

We enjoyed the trip a lot!
Our guide Merak was fantastic, the landscape and the monastery beautiful and the wine was great! ;)

Pol, our tour guide was great. He was informative but also gave us time to explore on our own. We did several tours on our vacation and he was by far the best and this was the best tour we went on. Great deal for the price too. The whole experience was lovely and made for a really great day. Highly recommend!!

My daughter and I took the castle experience tour and it was wonderful! The views going up the mountain where phenomenal as were the views from the top! Our guide Rubi was the best! Funny, articulate and a wealth of knowledge about the area and of the vineyard and wines we experienced on the second half of our tour. Would highly recommend this tour...and ask for Rubi!!

This day trip was a highlight of our Barcelona holiday. Montserrat and the monastery were gorgeous and truly a unique experience. The winery/wine tasting was well done and fun.

Everything was perfectly organised and Silvia, our tour guide, was so caring, informative and fun! Book this tour!!

This is a nice tour -- low-key, fun and easy day for a must-see attraction in Barcelona. I highly recommend this. Montserrat is fascinating and the history and views are spectacular. Meet at the Hard Rock Cafe in downtown Barcelona for a comfortable 50 minute bus ride to Montserrat. Jordi was a wonderful guide with a lot of wonderful local knowledge about Montserrat and the Oller del Mas Winery. We had a 50-minute guided walking tour of Montserrat before a 90 minute free-time. The options for the free time include a walk up to the cross with spectacular views, a ride on the funicular half-way up to the summit, a walk through the art museum and gift shop, or a hike down (and back up) to the church where the black madonna was originally discovered. The other family in our group walked to the cross, we took the hike to the church -- it was worth the trip, but a very steep climb back up. It is not an easy trip so be careful.

The vineyard, Oller del Mas, is a wonderful old winery dating back 600 years. It's about a 30 minute bus ride back down the hill from Montserrat. Jordi had great stories of the family-owned vineyard and the wine was very nice. We spent about an hour tasting wine over a light lunch of tapas and a short walk through the vineyard tasting grapes on the vine.

All in all a very nice and relaxing day.

It was a fantastic trip! Our tour guide Xavi was funny and informative and made the trip very interesting. The air-conditioned bus was very comfortable given the high temperature in the summer of Barcelona.

My husband and I were given a private tour with WeBarcelona and tour guide Flavio for a birthday gift. It was truly an incredible day. Flavio was so kind, funny, and knowledgeable about anything and everything we could have asked, from local geology to Spanish history to hiking recommendations. Our time at Montserrat was beautiful and Flavio took us up higher on the mountain and took pictures for us at all the best view points, showed us an ancient water cistern hermits had built a thousand years ago, and even sang for us at the ancient chapel on the hill to demonstrate the acoustics. Our wine tasting afternoon was at Can Bas Winery, not the one listed here, and it was absolutely incredible, and our guide, Esther, was so kind and generous with her wine pours. On the way home, Flavio and our driver Roberto were gracious enough to speak Spanish with me so I could practice.

Flavio also recommended an amazing flamenco show in Barcelona we went to on our final night!

I definitely recommend this tour and definitely recommend Flavio!!!

Some colleagues recommended this bus trip and it was very pleasant. It was a hot day when we hiked up to the cross. Didn’t have much time left to spend in the gift shop. The winery was enjoyable. We liked our guide Borja!

Great tour! Our guide, Silvia was very informative and super nice. The wine at the winery in a castle was mostly very good. The tapas was enough to fill you. We also got a ticket to taste the monks liquor and sweet bread. I highly recommend it.

A tour with Castlexperience in Barcelona took us to The beautiful Montserrat Monastery followed by a winery tour & lunch at Olle del mas winery what made our day perfect was the incredible knowledge our tour guide Alex shared with us About Montserrat and then the different wines , grapes &process of wine making a bonus was that he had travelled to the wineries in our home state of ADELAIDE in South Australia thank you Alex & Castlexperience
Valeria & the gang from Adelaide

Our guide was VERY knowledgeable and fun! I have been to many wineries, but particularly enjoyed this one. Comfortable. Beautiful setting. I sent a case of wine home to the states - what does that tell you! :)

Well worthy of the 5 star rating.
Xavi our guide was so knowledgeable, friendly & caring, he certainly made our day with him that much more memorable, thanks Xavi.
Super Fun trip! Great views and wonderful tour guide. The wine was also tasty. I would highly recommend this!

Excellent tour after a rocky start.
There was a small rock slide on the road up to Montserrat - tour guide seamless organised to go back to train station where we were taken by clog train to the village and we were able to continue the planed trip.
Excellent day.
It was an amazing tour. Everything was perfect and Toni was funny, nice and have a lot of interesting information to share. Clearly, i recommend the tour with Toni.
Tour was great . Our guide , Sylvia, was excellent. Knowledgeable and fun. We highly recommend this tour. A great way to spend the day.

This tour was a great way to see an attraction outside of the city of Barcelona.
We traveled in a very comfortable air conditioned coach.
Our guide, Agnes, was the perfect guide.....So friendly, very humorous and knowledgeable.
We appreciated the cultural experience, and really enjoyed the tapas and wine.
Again, Agnes was brilliant at explaining the wines and how to read them.
Overall it was a great day.

This was the perfect amount of tour and free time, also a good value. You take a comfortable bus about an hour to Montserrat and our guide, Agnes, was really great and gave us some Barcelona history along the way. Then once there it was the perfect amount of tour/free time and beautiful views, I feel like we did everything we wanted to do there and were tired and ready for the winery after. The winery was a relaxing experience with good food and views. Overall the perfect day trip, I’d recommend if you’re spending at least 3 days in Barcelona!

My husband and I took this tour while visiting Barcelona on July 15, 2019. Jordi was our Tour Guide and he is fantastic! His English is flawless and because he was born and raised near Montserrat, he was well informed on the area. Jordi made our tour pleasant and fun.

If you get a chance to take this tour I guarantee you'll love it! Be sure to ask for Jordi!

This was such an excellent day trip! Very well organized and run, loved the small group (no more than 16 per group). The bus was new, clean and comfortable, the sights were amazing, the guided tour was perfect- our guide was informative and funny - they were easy to understand; We had about 2 hours of free time which was very nice. The winery tour was interesting, food was great, they did a great job of accommodating food issues (we have a gluten free daughter). The day was perfect!

My husband and I booked the half day Monserrat with winery/castle tour by recommendation of our hotel.

We met at Plaça Catalunya and were organized into a small group to board a bus to the mountain. We liked how the bus ride to and from the mountain included a talk on the history of the city and more information by the guides Ana and Pep.

The drive to the mountain was smooth with nice views up the mountain. Once reached the tour of the inside of the outside and inside of the church was informative and good to listen to. Unlike other tours the part where we were able to walk around for an hour alone was good for us. We walked to the cross at the top of the mountain by recommendation from Ana.

Ana also showed us the local farmers selling their products like cheese, honey and fog— we bought a lot.

The wine tour part was really historical and explained very well. We tasted 4,5 (?) wines and had tapas. We could tell that Ana is very passionate about the mountain and wine castle. She did a wonderful job!

Recommended to others that want a half day excursion.

Booked this tour as I wanted to go to Monserrat and thought the winery would be fun and hubby wasn't keen.
I don't normally book coach tours as I like small groups but this worked really well. Travel on the coach and small groups once you get there.
The guides took turns in providing an interesting and amusing commentary which I really enjoyed.
Pep was my guide and he was great. Interesting, knowkeadgable, friendly, helpful and fun.
There is more at Montserrat than I ex poected and not enough time to do everything but I appreciate that you make choices! The basilica is impressive, views are fabulous, and museum amazing. Would have loved to do the short hike but a friend was singing at the basilica do that was unmissable!
Winery tour also great. Lovely tapas plate, Pep did a great intro on the wines and very knowledgeable.
Highly recommended

Pep was our tour guide and he was so friendly and knowledgeable and easy to converse with! We didn't know how spectacular this tour would be and would highly recommend it to anyone visiting Barcelona! The views are breath taking and the winery is beautiful and quaint, and the wine (especially the Samso) is delicious! We brought some home with us.

Our guide Aina, gave us a very interesting tour in the Montserrat Monastery of Santa Maria as well as to the Oller del Mas Winery. Both places are very historical and worth to visit with an experienced and enthusiastic guide.
Also, we have enjoyed the wine tasting and the light tapas lunch.

This was a great trip, especially for a solo traveler like myself. The meeting point was at an easily accessible location, and I was able to quickly find the pink umbrellas for the group as indicated on my ticket.

A heat wave swept through Europe while I was visiting, so the air conditioned charter bus ride made the hour or so drive to Monserrat very comfortable! Plus, the guides had great commentary to start off the ride, but then gave us the last 45 minutes to relax and enjoy the scenery.

Borja was my tour guide, and he was quite funny! He was down to earth and gave us personalized information. I appreciated the thoroughness of his explanations at both Monserrat and the winery, as well as the 90 minutes of free time we had to explore the different areas of Monserrat that were of interest to us.

The winery was idyllic, with stunning views of Monserrat. The tapas offering was filling enough so that we weren't starving or tipsy after three glasses of wine; however, I wouldn't consider it a meal. At the end, we were able to make purchases in the small shop, and the price points on bottles of wine were very reasonable!

I am extremely happy that I took the time out of my trip to go on this adventure.

Rubi was fantastic as tour guide. Very knowledgeable about the area and the amazing history. Importantly he knows his wine and this made a big difference. Great passion and engagement with the whole tour. The mountain svc the views are breathtaking. The history amazing and the 1000 year old winery is not something we have in NZ. Rubi made the day
Informed, easy and enjoyable. The crew knew what they were doing and presented very well. Well done Jordi

We had a great time on the tour today. Carol was a fantastic guide from start to finish. She gave us an amazing friendly welcome so we knew we were going to have a great time from the start.
The pace of the day was just right. Learned lots about the local history in a fun manner. Montserrat was beautiful and I very much enjoyed the wine tasting and tapas.
Thank you very much for a lovely day!

I did thé tour today and it was super. I was alone (my husband was at a conference that day) but I got to meet really nice people. We had an amazing guide, Rubi, who was so interesting and knowledgeable. He gave us lots of historical facts and guided us through our wine tasting activity. He took time to talk with everybody and was really nice. We had plenty of time to explore Montserrat and there was a lot of food with the wine. What a great way to celebrate my birthday!

We had a very nice and well organised day with Ana. She is very knowledgeable and nice. She helped us make the best of our trip with her tips. I recommend this trip to anyone including families and even with babies (10 months old for our case).

Wow an incredible tour which started in Barcelona with Ana (?spelling). The sites were amazing and she covered everything very well. A great bus driver touring us throughout the countryside. Going up to Montserrat should not be missed. The history and commentary was great. This trip was my wife, myself, and our 15 year old son. A great activity for us. What a nice stop at the winery with tapas and wine. Very nicely set up and enjoyable to meet and chat with other guests on our trip. This is an a++++ tour and staff that complete the package. Thank you!!
Our trip was wonderful. Our guide Laura was so enthusiastic, knowledgeable and fun! So glad we experienced this gem while in Barcelona. One of my favorite experiences in all of Europe!

We enjoyed the trip to Monserrat very much. Great history, beautiful country, and nice wines. For us, one of the highlights were tour guides Marta and Carol. They were exemplary in every way! Highly recommend.

Had a great time on this tour. The guides were fun and knowledgeable with good advice on how to use your free time at the monastery. We hiked to the cross- very cool views. Tapas lunch at winery was good and enjoyed learning the history of Oller Mas. Highly recommend.

This tour was the highlight of my week in Barcelona. The views from Monserrat were amazing as were the cheeses from the farmers markets there. Our guide was Carol who was exceptionally well versed in every aspect of the tour. The winery was worth visiting with nice tastings and tapas.

We attended the "half day" tour from Barcelona to Montserrat/Oller del Mas winery. It was awesome! Our tour guide Carol was both knowledgeable and personable and we appreciated her humor. She definitely made our day great. There were amazing views from the top of Montserrat and the winery. We attended on a Sunday and actually saw mass happening in the church. The tapas and wine tasting was done in a cellar-type room which created a cool experience. We would definitely recommend this tour to anyone that is considering it. It was one of the highlights of our whole trip!
She was friendly & personable! She was also knowledgeable! We had an awesome trip! We will recommend to anyone!

As a solo traveler, I went on this excursion in June 2019. Clara was my group’s guide and was completely delightful. In addition to being knowledgeable about Montserrat and the winery, Clara gave me instructions on how to take the train from Barcelona to Sitges for a better beach experience (which was great). Don’t miss Montserrat if you are in Barcelona, and for the value, this tour (particularly with Clara) just can’t be beat.

We had a great time on this tour. Our tour guide Carol was outstanding. Made history fun on the way to Monserrat and was extremely knowledgable about the winery. She was informative, witty and has a great personality. We had several nationalities on our tour and she was able to relate to all. Highly recommend this tour and Carol if you are able to get her.

SO Responsive
1. Dummy me made our reservations for La Sagrada Familia the same day as our wine tour. I sent an email at 13:30 (22:30 in Spain) the day we left for Spain asking if it was possible to change the reservation to the next day. We had 2 emails when we landed, 1 letting us know it was no problem and a second one with a new confirmation of the changed date - could not have been more thrilled, and thankful!

Wonderful Staff
2. All the tour guides were energetic (we had the lovely Laura), knowledgeable and gave a lot of information without boring you to death. They knew how to use their time wisely as to not take up all your free time at the monastery. They also didn't talk the entire bus ride which was perfect since you will need a nap on the way back to Barcelona :)

Plan your trip
3. A number of reviews I read all mentioned the same thing about not having enough free time at the monastery - which I understand, BUT you are paying for a scheduled guide with a set time frame. If you want to spend the entire day at Montserrat, then do not buy the tickets for the wine tour. We decided to take the short walk/hike to the cross (totally worth it) but we unfortunately didn't get to see the church because there was a line when we got back - so that's the only thing I'd recommend planning:
- Quickly take pictures at the monastery and church first if you plan on going on the hike.

Pricing - really?
4. When we originally purchased the tickets we thought, wow that's a pretty good deal. After the trip, we realized it was a steal! You really get A LOT for the price.

Honestly, if you have the time, want to see an amazing Monastery carved into a mountainside and enjoy good wine - this is for you!!

My husband and I booked the half day tour in order to see Montserrat and it did not disappoint! The guides were so funny and welcoming! Montserrat and the monastery were absolutely breath taking. Hearing the history behind it all from our guide Pep really helped put everything into perspective. I will say that going through the monastery felt rushed as we had about 10 minutes to go through it before it closed for mass. I'd maybe recommend to the team that they start earlier in order to prevent that? Either way, we were still glad to have seen it! The winery was GORGEOUS and the provided wine + tapas were delicious! We even left home with 2 bottles. They were very decently priced at 8 euros and 30 euros! Overall, a beautiful, easy day trip that I'd recommend to everyone! I will say -- if you get motion sickness from being on a bus and doings lots of twists and turns, take some non-drowsy Dramamine with you! My husband could have used some!

This was a wonderful and easy day trip. Just the right amount of time. The trip to the abbey is well worth it. And to hear the boys choir is a spiritual joy. The wine tour is not an in depth tour but just enough to get a feel for Catalan wines. Our guide Aina was charming and knowledgeable. I thoroughly enjoyed this tour and would highly recommend it if looking for an easy and pleasant day trip from Barcelona.

Merak was great. Spoke "perfect" English. Really kept us engaged.
All the others on the tour were from the U.S., so it made it alot of fun to swap local stories.

The 1/2 day tour was the perfect amount of time.
Loved the trip! Our tour guide Luis was incredible - friendly, knowledgeable, fun, and kind! The church is gorgeous and they give you free time to explore Montserrat. High recommend!

This tour was so nice, what a great experience of views of the city and of course the wine. Our guide, Laura, was FANTASTIC! She was so knowledgable on the tour and super fun. I'd recommend this tour 100% and make sure to ask for Laura!
Suprising your. Was much more than expected. Beautiful! Be prepared to walk to see the best sites. Was worth every penny.

This was a great tour. Maria was our tour guide and she was wonderful. She was both fun and informative. She made the whole experience great. Montserrat was so beautiful and the visit to Oller del Mas winery was terrific. Together the two stops made for perfect combination. Would recommend this to anyone visiting Barcelona. Don't miss it!

Hola:)

The tour was even more then I expected. The emotions the wines the cava the food. It was worth every penny. All the stories behind it and all the passion of wine and cava making it was an experience of it's own. 

Also I have to make all the credits to our tour guide Agnès (the princess :D) who made this journey a delight.

We had a fabulous group to make the journey. Thank you all for this. It was a day to remember. A day to repeat :) 

Best Regards
Rauno Pinsol from Estonia

This tour was a great experience. Montserrat is absolutely beautiful and Oller del Mas Winery was outstanding. Mercedes our tour guide made all this possible. She was fantastic, very knowledgeable and fun.

We had a fantastic time. Often times parents feel anxious when booking a tour with their kids because they fear that they might make their guides and other tourists feel uncomfortable but Marta and the rest of the group made us feel very welcome. The children (all three boys) enjoyed their time around the beautiful basilica and the vineyard (tasking their own wine... without the alcohol, of course).
Fabulous tour, well paced and enjoyed every moment. Our tour guide Clara was simply delightful - her love and knowledge of Spain shines through making the tour one of the best.

My partner and I greatly enjoyed the experience and would thoroughly recommend this tour to anyone seeking to sample a little culture and history from the region. Our guide Xavi was very knowledgeable and hosted the day with great energy and humour
Had a great time on this tour! Our tour guide Dani was awesome and I highly recommend the full day tour to get the most out of day. You will not be disappointed!

The meet up place was easy to find at 10 am and there were representatives there to check us in and get us with the correct guide. All tours used the same big bus to Montserrat but split off with our respective guides there for a smaller group. Our guide, Jordi, was excellent. He was easy to understand, moved at a comfortable pace, had a lot of information about the area and wine in general. We had a group tour to the monastery and then he went over all the options for our free time. We opted to hike to the cross but there is a museum, shopping, Farmers market, ornmorentime in the monstaery if you wanted. We met all the groups to then bus to the winery which was a half hour ride away. Beautiful setting. We had tapas and sampled 4 wines inside. Jordi poured and shared a lot of great information. After the winery, it was a little over an hour back to Barcelona. This is a fun, easy, relaxed day trip to get out of the city and see the countryside and the beautiful mountain. All the guides were great, some shared information about the history and the area as we traveled there and back. Highly recommend.
We loved our trip and Marta was very helpful, patient and knowledgeable with our group. Would really recommend and the mountain is something to be admired! Best thing we did while in Barcelona.

I’ve been to Barcelona before and wanted a new experience away from the bustle of the city, so I booked a tour for a gf and I. Needless to say, the day was fantastic and Mercedes was such a lovely, welcoming and knowledgeable guide. I didn’t expect such a short distance away from Barcelona could be so magical! I highly recommend and love the rustic, romantic and laid back appeal of the winery. After all, you’re in Spain, so chill 😎

Thanks Mercedes!!

Shelby

10 points to our tour guide: Jordy!
Man... this guy made the trip very fun, informative and enjoyable.
We started by having an hour bus trip from Barcelona to the Montserrat monastery where we had about 40 minutes of free time.
This was enough to enjoy the views, visit the church and complete the hike.
After this we went for a 30 minute bus ride to the winery which was excellent.
Jordy explained every detail of the winery and he was very knowledgeable.
This winery is about 1000 years old and it’s been for 36 generations in the same family.
I believe the full day tour would have been too long, so for that I recommend this tour better than the other option.

*People here complain for nothing! Just book this tour.

Kevin & Erika

This experience was great. Xavi (Mr.X) was the guide for my tour group and he was great. He was very knowledgeable and high energy. The group I was a part of had 2 young children, and he was great with them as well.

Just did this tour yesterday and it was one of my Barcelona highlights. Met our guide Maria at the arranged meeting point and it was laughs and gasps ever since. She was fantastic, probably the best tour guide I’ve ever had. Funny and warm and knowledgeable, we instantly bonded which was great as I was traveling solo. I hope she’s paid a lot because she was a huge part in making this tour successful :)

The views from Montserrat are incredible. Your instagrams will explode. Listening to the boys choir sing was extremely special - make sure to get into the chapel early for a seat up front. By the time the wine tasting rolled around I was hungry and thirsty...and this didn’t disappoint either. Do yourselves a favor and just book this tour.

Our Castle Experience was amazing. Crew was amazing, nice and Helpful.
Our assigned guide was Merak such great person, very nice, polite
and enthusiastic.
Merak gave us an exceptional experience in all the ways, he's explanations
was very rich and clear.
Overall was an amazing experience. I will recommend to my friends
Thank you

JAS

My sister and I had a very enjoyable and fun time on this trip. Xavier our guide was very good and kept us entertained. I highly recommend it. The time in Montserrat although fairly short was ample time to wander around, visit the market and take some photos, because we went on the bank holiday (May 1st) it was very busy but as a result we got a free trip on the funicular down the mountain to meet our coach. The wine tasting and tapas was excellent and the group we were with were very nice.

Thank you Luis for a great experience of this tour. We all loved to hear how knowledgeable you are as well as your personable personality. When we return, we will definitely like to have you again as our guide.
Thank you!
Eduardo Senior, Cary, Eduardo junior, Yvonne, Chris, and Melanie!!

Despite less than ideal weather (rain and clouds), we had a great day visiting Montserrat and the winery after.

Pep was a fantastic tour guide, informative, interesting and entertaining! The wine from Oller del Mas was great
It was excellent! Whole guide crew was great and our tour guide Clara was the best! We really recommend this mini trip.

My husband and I enjoyed every thing about our tour! Our guide, Luis, was amazing and so engaging! From transportation to the activities it was one of the best tours I have been on. Highly recommend!!
Absolutely beautiful! We had plenty of time to hike to the cross, view the church and look around the gift store. The winery was a fun experience.

Wow! What a trip of a lifetime. My friend and I had an absolute blast. The monastery is beautiful and having an hour to walk around and explore was a major plus. The Oller winery felt like a once in a lifetime experience, I’m so glad we were able to eat and enjoy some great wine while making great memories. All the tour guides were extremely friendly and funny. Ana was our tour guide, she is an absolute gem. She is so smart and she really enjoys her job. At the end of the trip, she felt more like a friend than our tour guide. If I ever come back to Barcelona, I will 100% do this again. Don’t miss out!

I visited Montserrat and winery tasting tour in April by myself. Our tour guide was Iana she was truly awesome and God sent for me. I have limited mobility I walk slow so keeping up with some of the tour was challenging. But Iana was so compassionate and empathic to my needs. She took me on a solo tour of Montserrat and made sure I had the same experience everyone in my group experienced. I did not feel rushed at any time of the tour, my group members were fantastic I must say either checking on me or walking with me over uneven payment. I can not say enough about Iana, she was a blessing and an awesome tour guide. I would like to thank her and my group members for making the tour one to remember.

Thank you,
Laurence

My wife and I took the tapas-lunch version of the tour with Tony as our guide, and it was spectacular! Tony was very nice, knowledgeable, and his English is near perfect. Montserrat is a natural wonder that should not be missed, and the winery was a great bonus. Our only regret was that we did not have more time to explore the grounds around Montserrat. Highly recommended, and a big thank you to Tony.

My sister and I decided to book a half-day tour of Montserrat and the Oller del Mas winery. Everything started on time and was easy to find, etc., at the time of arrival to meet the guide. We were assigned to Luis, who was an amazing tour guide. He was very friendly and knowledgeable about all the topics, in addition to being quite funny. We went to Montserrat first and had great views and then toured the basilica there. Then we went on to Oller del Mas winery and had a great lunch and sampled three wines made on site. I would recommend this trip for anyone in Barcelona looking for a half-day excursion.

We took the half day (6 hour) trip. The mountain and Basilica were breathtaking with a short but taxing walk to the cross to look back at the buildings. The wine tasting venue was what I would call boutique , good food and excellent wine. Every tour can be made or not by the guide, ours, Dani, exuded enthusiasm and passion for the Catalan history and he made the day a delight. Thank you

The tour was precisely as promised, from the meeting place, time, and pink umbrella, to the Monastery and winery. This is a “well-oiled” but relaxes, fun, engaging Spanish machine. You travel on a large bus, but are divided up, about 10 per guide, for a more intimate experience. All the guides were very knowledgeable about Barcelona history, Montserrat and wine making. And they were funny! The drive there and back was interesting and entertaining. Our guide, Marta, was the absolute best, we loved her!

We had a very good day with our guide Merak at Monserrat and the Oller del Mas winery. The one-hour bus ride was comfortable, then we were divided into small groups when we arrived at Monserrat. Merak was informative, helpful, and entertaining! We liked having enough free time at Monserrat (which is beautiful) to do/see what most interested us. The lunch at the winery was tasty. Wine tasting was fun, too!
There’s a lot to see in Barcelona, but this tour is definitely worth the money and time.

Amazing views of Montserrat with the knowledgeable guide Luis leading the way! Luis was charismatic, engaging and informative on our trip. He taught us a lot about Montserrat, the Oller de Mas winery, and Barcelona. He went above and beyond all expectations and made the tour a lot of fun for everyone in our group. Thank you for the awesome tour Luis, this was one of the highlights of our trip to Barcelona!

One problem with tours like these can be that there never feels like enough time to do anything. That wasn't so on this tour. An hour of free time at Montserrat was more than enough to enjoy the monastery and take a walk up to St Michael's Cross to enjoy the views. That said, for those less able, you might need longer to get to the cross. I made it in fifteen minutes, but took a ten minute breather once there!
The Oller del Mas winery tour was shorter than usual (judging what others have told me about their own visits) but I understand this was due to some work being carried out by the owners. It would have been interesting to see the inner workings, but the business comes first. The wines offered during the tasting and tapas lunch were lovely and the opportunity to purchase was not passed up.
Our guide was Luis and he was informative and jovial - a great combination.

My family (4 adults) picked the half day tour including tapas and wine tasting. Accommodations were made for dietary restrictions which was great. Silvia was a wonderful guide - very energetic, knowledgeable and kind. She was thoughtful to check in with everyone from the group to make sure they felt included and having a good time, including my grandmother (language barrier, so my family helped translate). We all had a wonderful time and it was one of the best parts of our vacation in Barcelona!

We selected the shorter tapas and tasting half day. For us the perfect length as there is much to do if you’re only in Barcelona a few days. We were assigned Jordi as our guide and he was fantastic. Provided an excellent abridged history of Barcelona and Catalonia as a whole on the way. While at the Monastery he provided background, great recommendations for the free time, and was willing to answer any questions, about the monastery or any topic at all; we found his insights on Catalan history and culture particularly helpful. During the wine tasting he made everyone feel comfortable and relaxed, lots of laughing and smiling around the table. Absolutely would recommend the tour.

Ryan and Liz

Paul (I'm sure it's spelled differently) was very friendly and knowledgeable about the monastery and wine. We had been to wine tours before, but we learned more about wine from Paul than any tour. Wish there's more free time to explore at the monastery. It was a very pleasant tour.

Great guide, easy to find meeting place - Merak Made the trip very entertaining - 1/2 day tour was quite enough and recommend going in the AM before it gets too crowded. Very touristy at the top but the winery was fun.
This was a great day out , Agnes our tour guide was very good, friendly and informative . I would thoroughly recommend this tour .

The views were amazing and the tour guides were great !
The winery tour and tapas was tastey,
Would definitely recommend and revisit myself

Shout out to Silvia our guide, who's boundless energy got a quiet (tired) group at 08:30 in the morning ready and eager to visit the sights.
The meeting point was easy to find and the bright pink umbrella would be hard to miss. Introductions over we got onto a coach for the 45 minute trip to Monserrat. A quick jaunt into Barcelona and winder Spanish history on the way and we were ready to go.
We went on a Sunday, so as would be expected there were a number of people that went to Monserrat for it's primary purpose, to attend Mass. We wanted to see the boys choir but because of the number of people attending Mass we could not get into the basillica until the boys were coming to the end of their second song. The experience was still lovely and I would recommend this.
We made use of our free time to soak up the atmosphere, this really is a special place and if you want to hike, there are plenty of opportunity to do so. I had little appetite to queue for the black Madonna so can not comment upon this although others in the group suggested that time with her was very limited.
Back onto the bus and a 30 minute trip to the winery. We had lunch in the restaurant with a few bottles of the wine. The food was good and the wine excellent. The staff were attentive and Silvia kept the group entertained. A quick tour of the winery and we went for the tastings, which was interesting.
The only feedback I can give is that I think it would have been better if the wine tasting occurred before the lunch, it would have been nice to have bought a bottle of the wine we tried with lunch. Although I suspect this does not occur because they do not want drunk visitors climbing to the top of the tower, which is completely understandable.
All together this was a fantastic experience and I would highly recommend it.

This was an amazing trip for my girlfriend and I. Montserrat was gorgeous and our tour guide Danny had great recommendations for us to do with our free time. When we went on to the vineyard, we got a tour of everything as well as the lunch and tasting, which were delicious. Throughout the tour, our guide as well as the others had great stories and info about the area to share with us. I highly recommend this trip to anyone. It’s considered a half day trip, so you still have time to do things in the afternoon and evening once you get back to Barcelona.

I went on this tour on February 28th, which also happened to be my 40th Birthday. It was a phenomenal day. Toni was very welcoming to me and my friends, there were 6 of us, and so knowledgeable about Monserrat and the Winery. He greeted us with a big smile at the start and kept us engaged during the tour with stories and fun facts about himself, the locations we were traveling through and the winery. He made our tour special and most memorable when he and the group surprised me with a rendition of 'Happy Birthday!' In short, he made us feel like family.
Thank you so much Toni!

(Janine)

Montserrat is a most beautiful sight, with so much to see and learn about. Had a good exercise too, walking along the trail to see the cross on the mountainside up close. Our guide Carol was excellent - so friendly, knowledgeable and energetic - gave us detailed information, and also about wines as well during the winery tour. Lunch was nice, and the whole journey was in a comfortable coach. A nice and wonderful day!

The tour was wonderful!! I loved the time at Montserrat, and Dani was an awesome guide. He was so friendly and helpful with everyone’s questions, and gave different options of how you could spend the short time there based on your interests. It was really the best experience of my trip.

Wonderful day! We would highly recommend this tour. Our guide, Carol was exceptional. She was very knowledgeable and personable. We enjoyed the small group experience, as Carol was able to more easily answer questions and interact with the group at Montserrat and during the winery tour and lunch. Montserrat is a must see!!!

Pep and Borja were excellent guides, educating us on Spanish and Catalan history during the bus ride from Barcelona to Montserrat. We split into smaller groups at both Montserrat and Oller del Mas, and Borja was so knowledgeable, friendly, and willing to answer all of our questions - both about the sights as well as Spanish and Catalan culture. We don’t typically take organized tours on our vacations, but we are so glad we did this one! It really helped to have context when touring Montserrat, and learning about the history and scope of the winery was fascinating. Highly recommend!

This tour has it all--spectacular landscapes, rich history, pretty architecture, & great food! Our guide, Borja, was very kind, genuine, and knowledgeable. He did a wonderful job making the tour fun and interesting. Montserrat is easily one of my new favorite places--highly recommend!

Highly recommend this tour/day excursion! Our guide, Clara, was truly wonderful: informative, kind and warm, and great company. Ana, who was leading another group parallel to our group, was also very friendly and helpful. The day was well-paced and nicely organized. Montserrat (equally the mountain and the monastery) is a truly spectacular sight and it was a great break from Barcelona to see some of the Catalonian countryside. The following visit to Oller Del Mas to see the winery and enjoy wines and tapas was lovely. The fact that it was a small family-owned (for 1000 years!) property was a great plus and in no way did it feel like a corporate, tourist attraction. Very happy to have taken this tour and would recommend to anyone visiting Barcelona and looking for a day outside of the city.

This was a great way to fit in a quick trip to Montserrat and tour a vineyard while we were visiting Barcelona. Great experience - definitely worth the time. Well organized tour and Alex did a great job as our guide.

Fantastic way to spend your day! We did the tour of Montserrat followed by a trip to the winery, Oller del Mas. Our guide, Luis, was so much fun and incredibly knowledgeable; we learned a ton about the area and wine. The wine and tapas were perfect serving sizes and eating them in the castle/winery while learning about each dish/drink added to the authenticity of the experience. Overall, highly recommend you take some time for this experience, you will not regret it!

Absolutely loved this trip, I would recommend it if you like learning about the local history and enjoy a good glass of wine.
We were lucky enough to have Pep as our tour guide and he was amazing! So full of local knowledge and his talks were engaging and insightful. He genuinely found the time to make you feel welcome in the group, this created a really nice environment to spend the day.

The monastery was beautiful and full of things to see, you can try liquors made by the monks for 3 euros for 4 shots if you ask at the shops. The chocolate croissant I picked up was absolutely tasty. It is considerably colder compared to the city so wrap up warm.

The tapas and wine tasing was fun and welcomed to get out of the cold for a bit. The tapas was actually very tasty. Once again Pep was so knowledgable and made the experience very fun.

I highly recommend this tour! We really looked forward to our Montserrat visit, and it did not disappoint.

Montserrat: You’ll get a rundown of Barcelona history, some information about the actual abbey, and some free time to roam around and absorb the gorgeous views and stunning architecture.

Winery: You’ll have a brief breakdown about the winery itself, how they produce the wine, etc. Then you’ll go inside the stunning castle to wine taste and have tapas. We had 3 glasses of wine, all of which are organic and delicious.

We had an awesome guide, Pep, who answered all of our questions. He is a native, so he was incredibly knowledgeable about seemingly everything to do with Montserrat, the winery, and wine production. We had very specific questions and he was able to answer all of them in depth.

One thing I can’t stress enough is that you have to bring warm clothes. Take an extra heavy jacket and peel off the layers as needed. It was about 38 degrees on the mountain when we arrived and down at the winery, it’s not much warmer!

Group tours can often be impersonal, but this one was totally different. Our tour guide Carla had a great sense of humor and extensive knowledge about Barcelona's history, Montserrat and the Winery. All of these factors combined to make this the best tour from Barcelona. While we shared transportation with other tours, that was all we shared. Our group numbered only a dozen and we all quickly bonded. We really enjoyed the pace of the tour and the combination of guided tour and time to explore ourselves. The wine tasting ended with a beautiful pink sunset. If you do only one tour, this is the one!
We loved this tour. It was the perfect amount of time to hike around Montserrat and the wine tasting was the perfect ending to this day trip.
Highly recommend, we had a blast! Nice change of pace from the city, and we had the perfect amount of time at Montserrat and the winery.

The tours were great! The guide was really knowledgeable (and cute!), but it was really foggy on Montserrat so it was kind of hard to see some things. Also, the lunch at the winery is pretty small so I would recommend eating something at the cafeteria at Montserrat.

My friends and I took the Montserrat tour and Oller del Mas winery tour with wine tasting and tapas. It was a very good experience!

Our guide, Jordi was extremely knowledgeable and enthusiastic, he makes sure that all of us enjoy the tour.. There was this guide Carol too, who told us about local history and sites of interest during our bus ride to Montserrat and Oller del Mas.

There were 10 of us in our group with different needs to cater to when comes to tasting the tapas and the I am amazed that the tour company asked at the start of our tour if we had any special dietary requirements and all were catered and serve accordingly to our various requirement.

Thumbs up guys!!!!

Thank you!!!!

My mom, sister, and I took the Montserrat tour and Oller del Mas winery tour with wine tasting and tapas. It was 100% a positive experience!

Our guide, Sandra, was awesome! She was extremely knowledgeable and enthusiastic, and was clearly invested in making the tour very enjoyable for all of us. Our guides told us about local history and sites of interest during our bus ride to Montserrat and Oller del Mas.

Our Oller del Mas winery tour included wine tastings and tapas. The BEST part of this was that they were able to provide GLUTEN FREE tapas!!! With gluten free bread!!!

I was surprised that Sandra asked at the start of our tour if we had any special dietary requirements. I have celiac disease, which means I cannot eat any gluten/wheat flour whatsoever. (If I do accidently eat even a small amount of it I get extremely, extremely sick.) This means I have to be very careful, especially in a foreign country where I do not speak the language, and take a huge risk every time I eat out anywhere. Sandra made sure I had a gluten-free tapas plate at our wine tasting. This was so special because I can never eat anything on tours like this. In addition to wine I enjoyed several tapas of gluten-free bread with olives and fish/meat, cheese, and olives. The tour’s ability to offer a gluten-free option was above and beyond because, again, I can never eat anything when I go on tours. Thank you!!!!

We signed up for Montserrat ready for something different and relaxing. We were fortunate to go on a beautiful day and Montserrat looked beautiful floating above the clouds. It was gorgeous. We went with the half day tour, but easily could've spent a whole day hiking around. Our tour guide was awesome and was able to get us in before the church closed for service. We spent the rest of our time walking around and visiting the local farmer's market. The winery was located just down the road and offered some fun tapas and tastes. We didn't go hungry although we had filled up on our share of cheeses before we came. Overall, I don't think you can go wrong with a full or half day tour, but we would definitely recommend as it was our favorite part of our trip to both Barcelona and Marrakech.

We loved our tour with Clara to Montserrat and the Oller Del Mas winery. Clara was very friendly, funny and knowledgeable. She encouraged questions and made sure everyone was having a great time.
Meeting the tour was easy and the ride was comfortable.
Montserrat is a beautiful location with amazing views and interesting history. The winery also provided fabulous views and delicious wine and tapas. They were very accommodating to provide vegan tapas which included plenty of food.
I would recommend the tour fully and would do it again if we're ever back in Barcelona.

Our day got off to a rough start when we had planned to taxi to the meeting point, but couldn't find one and had to walk the whole way making us 10 minutes late so the 9:00 tour had to leave without us. Totally understand but I was still upset to miss it, but they had another tour at 10:00 and easily accommodated us for just 10 more euros and a even better experience. They were running multiple tours and they coordination of all of them was impressive. Unfortunately there was torrential rain at Montserrat and very cold, but our guide took good care of us and navigating around the site was easy with Carla. Then the visit to the vineyard, food and conversation with our guests was very enjoyable. If the weather had been sunny if would have been a "perfect" day for me!

This tour exceeded our expectations and was a lot of fun. Our guide for our 12-person group, Alex, was enjoyable. The views from Montserrat are breathtaking. The monastery is interesting. The art museum was worth a visit. The winery tapas lunch and wine tasting was great. How bad a day could that be?

I visited Montserrat with Dani, Montserrat is a lovely place to visit, Dani is a smart guide.
To visit Oller del Mas was very delicious and educational both for my wife and me. Everything was well organized during the tour. I would like to thank for the hospitality also.

Thanks to the crew for this amazing experience. Jordi, our guide, was very professional and very knowledgeable. There are a bunch of stuff that I've got to know from Jordi during this trip; about Montserrat, history of Barcelona and even the mechanics of wine tasting.

All in all it was a great way to spend one day in your stay in Barcelona. Salud!!!

Clara was our guide and she was excellent! She was very knowledgeable and ensured we didn’t miss a thing on the tour! She kept us interested and engaged — and gave us great options for the free time we had at Montserrat (nice hike to St. Michael Cross!). The day was beautiful— crystal clear and the views were breathtaking! We were so glad we booked the tour and had a fantastic time!!

It’s a 6-hour tour and wished we stayed longer at Montserrat for a closer view of the Black Madonna. It was raining and yet our group made the most of the occasion, no view of the mountain with the abbey. The tour conductors were amazing, I learned a brief history of Barcelona as compared to my history class.

My group and I absolutely loved the tour of Montserrat and the accompanying wine tasting. The tour guides narrates your drive from Barcelona to Montserrat; they are incredibly knowledgeable and fun.

Montserrat is a beautiful Monastery up in the mountains. We lucked out and had great weather so the views were phenomenal. You learned quite a little quite a bit about the history of the area and how the monastery functions in today's age. I would personally recommend the half-day tour. Montserrat was very cool but you didn't need more than a few hours to feel like you see you've seen everything, unless you plan on attending a mass.

Afterwards we drove down to a tenth century fortress, that is now a winery. The wine and the food was delicious. Again, our tour guide impressed me with his knowledge of all things wine.

Overall it was a really fun and educational day, well worth the money in my opinion. It was an easy way to get out of the city and see the countryside without the stress of driving in a foreign country.

We read the reviews and knew that this was a good choice, but we didn’t realize that this trip would include one of the most beautiful views and experiences we have ever had. Recommend this to anyone who wants to venture a little bit out of the city and experience the sights of a lifetime.

Carol was our guide and she was fabulous from start to finish. She was knowledgeable, a great speaker, friendly and available for any questions. The reviews I read on TripAdvisor said this was a MUST when visiting Barcelona and I couldn't agree more. Everything was organized perfectly and we had enough free time to wonder and explore. I learned a lot from the amazing and talented staff. The winery was beautiful and the wines were excellent. So happy I took this tour. Thanks to all with Castlexperience for making it possible.

We had a fun day on the Montserrat and Oller del Mas Winery Tour with our guide Oriol.
The Hard Rock meeting place was fun, as folks gathered looking for the promised Pink umbrella. There were multiple guides for the large group and they were very well organized. Each small group had a dedicated guide and some folks were on a full day tour, simply sharing the bus.
The motor coach ride to Montserrat was comfortable and informative too. As we entered the mountain area, the views were spectacular as we made our way up the mountain. The church was simply wonderful, and we were there shortly before a service, which made it all seem like a place very different than the norm. Oriol tended to our group with great individual care for our needs.

We then descended to the valley and enjoyed a wine tasting and tapas. It was fun and relaxing, and there was a real appreciation for the wine and the local vineyards.

Most folks took advantage of siesta time, on the drive back to Barcelona! We returned happy and refreshed and ready for more fun in the fabulous city.

Wonderful day enhanced by Luis with him sharing so much background of the Catalonian history and area and places we would see on the tour. His sense of humour added to the pleasant day and it did not go unnoticed how caring he was, One lady was missing (she told me how kind he'd been and she had trouble walking but he'd taken the pace gently for her, even though she had us all worried and was late for our bus to leave). I was a little under the weather and Luis offered to do anything that would help and checked I was OK after I'd left the wine tasting. A great guy and a WONDERFUL TOUR GUIDE. :). Meeting up before tour is a little chaotic - don't know what you can do about it but it needs some tweeking.

Well organized tour with informative guides. Beautiful sites. Wish we’d had longer in each location. Only 1 hour free time at monastery - would’ve been nice to be able to hike some and also enjoy the church. Winery experience was nice, although the wine itself wasn’t my favorite. Overall though, worth the money for the whole event!

Having two wine drinkers in our group and never having experienced Spain or its wines before, this tour provided a great way of visiting a recommended attraction with the Monastery and Church as well as an opportunity to partake in sampling local wines. Our guide provided an excellent introduction and basic knowledge about the wines of the region and how to recognise various features of the wines we tasted.
The opportunity to spend time at Montserrat exploring the various attractions on our own, particularly suited the four of us as we were able to go our separate ways to see different aspects that were of personal interest, eg the museum, the local produce and souvenirs and more exploration of the mountain.

A well organised tour, and our guide Borja was very knowledgeable. This is a good trip if you want to get back into town by about 3.30pm. Others on our bus were doing the long day tour - CastleExperience join a few tours together but you still get the small group experience at the monastery and the winery. Highly recommended. We had a good day with Borja. Take a warm jacket for the mountain, it's cool up there.

The half day suited us fine as we didnt want to be back in Barcelona too late. The guides were fun and full of knowledge. Our guide Alfred was great and informative. There were lots of laughs and good wine.
The monastery was interesting and the views up spectacular

Our guide Xavi was engaging and enthusiastic. This was an excellent trip to Montserrat and the Oller del Mas winery. On the half day trip option we did not get to see the black Madonna up close but it didn’t matter to me as the mountains are beautiful and the hike to the nearby cross has stunning views. Tapas were nice for lunch and the wine tasting at Oller del Mas was fun. I only wish the highest rated of their wines were included in the tasting, but we took one home and have high hopes.

We did this trip this week with Xavi as our guide. He made the trip so much fun. The weather was quite bad for Barcelona and the low cloud was covering the mountains but it cleared up and the views were breathtaking. We had a great day.

My husband and I were in Barcelona, Spain in mid September 2018 and we participated in the Montserrat and Oller del Mas Winery Tour, with Luis as our guide. Luis was awesome, giving us a brief history on Barcelona, Gaudi, and even the Black Madonna when were at the Monastery. The wine tasting was enjoyable and educational and if we ever go back, we would love to have Luis as our guide again!

Brilliant couldn't fault it one bit. We both thoroughly enjoyed the tour, the wine tasting and the cog wheel train is a fascinating little journey. Jordi full of knowledge and experience a credit to your company. Tapas was fabulous what was the name of the olives with lunch and where can i buy them.!!

Once again many thanks for the days tour.

Graham and Cilla.

Castlexperience is such an awesome company and really made our Winery Tour one to remember. Our tour guide, Ana, was extremely knowledgeable and made the experience so great. The bus ride there and back is very relaxing and the whole timetable of the tour is perfect. Highly recommend!!

We had a great day with Jordi! The clouds were hanging low over Monserrat but it added to the ambience. Jordi was a fantastic guide both informative and entertaining. Montserrat and the winery is beautiful. We made some new friends and created memories with old friends. Thank you!!

The tour was FANTASTIC! Definitely recommend it! Worth every cent!
Oh, and our tour guide Xavi (Mr. X) was really the best!

We thoroughly enjoyed the tour. Aurora, our tour guide, was wonderful with so much knowledge and passion for the area. And we so enjoyed her sense of humor! The scenery at Montserrat is breathtaking and we had some free time which my husband and I spent going inside the church and then did some shopping. The winery, tasting and tapas were so much fun and Aurora's knowledge of the wines and region added so much! We are glad we booked this tour and especially glad Aurora was our guide! Thanks for a great time!

We did the half day Montserrat and winery tour (which really takes up most of the day) and really enjoyed it. Our group had 12 people and our guide was Agnes, who had a lot of energy, was a lot of fun, and could answer any question we threw at her. The tour left right on time, but due to traffic (and probably the rain) we got to Montserrat a bit late. The cathedral was going to close in 10 minutes which gave us very little time to run for it and be able to see the black Madonna. My husband and I did not go up to touch her, but there was in fact a line to do so. However, it did not seem like the line was very long, possibly because it's not like you get any time with her. From my distance, it seemed like just enough time to touch, cross yourself is so inclined, and move on. For me, trying to take a picture, the time between people was generally not enough to get a clear shot. The church itself is very nice.
Then we hiked up the path to an overlook of the valley, which took about 20 minutes to get to the overlook (coming down was a bit faster). The hike may be strenuous for some, it is pretty much up hill all the way, but worth it. When we came back down it was back on the bus to the Oller del Mas Winery.
The winery is in an old castle which has been in the owners family for 36 generations. While we did not get to see a lot of it, what we did see was beautifully maintained, and a lovely place to taste wine. It's a small winery and it's not their main business, so you will be able to find their wine locally, but that's about it. We tasted 3 wines, 2 reds and a white, made from grapes I don't remember but some of them are only found in this particular region. The accompanying plate of tapas included olives, cheese, bread with tomatoes and Iberian ham, bread with salami, bread with tuna, and a piece of the famous spanish omlet (potatoes and egg). I don't like tuna but everything else was very good, and the wines ranged from light to medium bodies. All were very tasty.
It would have been nice to taste the wines paired with the food, but that's a minor detail. Overall, it was a very nice tour and a fun way to spend our last day in Barcelona.

This was well organized and the guides were knowledgeable and entertaining. The bus ride up to the abbey was informative and well as funny, thanks to the main guide. The winery tour was directed to tourists that at least have a basic understanding of wines and the wine making process. I'm glad we took this tour

This was our third tour from Barcelona, and by far the best. We found the other tours to be too long and way too much information. If you want to spend a few hours at Montserrat and then have some wine and tapas, then this is the tour for you. We definitely had enough time to take in the beauty of Montserrat, tour the monastery, and walk around the shops,farmers market, or hike the trail up to Saint Michael's cross. Our tour guide, Agnes, was personable,energetic, and funny. Then it was off to the Oller del Mas winery. We enjoyed the quick tour, but most of all, the wine and tapas. It was a relaxing, enjoyable day.

The pick up place was great and easy to walk to. We met our guide, Alex, and he was all smiles. Loved him from the very first. He told us what we were going to do and what we will be seeing. Boarded the bus, only 11 of us, and he began the tour with an overview of what we will be seeing. Very interesting speaker and guide. He was a wealth of information throughout the whole day. At first I thought he maybe worked at the winery since he knew everything about it. Answered our questions with precise answers. Made this tour so much fun and enjoyable. His explanations of how they make the wines and store it was amazing. The wines were great and so was the Tapa lunch with desert. So much fun. Then we toured the castle which was a treat. Waked around the grounds to see how they actually harvested the grapes and how they were de skinned. Met the workers there. Was able to taste the grapes also. Cant say enough about this tour and what a great tour guide Alex was. He was so kind and sweet. He made sure we all had a great time. I recommend this tour highly. Make sure you ask for Alex as a tour guide. You will not be disappointed. Even bought a bottle of wine, olive oil and a bottle of beer. There were no bad parts of this trip. Everything was excellent. Wish I could give them and Alex a 10 star rating.... Even if you dont drink wine you will love everything about this tour. Also met some amazing new friends on the tour.

I absolutely loved the extended Montserrat tour. Aurora was a fabulous guide, very personable but also very professional. The time allotted for each segment of the tour was adequate and her knowledge of not only the history of the monastery but also of wine was impressive and valuable. I would not hesitate to recommend this tour.

Our tour guide Ana was knowledgeable, approachable and had a great sense of humor. The reason why this tour has only gotten 4 stars is because of all the problems that everybody has talked about.

1. The disappointing lunch. The food was really quite bad by Barcelona standards, I would not be complaining if it were in Scotland, no offense. The salad had no dressing and no olive oil, the sauce on patatas bravas was essentially thousand island, the pasta tasted like microwaved british airways meal. And then having lunch in the winery with very very little wine on the table, it was depressing.

2. the tour size was too large, making it difficult to manage

The up side is that the actual winery tour at the latter half of the trip has made up for most of the downs. And, Ana was amazing, could not praise her more.

A fanstatic day tour from Barcelona!! The drive was an hour in a very comfortable airconditioned bus. The tour guides provided a fun and informative talks on the way to and from. The mountains views are spectacular. The winery & tapas tasting was fun as well. We had 16 in our group which was the maximum number & it was very personal. We saw a lot of very large groups there & were glad we had a small one.

We truly enjoyed our tour we took with Luis. Luis was knowledgeable and funny. We of course wish we had more time at the monastery but overall the experience was amazing.

The Tapas & Wine was also a great experience. We learned so much about the wine produced there and enjoyed the tasting.

We are definitely recommending this tour to all of or friends that visit Spain.

Thank you again

From the moment we signed in and discovered we had the wrong date the staff were exceptionally accommodating. We were able to take the tour today with no issues thanks to Anna. Bus trip out was very informative thanks to Jordi. Our guide Clara was outstanding. Pleasant and very knowledgeable about Monserrat and wines. She shared very different information then what we usually hear at a wine tour. The visit to Monserrat was excellent. Highly recommend the hike to the cross.

Hola
We had a really delightful day. Alex was our guide and was informative and cheerful in nature. He was eager to answer any questions asked. On the bus we were given brief history. Was a good length.
Definitely would do another tour if in the area.
Cheers Kaye & Keith

Very professional, well organized, always on time. A little excursion outside of Barcelona with beautiful paysage. During the visit of wineray Oller del Mas, our tour guide Dani shows his knowledges of wine testing, wine making and of course the history of the château. We had a great time with this tour.

This was a wine tour like no other I've been on. We were able to walk among the vines and pick a few grapes to eat! The story of the winery was fascinating...let's hear it for the small family-owned business! Back at the monastery, those monks make a deep, savory brandy that was worth carrying home in my suitcase. Those 9 year old boys in the choir were angelic. Ana was a perfect fit for me. She knew so much about the monastery and the winery, she was all I needed. She was friendly and pleasant and gave alone time for this single-traveler. Definitely worth the time and the price.

I had researched this trip beforehand and all the reviews were amazing, so we booked it, and what can i say, only fantastic day trip and great value for money. Everything was so well organised and easy, our tour guide was Carol, she was so informative and nice, i could have listeaned to her talking all day. Montserrat is just one of those places you will never forget and to top it all off the winery tour which included wine and the most beautiful tapas ever was just out of this world, thank you Carol and your team for giving us this memory. Such great value for money. Marissa & Stephen

We don't usually choose to do tours, but prefer to put things together on our own and explore. We are SO happy we chose to do this! Jordi was amazing and gave us an excellent tour. He was knowledgable about the area, Barcelona and the winery itself. The bus was superbly comfortable...beware the winding roads to get to Montserrat and choose the front of the bus if you have a tendency for motion sickness. This would have been so much more difficult and not as fun if we had ventured out on our own. Thank you for the lovely day!! And if you get to Utah, Jordi we can show you where to hike!
Our tour guide Albert was so nice and knowledgeable. Make sure you take good walking shoes because there’s a great hike that’s a must!

Our hotel recommended this tour and made all the arrangements. It was very well organized from the start and Patricia and I were assigned Aurora as our tour guide.

The tour itself was amazing since the locations are very special and full of history. Aurora was genuine, generous, funny, very giving of her time with any questions. We felt very comfortable and she certainly stands out as a tour guide. Thank you Aurora for a great day.

Louis and Patricia

It was a lovely experience!!!Monserat is outstanding!!we really enjoyed the wine tour ,the winery, wines and tapas .Sandra is a really gifted guide!! thank you so much for the wonderful day.!next time i woud choose the dinner option!Value for money!!!i would highly recommend it

Our guide, Princess Aurora, was a gracious hostess. She provided that extra effort that made the entire group feel special. Montserrat was truly an amazing spectacle. A great break from the hustle and bustle Barcellona. The wine tour, tapas and wine tasting was excellent. The vineyard surrounds a 1000 year old castle. It was a wonderful place to have our lunch and three delicious glasses of organic wine. I would definitely do this again.

We had an amazing day, all credit to Xavi. He was a font of knowledge, all delivered with a very entertaining sense of humour. Xavi kept us continually informed about our activities- how long we’ll be here, what’s next etc. plus we had options. Even with rain and fog obscuring the view at Montserrat we had a great time, that’s quite an accomplishment! At the winery we learned so much about tasting and winemaking, with fun and very tasty tapas. Clearly this guy loves his job and his enthusiasm is infectious. Highly recommend!!

This tour was incredible. We loved being given a guided tour of Mont Serrat Basilica, before having free time to explore at our own pace. The scenery and Basilica are very unique, and we took many photos. Our guide Albert was incredibly knowledgeable, yet had a good sense of humour, so the tour still felt relaxed, which we liked.
The lunch was so good, and we had a chance to chat with our fellow travellers, which was really fun. Albert even wrote down his personal recipe for sangria which we are going to try at home.

We learnt a lot about the local wine region at the castle vineyard, a wine tasting inside a Spanish castle was magical, Albert really contributed to our knowledge of how wine is made, and tasted, and the wine we tasted was delicious. In all, we would recommend this tour as essential to anyone visiting Barcelona.
Great tour that gives travellers a chance to see Montserrat, a monastery and a winery, including tapas and wine testing. Highly recommended!

Trip was great, Lorenzo was a wonderful tour guide, great experience and very knowledgeable but DO NOT GET THE TAPAS extremely poor quality of tapas. Wine was good great day but definitely let down by the tapas, stale dry bread, stale dry biscuits, not good. Overall had a wonderful day.
The tour was excellent. Very easy going. Clara our guide was brilliant. The cava tasted beautiful. I learnt a lot from the experience and had a wonderful day. Highly recommend.

We were so impressed by the amazing view and enjoyed very much from the wine tour. Our guide is Xavi,he is very knowledgeable and hilarious ,his passion and love to Catalonia culture also make this trip more meaningful.

Very informative and educational tour with our amazing Guide Xavi.
He gave us a lot of freedom with time but kept us to schedule the whole half day.
His knowledge of the history of Montserrat was great as was his knowledge of the wine.
The fantastic day was due as much to Xavi as it was the destinations.
Thanks mate.
The tour was wonderful. We spent enough time in each place and had a wonderful guide: Borja was amazing. He was very knowledgeable and really enjoyed his stories/fables of the two places.

We booked the tour to Monserrat from New York. The day we went there was cloudy in the morning and as soon as we arrived to monastery the torrential rain started. But the rain did not change our day. Our guide Xavi was very helpful. He organized everything beautifully for us not to get wet. He was funny, knowledgeable and caring.Xavi gave us so much information about the monastery and the area around. Even with the rain we did not stop to go to farmers market and try and buy cheese and other gourmet food. Everything is delicious.The winery and the time we spent there was another pleasure. Even in this field Xavi was very knowledgeable and taught us a lot about wines. We enjoyed the tapas , the wine and the company. We really recommend this trip.

This day trip out of Barcelona to Montserrat Monastery and Winery tour and tasting was wonderful. We had a super guide: Xavi Roses ("Chavi". He was entertaining, personable, and knowledgeable. Castlexperience limits each guide to a maximum of 12 tourists for this tour. Our bus included 3 - 4 groups and guides. We left at about 8:45 am and were back about 3:30 pm. The trip each way is about an hour, depending on city traffic.It would have been nice to have more time at the Monastery - to take the very steep train ride to the top of the mountain, or to hike a trail to a distant cross on the top of an outcropping, but that would have take at least an hour or two more. This tour worked well with our time table. Definitely recommended.

This tour was excellent. The views from Montserrat were spectacular and the rich history of the region was fascinating. Our tour guide, Broja, was fantastic - his knowledge of the church, monastery and mountain itself MADE the tour.

Oller del Mas Winery was the perfect end to the day. The wines were delicious and the food was just enough. However, if your someone who likes a larger lunch I would recommend getting a snack from the cafe or food stands at the monastery. There are an abundance of food choices from local farms at the market.

I would highly recommend this tour - especially for couples!

This was a great day trip that I can recommend to anyone. Everything was well organized and our guide Agnes was fun and informative. Beautiful views at Montserrat. The visit to the winery afterwards for wine and tapas was a great way to top off the trip.

Its a worth of trip views from here are spectacular and Santa Maria Church is stunning bit its centrepiece the Black Madonna is so very special. a beautiful place to admire natural beauty The road to get there is absolutely scenic and awesome.
While we did not have a long time in Barcelona we wanted to get out an explore a little, this was the perfect day trip and such a great experience!

High points for logistics: Good communication, easy to find pickup spot, comfortable buses, great views from funicular and the top of the mountain. Crowds in the gift shop for liqueur tasting and in the sanctuary (line for up close with the Madonna too long for this tour). We chose to walk to the cross overlook (steep going up, but nicely bricked/paved) with the free time allowed. Could have spent another hour or two checking out the museum and such. The castle winery tour and tasting was fun but had a tiny bit of a feeling of timeshare sales! No overt pressure to buy the wines but it seem a little disappointing to our guide (Dani) when we did not purchase (assuming the owners have a stake in the tour company). Otherwise he was charming, knowledgeable and very sweet (taking it upon himself to amuse the very young and often fussy children some of the other guests had brought along). I'd recommend this company, but regardless of tour company you SHOULD see this site!

You should go on this tour! The Montserrat is beautiful and our tour guide, Dani, was awesome! He had so much energy and gave us lots of cool historic facts about Barcelona, the Montserrat, and the winery. Oller del Mas was a great stop on the way back down from the mountain. The wine and tapas were excellent, and you can even buy a bottle to go after the tasting if you like something, which you will, since it is a wonderful winery. And what a great souvenir to bring home! I would say this was a top highlight of our stay in Spain! Thank you Dani and Castlexperience!

We had a perfect day. Miguel was interesting, funny and gave us wonderful information about the monastery (Montserrat) and the history of the winery. Fantastic way to spend the day. The monastery was spectacular and the views amazing. The wines down at the Oller del Mas were very good (we bought two bottles ) and the 4 tapas were the right accompaniment to the tastings. You definitely need to include this tour on your trip.

First of all, I am not a tour person. I have never been a fan. Second, I don’t normally write reviews. My experience today totally changed both of those things! Our guide, Danny, was fantastic. So knowledgeable and friendly- giving us context to everything on our trip. Fantastic does not do him justice. The wine was fantastic- and to be tasting in a castle?! Surreal. Montserrat. Just WOW. It’s one of those places that you will literally never forget. Breathtaking. Do yourself a favor and take this tour. It’s a fantastic life experience you won’t forget!!

What a fabulous day!
With Narta our guide as well as her two counterparts it was a phenomenal day.
Organized
Fun
Light hearted
Infornative
Never boring

My husband and i had a blast.

Be sure to make visiting the family winery. The experience is once in a lifetime.

Spectacular.

The guides were great, and the crew of everyone on the tour was lovely.

Absolutely wobderful tour. We met our guide Clara in Plaza de Catalunya. Durinf the ride on a clean comfortable coach, Clara gave us some history of the area. Once we arrived ( about 1 hour ) we boarded the 10 minute teainride to Montserrat. Clara led us around after we sampled several liquors and pastry. She is very knowledgeable and gave a great presentation. After some free time, we boarded the cosch to the Olas winery, where were treated to a welcome glass of wine. We toured the entire winery and there are some amazing views including Montserrat and the snow covered Pyrenees mountains. We had a light tapas and sampled 3 more variety of wines while Clara explained the wines and how to properly grade them and judge them. She is very knowledgeable on the subject of wine. She and her colleague Miguel were more then happy to take photos of us. We returned to Plaza de la Catalunya right on time ( 5:30 pm). I HIGHLY recommend this tour and the company. By the way, once we arrived at Montserrat, we were placed into small groups. Ours had 8 people which made it more personable. Hats off to the company as well as Clara and Miguel for a unforgettable day.

Ana was my tour guide and she was so kind and provided us with so much useful information. She helped me learn more about wine than I have ever thought I would.
