She also was chill and gave us tips of what to do during our free time. She shares the culture in which she loves and I really felt immersed in the Catalan experience. Highly recommend.

Fantastic combination, Montserrat is a spectacular site where you can feel the silence and the magic and then you can try delicious tapas and great wines. This tour is a must if you are visiting Barcelona. The tour was very organised and our guide Jordi was exceptional.
Carol our tour guide leader was fun, informative, organized and well spoken. Thanks for making this a highlight of our trip to Barcelona. Highly recommended!

We did this tour a few days ago and I have to say it’s spectacular. Our guide, Dani, was wonderful, knowledgeable, energetic and entertaining. He was able to answer our questions and was a joy to be around.

There are way too many beautiful experiences to take it all in a trip. Would suggest staying there for a couple days to do it all. The boys choir gave us goosebumps and left us misty eyed. The wine was delightful. Again, Dani knew his stuff about the region and the varieties that they produce. The tour of the facility was great. Would have loved to spend an evening there with some live music! The ambience was great.

I highly recommend this trip. Well worth it.
Enjoy

My wife and I spent a couple of days in Barcelona before catching our cruise. We decided on this tour and we’re glad we did! Our guide, Xavi, or as he also wanted us to call him, Mr. X, was cheerful, funny, and above all, very knowledgeable on the history of Catalunya. Monserrat was beautiful, and the views from the mountain were breathtaking. We then visited the Oller Del Más vineyard for the wine tasting and tapas. Xavi gave us a sample of three different wines to try, along with how to properly use your senses to get the maximum enjoyment of the wine. We did learn a lot from him. I would highly recommend this tour, and if you’re lucky enough to get Xavi as your guide, it will be fantastic!

We thoroughly enjoyed our trip to Montserrat and the following wine tasting with tapas. Our experience was enhanced by the spectacular scenery, the performance of the boys’ choir at Montserrat, and by our delightful tour guide, Agnès, who was vivacious, friendly and knowledgeable.

Loved our tour to Monserrat and Wine Tasting and Tapas. Pick up/drop off location was very convenient to our hotel, just a short walk. Right in front of the Hard Rock Cafe. We were very lucky to see snow during our visit to Monserrat which enhanced the beauty of it. Our guide was excellent both at Monserrat and during the wine tasting. Would definitely recommend this tour

the tour was perfect

POL did great job and was a good guide

the wine testing and tapas after the monserat tour was great

we have good experience

thank you

What a great experience. A nice 1-day tour and wine tasting just outside of Barcelona. We wanted to do a wine tour and found this which included the most amazing bonus of Monserrat which is breathtaking and included a monk-made liquor tasting. The bus used in the tour was very comfortable and the tour guides gave us a lot of extra information during the trip. The winery was in a beautiful little castle with the view of Monserrat in the background which made the wine taste even better. The tapas and cheese included was a nice little taste. Our tour guide CLARA did an outstanding job being a great guide, kept us organized and quickly moving to see so much in the day, along with being our winery guide. She was very knowledgable and helpful.
It was the highlight of our trip to Barcelona.

This tour was perfect!! I enjoyed the half day and felt like it was just the right amount of time. My guide was Carol and she was so knowledgable and passionate about her job and the area. Monserrat is so beautiful and I think we had just the right amount of free time to explore. The winery tour was also beautiful and a great end to the day. The small group feel was wonderful.

We had a great tour with Pol as a guide. Early start in Barcelona, but easy to find the starting point! Nice bus trip to Montserrat with interesting Barcelona/Catalonia facts from the tourguids. The scenery in the Montserrat area is amazing, and we appreciated the opportunity to use the "break" for a short hike. Pol is a knowledgable guide, both with regards to Montserrat and spanish wine! Great value!

My wife and I had a fantastic time on this tour. Monserrat is gorgeous and the winery we visited was very nice as well. Our guide Xavi was very entertaining and knowledgable about the wine and local culture. We will be recommending this tour to other friends for sure.

Our wine tour went very smoothly and punctually. Pol was our guide throughout the travels, Montserrat visit, and the winery tour. He was very well spoken, paced his information eloquently and was easy to follow. He was the guide who spoke the most during our drive to Montserrat. He seemed knowledgeable, offered some personal examples from real life and was willing to look up information when asked or when he heard a comment. After we asked for local suggestions, he gladly gave us some of his own preferences. We appreciated his guide!

We had a wonderful tour made extra special by our amazing guide, Xavi. He (and Dani) had a tremendous sense of humour which meant the knowledge they gave (and they really know their stuff) was enormous fun. Can’t recommend this tour or the organisation highly enough. On my research before we went I don’t think there’s another tour covering Monserrat and the wine tasting in this way.
The tour of Monserrat was beautiful and the Wine Tasting was great. Breathtaking views, informative and funny guide. We had such a great experience.

We had a great time on this trip. Our guide, Lorenzo, was fantastic. We never felt rushed - there was a good amount of time to explore Montserrat on our own after the guided tour. I would recommend this tour to anyone.

My husband and i really enjoyed our tour with Xavi! It was fun, informative, and great wine! We would have loved it even more with better weather. I wish we would have booked it earlier in the week so that we could have adjusted the day based on weather. It was still so much fun and beautiful!

We really enjoyed the wine tour and seeing Montserrat. The wine and food were very good and Lorenzo explained everything wonderfully for us. He answered all our questions and showed us how to sample the wine. I was glad he had us stay to listen to the Monserrat boy's choir. They were amazing!
In addition, Lorenzo helped us with planning things to do in Barcelona and also gave us a list of things to do in Valencia for the remainder of our trip. He was great!!!!
Many thanks to Lorenzo and Albert!!
We did the Montserrat full day tour (with wine and lunch) and it was amazing. Ana was our guide and she was very informative and the whole tour was fun to be a part of.

This is an absolute must if you find yourself in Barcelona even for just a weekend. Our tour guide Xavi was fantastic, great personality and made the day a ton of fun.

You start off by taking an hour long drive up to the monastery. Once there you’ll get a guided walking tour followed by an hour of free time. If you’re lucky and crowds are low, you may get the opportunity to touch the Black Madonna’s hand. There are a number of things to do with your free time.
Check out the market and sample local cheeses
Take a (pretty steep) walk up to the cross on top of the mountain. If you’re physically capable of it, it’s a MUST. The views are phenomenal.
Check out the museum (we chose to do the walk to the cross over this)

After this, you’ll board the bus for a 30min drive to the winery. Once there you’ll get a walking tour and history of the place. Then you’ll be shown to a private room where cold tapas are already plated for you, and you’ll get a lesson in wine tasting while trying three of the wineries fantastic wines. Lovely experience.

Thanks so much for an amazing tour, Xavi!

It’s our first time in Barcelona and I went on this Montserrat/wine tour with 3 of my best friends and I am so glad we booked it. First of all, I love that they pick you up and drop you off which makes it so easy. Then, they entertain you the entire ride, informing you about the history of Barcelona and the Montserrat. Once at the Montserrat, the beauty of the views from the mountain and the detail from the basilica are jaw dropping. I think what made my experience unforgettable was our guide, Victor. He was so insightful, passionate and slightly comical about the history and art of the area that it was captivating. Although he hadn’t given a tour in a while, he was absolutely amazing and I’m so glad he gave us our tour. It was an experience I’ll cherish forever. Plus, the wine and tapas were absolutely delicious! The ambiance of the tasting room and the castle itself were stunning. Highly recommend the experience!

First time in Barcelona - my husband and I booked two tours - were excited to see the sites - did not receive email confirmation - tried to view bookings on TripAdvisor site - NO BOOKINGS - what to do? Cannot get in touch with anyone at TripAdvisor - did get in touch with third party vendor who conducts tours - first third party - Viator - were super helpful - responded to email in 7 hours - confirmed our booking and gave us directions where to meet. Second third party vendor - Castlexperience - had where to meet on TripAdvisor site - able to confirm dat of tour. TripAdvisor advertises 24/7 support - not true - it was the third party vendor who provided 24/7. Will think twice about using TripAdvisor in future.

Jean and Lennart

Agnes was one of the best parts of our second trip to Barcelona!. She is such a charming young lady, with a solid knowledge base of wines and the history of the region we toured. We enjoyed the Montserrat & Wine Tasting tour very much, but I must stress that it was made all the more enjoyable by the presence of such a wonderful tour guide. We will tell all our friends who might plan to visit your beautiful city about this wonderful tour, When we return to Barcelona (God willing), we will contact your agency again - for the purpose of going on another tour of yours, hopefully with Agnes!

I had an amazing time! Montserrat was breathtaking, and Aurora made sure we got there in time to actually touch the Black Madonna (not many people get to do that). Our tasting at the winery was full of laughs. I had taken the tour by myself but left with new friends. I would definitely recommend this tour to anyone who is planning on going to Barcelona and wants to experience Montserrat.

Our guide was Marta. She was FAN-TAS-TIC!

Her English was great as she had spent some time in the UK studying abroad but is a local to Barcelona which made her a fantastic resource.

I really appreciated her wittiness as she shared so many interesting facts that I never would have probably otherwise known about Barcelona as we traveled up to Monseratt.

Once we were at Monseratt they gave us extra time due to a car accident preventing us from arriving at our original planned time. That allowed us to go into the monestary after mass was over to see the Black Madonna.

Make sure to check out the museum there. it was full of amazing pieces!

Oller Dl Mas was a beautiful winery. being a wino myself I really appreciated getting to see the behind the scenes of the winery and it being a castle made it extra special.

Marta also helped us after the tour by recommending some local activities. We took her up on two restaurant recommendations and one scenic recommendation. All three were amazing and a fantastic way to end our trip!

The tour was amazing! It delivered so much more than we expected! I would definitely recommend this tour to anyone who wants to experience wine tasting. Ana was one of the best tour guides we’ve ever had! She’s was so easy to get along with and had so much energy! Anyone who had ana as a tour guide are very lucky people! The group was a great match of people. Everyone was so relaxed and friendly which added to this experience. We have made some good friends on this tour.
Jordi was a fantastic tour guide. He was very knowledgeable on the history as well as passionate.  He was excellent

We loved this outing! We were a small group, and we had time for education, sight-seeing, wine and liquor tasting, tapas, the Monserrat choir, and a hike. It was delightful. Jordi was the perfect guide. He answered my numerous questions, and by the end of the day, he felt like a good friend. Highly recommend!

My partner and I decided to do a half day tour to the Monserrat and winery and it was a great decision. We both enjoyed the tour very much and found the Montserrat awe aspiring. Our guide Pol was extremely informative and insightful during the whole tour, even giving us a brief history on Barcelona on our bus rides. The winery was a great plus as we enjoyed the tapas and the wine. We enjoyed it so much we even bought a couple of bottles to bring home back in Australia. Overall it was a great experience and we will definitely be recommending this to our family and friends. Our guide gave us the experience we had hoped for and more.

This was a great experience. While the Montserrat mountain was very cold that day, we had amazing views of the whole area, and vineyard tour afterwards was a great way to end the trip. Carol was great!

Unfortunately our trip to Montserrat was dimmed a little with rain...however, Carolina made sure we were all enjoying ourselves and getting the most from this beautiful place! The journey there was beautiful but the destination was breathtaking. Lots to do. Carolina is so knowledgeable and patient, and humorous! We were delighted with her!
The side trip to the Castle for the tapas and wine tasting was the perfect end to a perfect day! The wines were wonderful and tapas tasty! Carolina was filled with information regarding the wines and the castle! A Must Do Trip! Just hope you get our new friend Carolina for your guide! (I'm sure they are all great)!
We had a wonderful experience with this tour to Montserrat cloister and then to the vinyard for a tapas and wine tasting. Our guide Pol was amazing and told some great stories along the way.

The Small-Group Monserrat Tour, Wine Tasting, and Tapas Tour was a pleasure from beginning to end! Our guide Pol was a true renaissance man, a font of historical knowledge, well versed in the production of wine, and excellent wine tasting and tapas host, fluent in English, and all with a pleasant demeanor and positive energy that made the experience an excellent way to spend a day. We loved it...

My sister and I took the half-day tour with Agnes as our guide. Agnes was wonderful: funny, informative, helpful, and patient! The half-day tour length was perfect-- Montserrat is gorgeous and there was plenty of time to explore. There was also a great balance of guided tour and self-exploration. The winery was lovely too. Due to the touristy nature of the winery visit we were expecting mediocre wines, but we thought all three wines (glass-sized pours) were delicious! Also enjoyed the tapas. So glad we took this day trip outside of Barcelona. We would not have been able to replicate this experience on our own.

Xavi, our guide, provided a wonderful experience on this tour. He was funny, full of life and kept everyone interested. His energy and enthusiasm were contagious. We would certainly consider another tour with Castlexperience if we are in Barcelona again.
My husband and I had a great time touring Monseratt and the winery. Our guide, Marta, was amazing and hilarious. She had us laughing and learning the whole time. Would highly recommend!

Had a great time, our guide Marta was great. Did an excellent job explaning the history of the area and making my wife and I feel special. I would recommend this tour to anyone the scenary was breathtaking and the wine wine and tapas were great.

This tour is the first thing I'll recommend to any friends spending more than two days in BCN. It was such a joy to get out of the city and see such a wonderful part of the region. Pol is a fantastic guide, we learned a lot about the area while getting a taste of the culture. Not to mention Montserrat and the vineyard are breathtakingly beautiful.

My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed our small-group tour of Montserrat and the wine tasting and tapas. Our guide Xavi was a delight. Very knowledgeable and personable and he made the day great. I hadn't done much research on Montserrat Monastery before the trip and was amazed by its size, beauty and history. So picturesque. The tour is very well organized. Highly recommend!

Let me begin with this was my favorite day out of the whole trip.

Our guide was Marta and she was entertaining, knowledgeable and so much fun to be around. We began meeting in Plaza Cataluyna promptly at 945am. Heads up, the pink umbrellas are personal umbrellas, so hang tight and they will show up. :) The bus ride was smooth and narrated beautifully.

The monastery was out of a dream. It is on top of a mountain, so if you are afraid of heights, sit on the right side of the train. There was so much history and beauty. Plus it is a nice change from the hustle and bustle of Barcelona.

The winery is a castle! I love wine tasting and this was one of my top 3 wine experiences, if not #1. Every glass of wine we had was wonderful and the tapas were delicious and filling. Trust me, we did not leave hungry or thirsty. ;) The wine is very reasonably priced as well, I wish I had purchased more bottles!

If you want to see more than city life and enjoy history and good wine. I highly recommend! Try to get Marta if you can! You will not be disappointed!
